README says the executable ships with full debug symbols, which enabled Ghidra study; about thirty specifications in docs/ describe each subsystem in paraphrase, citing original functions by name and address, and JavaScript reference tools in re/tools read the game data. README credits heavy use of Claude Code, directed and reviewed by the maintainer. STATUS.md says the reverse engineering ran as background agents that each produced a spec, while the author’s reply says he reverse-engineered in Ghidra and wrote the specs himself.

Verification is project-reported. C++ checkers compare damage on all 169,312 attacker/target pairs, prices, income and interface layouts with the reference tools, rules tables with a recorded game’s memory image and world grids across 156 stock scenarios, and a headless harness checks determinism. The simulation targets bit-identical lockstep behavior but has not yet been compared with recorded games, and rendering was checked by reading snapshots.

The engine is GPL-3.0; the menu logo is excluded, and its rights stay with the original owners. The project states that it is unaffiliated with Microsoft, Big Huge Games and SkyBox Labs. .gitignore keeps decompiler output, symbol dumps and extracted data out of the repository, although two small instruction-search outputs listing original addresses are committed under re/jobs.

name: TH04: rebuilding Lotus Land Story’s four PC-98 programs from source
description_en: Reconstructs source for the Japanese PC-98 Touhou 4: Lotus Land Story and rebuilds all four DOS programs, MAIN.EXE, OP.EXE, MAINE.EXE and ZUN.COM, with a pinned Borland toolchain under Wine. Function acceptance against the original binaries is tracked separately from emulator replays that compare inputs, RNG, object pools and video with the original game. Complete-campaign, original-timing and byte-identity goals remain open.
description_zh: 为日版 PC-98 Touhou 4：东方幻想乡重建源码，并在 Wine 下用固定版本的 Borland 工具链重新构建全部四个 DOS 程序：MAIN.EXE、OP.EXE、MAINE.EXE 和 ZUN.COM。针对原二进制的函数认定，与在模拟器中对照原游戏比较输入、随机数、对象池和画面的回放分开记录。完整流程、原始时序与字节一致性目标仍未完成。
requirements: Generated PROGRESS.md reports 661 of 663 reviewed authored functions exact across the four artifacts and 99.97% of confirmed MAIN authored bytes, with two MAIN cases deferred. README says the rebuilt products need not reproduce the original executable bytes and that complete-game and original-timing acceptance are unfinished. A 64-bit native port on the port/modern-64 branch is reported with scoped Linux clears.

Supply your own legal copy containing the Japanese zun.hdi; the importer requires OP.EXE, MAIN.EXE, MAINE.EXE and ZUN.COM matching the sizes and SHA-256 values in README, whose provenance is marked candidate-local-attested pending an independent pristine dump. Image preparation modifies a disposable copy of that image, and original executables and assets are never committed.

Builds use Turbo C++ 4.0J, TASM 5.0 and TLINK under Wine; the bootstrapper fetches them from third-party mirrors that TOOLCHAIN.md does not treat as authoritative, and takes MS-DOS Player from a pinned ReC98 checkout. The tested host is Debian 12 x86-64 with Python 3.11. Runtime checks also need DOSBox-X 2024.03.01, Xvfb, xdotool and ImageMagick, and the Windows build entry point uses a WSL toolchain bridge.

README reports original-versus-reconstructed DOS replays agreeing on consumed input, score, RNG, nine actor pools, 22 state blocks and configured video regions across the four bundled demos and longer Stage 1–3 routes, while raw GDC timing and some post-reset input samples still differ. A 2026-10-16 audit found frozen native programs and candidate MAIN files missing from local storage, so historical replay first needs recovery. Public CI runs target-independent checks only.

MIT covers repository-authored code and documentation, not the game, its assets or third-party work; ReC98, credited as a migration input, has no license file at the pinned revision, and the Borland tools stay proprietary. The repository is organized around coding-agent handoffs; REA’s TH04 helper showcase and Touhou essay cover parts of it.

name: Supermodel: initial Real3D Pro-1000 image-generator emulation
description_en: Adds emulation of Real3D’s Pro-1000, the SCSI-attached image generator from which Sega’s Model 3 graphics hardware derives, to the Supermodel arcade emulator. It boots user-supplied Pro-1000 firmware from the SDK disc, emulates the board’s interrupt, JTAG and UART hardware, and exposes the firmware’s built-in monitor on the console. Nothing renders yet, and SCSI host communication is unimplemented.
description_zh: 为 Supermodel 街机模拟器加入对 Real3D Pro-1000 的模拟。Pro-1000 是通过 SCSI 连接主机的图像生成器，世嘉 Model 3 的图形硬件即由其衍生。该实现可启动使用者自备的、来自 SDK 光盘的 Pro-1000 固件，模拟板上的中断、JTAG 与 UART 硬件，并在控制台中提供固件内置的监控程序。目前尚无任何画面输出，与 SCSI 主机的通信也尚未实现。
requirements: Reviewed at merge commit 4f5d686 of pull request #343, merged 2026-10-14, which adds a CPro1000 emulator class beside the Model 3 one. The PR boots the firmware to its UART monitor and accepts console commands such as help; it states that nothing is drawn, not even the start-up logo, and that SCSI communication is the next step.

Supply the Pro-1000 firmware images p1_p4.bin and p2.bin from the SDK disc; Config/Games.xml lists their CRC32 values, and the repository does not include them. The PR says the default scene and model data sat in a SCSI ROM that the SDK lacks and would have to come from original hardware that likely no longer exists; a synthetic SCSI ROM only gets past renderer initialization.

Supermodel documents builds with GCC and Make on Windows (MSYS2, with SDL2 and SDL2_net), Linux and macOS, and a Visual Studio project; the PR adds its sources to the shared Makefile rules and that project. No Pro-1000 test or rendering comparison accompanies the change.

Source comments describe the hardware findings as reverse-engineered working hypotheses drawn from firmware disassembly, logs of unmapped accesses and UART output, embedded SCCS module strings, address cross-references, part datasheets and the SDK manuals. Some registers and the JTAG scan chain remain unknown.

Supermodel’s source headers declare GPL-3.0-or-later; the firmware, SDK material and demo databases keep their own rights. The author’s X post credits Claude with doing the reverse engineering and writing the emulation, and credits co-author Ian Curtis with the earlier SCSI-interception demos.

name: Blackbox Protobuf
description_en: NCC Group's tools for decoding and re-encoding Protocol Buffers messages without the matching .proto definition. The decoder returns the message data with an editable type definition built from best-effort guesses based on wire types; analysts can name fields, correct types and re-encode edited messages, which protoc --decode_raw cannot do. It ships as a Python library with a bbpb CLI, a Jython Burp Suite extension and a mitmproxy addon, and its README traces it to modifying messages during mobile penetration tests.
description_zh: NCC Group 推出的工具集，可在没有对应 .proto 定义的情况下解码并重新编码 Protocol Buffers 报文。解码器返回报文数据，以及根据线路类型尽力推测生成、可编辑的类型定义；分析者可以为字段命名、修正类型并重新编码修改后的报文，这是 protoc --decode_raw 做不到的。它提供 Python 库及 bbpb 命令行工具、基于 Jython 的 Burp Suite 扩展和 mitmproxy 插件，README 说明它最初用于在移动应用渗透测试中修改报文。
requirements: The library and CLI install from PyPI as bbpb (1.4.2, Python >=3.8,<4.0); the README calls the blackboxprotobuf PyPI package an older fork. The mitmproxy addon loads mitmproxy/bbpb.py with bbpb installed in the same environment; edited types survive restarts only with the bbpb_project_file option, and editing commands are unavailable in mitmweb.
The Burp extension needs Burp Suite configured with Jython 2.7+ and a clone with git submodule update --init. gRPC needs Burp's HTTP/2 support, and only uncompressed gRPC payloads are handled.

Field types are guessed from wire types and occasionally field content, so type definitions may need analyst correction; field names and meanings are not recovered, and a type-discovery tool is listed only as future work. .proto import and export use a partial parser that does not resolve import statements.
MIT. The default branch was last committed on 2025-03-14, the day of release v1.4.2.

name: Claude Intercept
description_en: A local man-in-the-middle proxy and dashboard that captures HTTP/S traffic from the user’s own computer and devices, stores it in SQLite and hands it to Claude Code through an /intercept skill and CLI. Exports such as API documentation and traffic summaries support investigating request patterns and undocumented endpoints. It is an agent-facing capture tool for authorized testing, not a reconstruction case, and it has no established REA connection.
description_zh: 本地中间人代理与控制面板，捕获使用者自有电脑和设备的 HTTP/S 流量，存入 SQLite，并通过 /intercept 技能和命令行交给 Claude Code。API 文档、流量摘要等导出模式可用于调查请求模式与未公开接口。这是面向智能体、用于授权测试的抓包工具，不是重建案例，也未确立与 REA 的关联。
requirements: The reviewed pin is package version 1.0.0, last updated 2026-06-02. It combines a Node.js proxy with a per-machine CA, a live web dashboard, local SQLite storage, a CLI and a Claude Code /intercept skill, with Markdown or JSON exports shaped for agent analysis. README asks for Node.js 22.5+, while package.json declares 22.15.0 or later; the system-proxy toggle and certificate trust are automated on macOS and GNOME/KDE Linux, and Windows needs manual configuration.

HTTPS capture requires installing and trusting the generated CA and routing a device through the proxy; README covers macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and Firefox, and warns that leaving the system proxy enabled after stopping the server breaks connectivity. README says some certificate-pinned domains fail under the proxy, and the skill states that WebSocket connections are tunneled and logged without frame parsing.

In the reviewed source the proxy and the dashboard listen on all network interfaces, and the dashboard API has no access check; README warns against running it on untrusted networks. Captures and some exports can contain account credentials and personal data, and anything passed to Claude for analysis leaves the machine under the model provider’s terms. The project limits use to devices and accounts the user owns or is explicitly permitted to test.
Tests under src/__tests__ run with node --test, but the repository has no CI workflow, and the README’s install example still uses a placeholder repository URL.

The repository is licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0, a non-commercial Creative Commons license rather than a software license, so commercial use is not permitted. The reported post presents it as a Ship Systems project built with William Haesemeyer.

name: Finding Jingle Town: Debugging an N64 Game without Symbols
description_en: A walkthrough from the Snowboard Kids 2 decompilation project on attaching gdb-multiarch to the Ares emulator while the matching build still cannot carry debug information. It breaks on a function by its ELF symbol name and reads one structure byte by hand to test whether that byte selects the level overlay. A short method note on checking decompilation hypotheses at runtime, not a reconstruction result.
description_zh: Snowboard Kids 2 反编译项目的一篇操作说明：在一致性构建仍无法加入调试信息时，把 gdb-multiarch 接到 Ares 模拟器上。文中按 ELF 符号名在函数处设断点，再手动读取结构体中的一个字节，检验它是否决定加载哪个关卡 overlay。这是在运行时检验反编译假设的简短方法记录，而非重建成果。
requirements: The post, dated 23 December 2025, asks one question: how Snowboard Kids 2 picks the level overlay on level entry. It breaks on a function that indexes 16 overlays and reads the candidate byte for Sunny Mountain, Turtle Island and Jingle Town (0, 1 and 2). Other levels and the code that sets the index are not traced.

Following it needs a Snowboard Kids 2 N64 ROM, original or rebuilt by the decompilation (the post treats them as byte-identical), and the decompilation's build/snowboardkids2.elf for function names. The post does not cover obtaining or building either.

Tools are gdb-multiarch set to mips:4000 and Ares with debugging enabled, connected through Ares's GDB remote support; an SSH reverse tunnel is optional when GDB runs on another host, as on the author's x86 Ubuntu server. The post explains that adding -g would shift sections in the absolute-address build and usually stop it booting, so structure fields are read by manual pointer arithmetic.

Results are the author's observations from one debugging session. The post calls the workflow painfully manual and reports gdbgui did not work with the setup. Its generated names have since changed: at reviewed commit 7600c79, symbol_addrs.txt names 0x8003D560 initRace and 0x800AFE8C gGameSessionContext, and the footnoted src/3E160.c is no longer in the tree.
The post describes manual debugging. The decompilation repository has no license file at the reviewed commit, and the game ROM and its content keep their own rights.

name: JPCERT/CC: APK analysis and API probing on attack servers
description_en: JPCERT/CC’s 15 October 2026 blog post on the infrastructure behind a series of unauthorized-access incidents in Japan. It reports that the attackers used AI for known-vulnerability scanning and API attacks, and that attack servers held APKs, jadx- and Blutter-related files, APK-extraction directories and an SSRF test script used to probe app APIs. It is a defender’s account of observed attacker tooling with mitigation advice, not a published AI-assisted analysis method or reproducible workflow.
description_zh: JPCERT/CC 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日发布的博客文章，调查日本国内一系列不正当访问事件背后的攻击基础设施。文章报告攻击者利用 AI 扫描已知漏洞并经由 API 发动攻击，攻击服务器上存有 APK 文件、与 jadx 和 Blutter 相关的文件、APK 解包目录，以及用于探测应用 API 的 SSRF 验证脚本。这是防御方对所观察到的攻击者工具的记述并附缓解建议，而非公开的 AI 辅助分析方法或可复现的工作流程。
requirements: The reviewed source is the Japanese-language JPCERT/CC Eyes post dated 15 October 2026; no English version was found at the corresponding URL during review. It follows JPCERT/CC’s 8 October alert about personal-data leaks reported by several organizations in Japan, and describes three investigated servers, one of which it states is not directly related to these attacks.

The post states that JPCERT/CC confirmed AI use for scanning and API attacks, but it does not name the AI system or tooling or explain how AI was applied. The roles of the SSRF script and some files are described as likely rather than confirmed. Findings are illustrated with partial file listings and one script; no samples, logs, prompts or timelines are published.

Appendix A describes Blutter as an open-source tool for analyzing the Dart AOT-compiled code in Flutter apps, and cites third-party write-ups that combine Frida, Blutter, LIEF and Capstone to recover embedded keys and request-signing logic. These are referenced examples, not JPCERT/CC’s own reproduction.

Recommended mitigations are to keep API signing keys and long-lived credentials out of apps, to authenticate and authorize users on the server rather than rely on in-app signing or obfuscation, to rate-limit and monitor API use, and to restrict SSRF-prone URL fetches and re-validate redirect destinations. The post also lists three attacker IP indicators.
The post names jadx and Blutter but no other analysis tools.

name: Xenosaga I Decomp Compatibility Kit
description_en: Checks a PS2 matching decompilation from outside its own build: the C is recompiled with a stock, unpatched ee-gcc 2.96 and assembler, then each function is byte-compared against the original and every difference is classified by its likely toolchain cause. Companion scripts export ELF symbol tables to CSV and convert them to splat symbol files. Defaults target Xenosaga Episode I; the README says the method generalises but the defaults do not.
description_zh: 在匹配反编译项目自身的构建之外进行检查：用未打补丁的原版 ee-gcc 2.96 及汇编器重新编译其 C 代码，再逐函数与原程序逐字节比较，并按可能的工具链原因对每处差异分类。配套脚本可将 ELF 符号表导出为 CSV，并转换为 splat 符号文件。默认配置针对 Xenosaga Episode I；README 称方法可推广，默认配置则不能。
requirements: The reviewed commit d9bb53d is the second of two commits, both made on 2026-09-25; there are no releases or tests. It holds three Python tools and symbol data for the NTSC-U Xenosaga Episode I executable SLUS_204.69 and its five overlays, built with SCE ee-gcc 2.96. Tool docstrings still refer to out/ paths and a TOOLCHAIN.md that are not in the repository.

verify_decomp.py needs a checkout of the decompilation under test, your own SLUS_204.69 and extracted originals (located through DECOMP_GAME_DIR), and an i386 root filesystem with stock ee-gcc 2.96 and ee-as run through Docker under linux/386 emulation, plus clang for preprocessing. The README points to decompme/compilers for the compiler, which is not vendored, and documents a colima and binfmt route for Apple-silicon Macs.

It compiles each C translation unit with -DSKIP_ASM, compares every defined function against the original bytes, labels differences hazard-nop, reorder, mixed, immediate or unexplained, and exits nonzero only for unexplained ones. The README warns that the mixed class masks branch and call targets, so a wrong target there is not flagged; functions whose relocations need the tested project's data layout are reported as unverifiable.

The README's case study against an anonymised PS2 matching decompilation reports 817 of 857 functions identical, 40 differences all in toolchain classes, 195 unverifiable and one compiler crash. It also reports 5,927 shared names with no address disagreements against another decompilation's symbol file. Neither result is published with its inputs.

MIT-licensed. The repository includes a 15,132-entry symbol table that its README says comes from the unstripped retail executables, but no game binaries, extracted assets or decompiled game code; the game remains its rights holders' property.

name: inFAMOUS Second Son native PC port
description_en: Runs the PS4 inFAMOUS Second Son’s own x86-64 code natively on Windows and Linux: a runtime reimplements the PS4 system libraries the game uses, and a shadPS4-derived core translates its GPU commands and shaders to Vulkan. The project reports a playable, in-development port that reaches gameplay and the first chapters, with unstable performance and remaining graphics glitches. It is a compatibility-runtime port rather than a decompilation, and its results remain project-reported.
description_zh: 在 Windows 与 Linux 上原生运行 PS4 版《声名狼藉：次子》自身的 x86-64 代码：由运行时重新实现游戏所用的 PS4 系统库，并以源自 shadPS4 的核心将其 GPU 命令与着色器转换为 Vulkan。项目报告该移植可以游玩但仍在开发中，能进入游戏并通过最初几章，性能仍不稳定，也有尚未解决的图形问题。这是兼容运行时移植而非反编译重建，结果仍为项目报告。
requirements: Reviewed at the commit of release v2026.10.19-d3995fe (2026-10-19); the repository was created on 2026-10-13 and changes quickly. README marks the port playable and in development: boot, intro, gameplay up to a named early mission, saves, audio, controllers and motion-sensor substitutes work, while performance is typically 20–30 FPS on an RTX 2060, first-time shader compilation stutters and some fog, water and fire effects flicker. Full-game completion is not confirmed, and a crash on AMD Polaris GPUs under Windows remains open.

Supply your own copy of the US PS4 release CUSA00223, base game 1.00 merged with update 1.07 (about 33 GB), including the 1.07 eboot.bin and the game’s own libc and Fios2 modules; README reports that CUSA00004 also boots but is not tested in depth. No PS4 firmware modules are needed, and README states that no game code, files or art are distributed. The project disclaims affiliation with Sony Interactive Entertainment and Sucker Punch Productions.

Play needs 64-bit Windows 10 (1903+) or 11, or x86-64 Linux with glibc 2.39+, and a Vulkan 1.3 GPU, with 6 GB of VRAM recommended; CPUs lacking F16C or SSE4A get instruction emulation at start-up. Building uses a recursive clone with the listed submodules and port/build.sh, with SDL3, Vulkan, FFmpeg, FreeType, Boost, fmt, Zydis and glslang on Linux and an MSYS2 CLANG64 toolchain on Windows; the Qt launcher needs PySide6.

Evidence is play-testing, issue reports and logs: README cites Linux tests on Nobara/Fedora 44, player tests on Windows and a seven-minute RTX 2060 session with a median of 27 FPS. The CI workflow builds Linux and Windows packages for pull requests and authorized manual releases, and its Linux job runs C, Python and GPU-library unit tests without game content or automated gameplay tests.

README declares GPL-2.0 for the project and credits code from HayatoG’s earlier The Last Guardian and Gravity Rush 2 ports, gow3_pc, bloodborne_pc, shadPS4 and a fork of it, and a Shadow of the Colossus port; experimental fixes are traced to their source commits. The game and its assets keep their owners’ rights.

name: xoreos: an open reimplementation of BioWare’s Aurora engine family
description_en: Reimplements BioWare’s Aurora engine and its later derivatives as a portable C++ engine that runs on the user’s installed game data, targeting nine games from Neverwinter Nights to Dragon Age II. Resource management, many Aurora file formats, graphics and sound are in place, and every target shows partial in-game areas in a free-flying spectator mode. README states that normal gameplay is not implemented yet, so this is an early-stage engine case, not a playable replacement.
description_zh: 以可移植的 C++ 引擎重新实现 BioWare 的 Aurora 引擎及其后续衍生版本，在使用者已安装的游戏数据上运行，目标涵盖从《无冬之夜》到《龙腾世纪 II》的九款游戏。资源管理、大量 Aurora 文件格式、图形和声音均已实现，所有目标游戏都能在可自由飞行的旁观模式下显示部分游戏内场景。README 说明尚未实现正常的游戏流程，因此这是一个早期阶段的引擎案例，而非可以替代原版游玩的实现。
requirements: The reviewed master snapshot (2026-09-04) still reports version 0.0.6; release v0.0.6 dates from 2020-08-03, and the repository calls itself pre-pre-alpha. README targets Neverwinter Nights 1 and 2, Knights of the Old Republic I and II, Jade Empire, Sonic Chronicles: The Dark Brotherhood, The Witcher, and Dragon Age: Origins and II; the 0.0.6 notes report a partially playable KotOR tutorial and partial menus in other games.

Needs the user’s own copy of a supported game, fully installed or copied to disk; xoreos reads its resources from that directory, and the repository contains no game files. There is no launcher GUI: a game starts from the command line with its path, or with a target section that xoreos saves in its xoreos.conf configuration file.

Builds use CMake 3.1+ with C++17, or autotools, against the libraries in BUILDDEP.md, including Boost 1.53+, SDL2 2.0.4+, OpenGL 2.1+, FreeType 2, OpenAL Soft and the MAD, Vorbis, FAAD, Xvid and libvpx codecs. README points to release binaries for Windows, Mac OS X and GNU/Linux on 32- and 64-bit x86; the FAQ says mobile devices lack an OpenGL ES renderer and console ports are highly unlikely.

CI builds with autotools and CMake on Linux (GCC and Clang), macOS and Windows (MSVC) and runs the Google Test unit tests, which cover Aurora file formats and shared engine code. No comparison with the original executables is published, and per-game progress is tracked on the project wiki.

README and COPYING apply GPL-3.0-or-later; doc/ adds GPLv2, LGPL-2.1 and font licence texts for incorporated components, and the games keep their publishers’ rights. CONTRIBUTING.md forbids AI-generated code, comments and commit messages.

name: Ghidra MCP Server (bethington)
description_en: A Ghidra GUI plugin, standalone headless server and Python MCP bridge exposing a 209-tool catalog: decompilation, cross-references, renaming, typing, structures, comments and batch edits, plus P-code emulation, live debugging through Ghidra’s TraceRmi framework, shared Ghidra Server repository and version-control operations, and hash-based transfer of function documentation between binary versions. The bridge loads three tool groups on connect and lets the model search for and load the rest, while naming and type conventions are enforced in the tool layer. Its NOTICE says it began as a derivative of LaurieWired’s GhidraMCP in August 2025 and has since been substantially rewritten and extended.
description_zh: 由 Ghidra 图形界面插件、独立无界面服务器和 Python MCP 桥接组成，提供含 209 个工具的目录：反编译、交叉引用、重命名、类型设定、结构体、注释与批量编辑，另有 P-code 模拟执行、经 Ghidra TraceRmi 框架的实时调试、共享 Ghidra Server 仓库与版本控制操作，以及基于哈希在不同版本二进制之间迁移函数文档。桥接在连接时只加载三组工具，其余由模型按需搜索并加载；命名与类型规范在工具层强制执行。其 NOTICE 说明，项目于 2025 年 8 月由 LaurieWired 的 GhidraMCP 衍生而来，此后已大幅重写和扩展。
requirements: The reviewed pin is the default dev branch at bridge version 7.0.0 plus unreleased changes; the README calls tagged releases stable, release candidates and main beta, and dev experimental, with tools renamed and merged freely. At review the newest published build was the 7.0.0-rc.3 pre-release of 2026-10-14, which ships the extension zip and bridge wheel, and the newest stable release was v6.0.0 of 2026-07-25. The README says the GUI plugin serves 205 of the 209 tools and the headless server 190, with the debugger tools GUI-only.

The extension loads only in the exact Ghidra version it was built for, Ghidra 12.1.4 at this pin, and needs Java 21; the bridge needs Python 3.10+, with uv recommended. Source builds use Maven 3.9+ or the committed Gradle wrapper, with install guides for Windows, Ubuntu/Debian, macOS and Arch Linux; Python Ghidra scripts need Ghidra’s optional Jython extension, and shared-server work needs a Ghidra Server version compatible with the 12.1 client. Clients connect over stdio or streamable HTTP, and a Docker Compose stack runs the headless server and bridge as two containers.

Users analyse programs imported into their own Ghidra project; the repository ships only two generated PE test fixtures for its regression tiers. Write tools change the project, and script execution, which runs arbitrary Java inside Ghidra, stays off unless GHIDRA_MCP_ALLOW_SCRIPTS is set. The HTTP server binds 127.0.0.1 without authentication by default and refuses a non-loopback bind without GHIDRA_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN, which the Docker stack always requires; GHIDRA_MCP_FILE_ROOT confines file-path endpoints to one directory.

CI builds the extension with Maven against a downloaded Ghidra, runs offline and real-Ghidra Java tests and Python unit and fake-server tests on Linux, and runs Python unit tests on Windows. docs/TESTING.md describes opt-in live tiers that import the fixtures into a running Ghidra and exercise endpoints and a debugger launch, and says the debugger tier is only partly restored. Sub-second responses, 93% fewer API calls through batching and workflows refined across hundreds of functions are the author’s claims.
Apache-2.0; NOTICE credits the original LaurieWired GhidraMCP code, whose copyright remains for any surviving portions. Ghidra, MCP clients, model services and analysed programs keep their own terms.

name: librw: a re-implementation of the RenderWare Graphics engine
description_en: Re-implements a large part of the RenderWare Graphics middleware API as a portable C++ library that reads and writes its DFF model and TXD texture files for PS2, D3D8, D3D9 and Xbox and is meant to convert them between platforms. Direct3D 9 and OpenGL backends render the scenes, while PS2 rendering works only as a test. README names rendering GTA as its use; BSP world files are not supported.
description_zh: 以可移植的 C++ 库重新实现 RenderWare Graphics 中间件 API 的大部分内容，可读写其 PS2、D3D8、D3D9 和 Xbox 平台的 DFF 模型与 TXD 纹理文件，并旨在于各平台格式之间转换。场景由 Direct3D 9 和 OpenGL 后端渲染，PS2 渲染仅作为测试可用。README 称其用途是渲染 GTA 游戏；BSP 世界文件尚不支持。
requirements: The reviewed master snapshot dates from 2026-08-26; CMake reports version 0.0.1 and the repository has no tagged releases. README calls librw a re-implementation of RenderWare graphics, “or a good part of it”: not all pre-instanced PS2 DFFs load and BSP is unsupported, and TODO lists morphing, several pipelines and PS2 rendering as open. ARCHITECTURE.MD says some design decisions follow the original RW and others are the author’s own.

As a library, librw needs no particular original files: applications hand it RenderWare DFF models and TXD texture dictionaries, such as those of the games they render. The repository ships no game data, but its demo tools include four small DFF sample models whose provenance it does not state.

Builds use premake5 (a premake5.exe is committed) or CMake 3.8+, selecting a NULL, GL3 or D3D9 platform and, for GL3 (OpenGL 2.1+ or ES 2.0+), GLFW, SDL2 or SDL3 for windowing. premake targets Windows x86/amd64, Linux x86/amd64/ARM and PS2, and the CMake files add PS2 and Nintendo Switch toolchains; a skeleton application framework with bundled Dear ImGui accompanies the demo tools.

The GitHub Actions workflow builds and packages 14 configurations: Windows D3D9, GL3 and null, macOS and Ubuntu GL3 and null, PS2 in a ps2dev container and Switch in a devkitPro container. It runs no tests, and the repository has no test suite or comparison with original RenderWare output.
LICENSE applies MIT to librw; the bundled Dear ImGui and ImGuizmo code carries its own licence files, and RenderWare itself and any game assets keep their owners’ rights.

name: awesome-game-decompilations
description_en: A single-README list of about 480 game decompilation, recompilation and disassembly projects, grouped by console from the NES and Game Boy to the Xbox 360, PC and mobile, with a large uncategorised section. Each entry is a game title linked to its project, mostly on GitHub, and entries with AI involvement are marked with a warning emoji under the maintainer’s disclosure policy.
description_zh: 以单个 README 维护的游戏反编译、重编译和反汇编项目清单，约 480 项，按主机平台分组，从 NES、Game Boy 到 Xbox 360、PC 和移动平台，另有规模较大的未分类部分。每个条目是链接到对应项目的游戏名，大多指向 GitHub；按维护者的披露政策，有 AI 参与的条目以警告符号标出。
requirements: The reviewed README, committed 2026-10-12, links 481 entries: 214 under 19 console and platform headings and 267 in an Uncategorised section kept for works in progress, while the table of contents and console index are marked under construction. One game can appear under several platforms.

Entries give only a title and a link, mostly to GitHub with a few on GitLab, Codeberg and SourceHut. They state no project type, completion or matching status, original-file requirement or license, and the list mixes decompilations, disassemblies, static recompilations and occasional reimplementations.
The README’s AI disclosure allows projects with AI involvement and marks them with ⚠️; 10 entries carried the mark at review.

The repository holds only README.md, with no license file or contribution guide, so the list states no reuse terms; linked projects and the games they reconstruct keep their own rights. An independent discovery list.

name: Vineflower
description_en: Fernflower-derived decompiler for Java and other JVM languages that continues the ForgeFlower, Fabric and Quiltflower forks, focused on output quality and modern Java, including records, sealed classes, switch expressions and pattern matching through Java 21+. Its command line takes a JAR, ZIP, folder or class file and writes a folder, an archive or console output, with multithreaded decompilation and automatic formatting. It can also be embedded as a library from Maven Central or used in IntelliJ IDEA through a plugin that replaces Fernflower, and the regular release JAR bundles three plugins, including Kotlin support and variable renaming.
description_zh: 源自 Fernflower 的 Java 及其他 JVM 语言反编译器，延续了 ForgeFlower、Fabric 和 Quiltflower 等分支的工作，注重输出质量和对现代 Java 的支持，包括 Java 21+ 的记录、密封类、switch 表达式和模式匹配。其命令行接受 JAR、ZIP、文件夹或 class 文件，可输出到文件夹、归档或控制台，支持多线程反编译和自动格式化。它也可作为 Maven Central 上的库嵌入使用，或通过替换 Fernflower 的插件在 IntelliJ IDEA 中使用；常规发布 JAR 内置三个插件，包括 Kotlin 支持和变量重命名。
requirements: Release at review: 1.12.0, published 2026-04-29 on GitHub and Maven Central (org.vineflower:vineflower). The regular JAR includes the three bundled plugins and the -slim JAR only the decompiler. The reviewed master commit is identical to that tag; pull requests target the develop branches, and develop/1.13.0 was 28 commits ahead.

The README says Vineflower 1.9+ needs Java 11 or newer and 1.11+ needs Java 17 or newer to run; the build uses a Java 17 toolchain with ./gradlew build. The IntelliJ IDEA plugin is a separate Marketplace download.

Inputs are user-supplied JAR, ZIP, folder or class files, with libraries added through -e/--add-external as classpath context. The output comparison on the project website is the project's own; decompiled code is reconstructed and is not the original source.

Apache-2.0. The README calls it a fork of JetBrains' Fernflower, MinecraftForge's ForgeFlower and FabricMC's Fernflower fork and a continuation of Quiltflower; its console entry point keeps Fernflower's org.jetbrains.java.decompiler package.

name: Decompyle++ (pycdc)
description_en: C++ disassembler and decompiler for compiled Python bytecode that aims to support bytecode from any Python version. pycdas prints the disassembly of a .pyc file, and pycdc prints reconstructed Python source to stdout with errors on stderr; both also accept raw marshalled code objects when the Python version is given on the command line. The source carries opcode tables for Python 1.0 through 3.13.
description_zh: 用 C++ 编写的 Python 字节码反汇编器与反编译器，目标是支持任意 Python 版本的字节码。pycdas 输出 .pyc 文件的反汇编结果，pycdc 则把重建出的 Python 源码输出到标准输出，错误信息输出到标准错误；在命令行中指定 Python 版本后，两者也能处理原始的 marshal 代码对象。源码中包含 Python 1.0 至 3.13 的操作码表。
requirements: The project publishes no releases or tags, so it is built from source; the reviewed master commit dates from 2026-04-07. The README makes no per-version completeness claim. The .pyc loader recognizes bytecode up to Python 3.13 but not 3.14, and the regression suite’s compiled samples stop at 3.12: 20 of its 191 samples are for 3.10–3.12, and 39 more are kept as expected failures.

CMakeLists.txt requires CMake 3.12+ and a C++11 compiler, and GCC and Clang builds treat warnings as errors. make check runs the tests on Unix-like systems or MSYS; CI builds and tests on Ubuntu and as 32-bit Visual Studio 2022 builds on Windows, where the executables are kept only as workflow artifacts.

Input .pyc files or marshalled code objects come from the user; recovering them from packaged applications is outside the tool. The README describes no verification of decompiled output, so uncertain regions should be compared with the pycdas disassembly.
GPL-3.0. Recovered source remains subject to the rights of the original program’s owner.

name: Super Mario Odyssey: per-function matching decompilation of the Switch executable
description_en: Reconstructs C++ source for Super Mario Odyssey’s Switch 1.0 main executable and checks each function against the original AArch64 machine code with the shared nx-decomp-tools checker. At the pinned commit its function list marks 18,996 of 74,171 functions matching. The README warns that the build is not a playable game, the repository ships no game assets, and Nintendo libraries such as sead and agl come from open-ead’s separate reconstructions.
description_zh: 为《超级马力欧 奥德赛》Switch 1.0 版主程序重建 C++ 源码，并用共享的 nx-decomp-tools 检查器逐个函数与原始 AArch64 机器码比对。在所审固定提交中，其函数清单将 74,171 个函数中的 18,996 个标为一致。README 提醒构建结果不是可游玩的游戏；仓库不含游戏素材，sead、agl 等任天堂库则来自 open-ead 另行维护的重建项目。
requirements: The reviewed master pin is dated 2026-09-29. README describes a work-in-progress decompilation of Super Mario Odyssey 1.0.0 that recreates a source base from scratch and warns that it will not produce a playable game. The GitHub description says all versions, but setup.py builds only 1.0 and skips 1.0.1, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 as a to-do, and README lists cross-version comparison and 1.3.0’s different optimisation as open work. Functions are matched individually.

Setup needs the user’s own original 1.0 main NSO executable, compressed or not; setup.py accepts only two SHA-256 hashes, converts it to an ELF and checks that result’s hash too. Only the ExeFS is needed, though README notes that RomFS files help cross-reference names. The repository holds no game assets, while data/ carries the function list and address, symbol and string-literal tables for the 1.0 executable; contributors work from Hex-Rays or Ghidra output.

The documented setup is Linux, WSL or macOS, with a VS Code dev container and a Nix flake as alternatives; it needs Python 3.6+, Ninja, CMake 3.13+, ccache, llvm-objdump, a Rust toolchain and the listed Python modules. setup.py downloads prebuilt clang, ld.lld and the viking checker from the project’s tools-cache release v1.2.6, or builds them from source, and fetches LLVM 3.9.1 libc++ headers. Submodules supply open-ead’s sead, agl, eui, NintendoSDK and NEX headers, a musl build and nx-decomp-tools.

tools/check compares every function marked in data/file_list.yml with the original executable. At the pin the list marks 18,996 functions matching, 47 with minor and 252 with major differences and 54,876 not decompiled, and decomp.dev’s report for the commit gives the same 25.61% of functions, or 15.77% of code bytes. CI fetches the executable through a repository secret, builds and requires the check to pass, and separately checks that every header compiles on its own.

GitHub detects no license and the pinned root has no license file, so no reuse terms are stated; submodules and Nintendo content keep their own terms. A workflow adds an ai label to new pull requests from authors who, in its own words, usually use AI.

name: Droid ASC
description_en: Python Android decompiler that answers queries directly against an APK instead of first unpacking and indexing it. It probes compressed DEX entries in place, uses the layout that the R8 compiler’s constant relocation and instruction deduplication leave behind to search string, type, method and field references across DEX files, and for a requested class rebuilds a minimal, self-consistent DEX in memory that a bundled copy of Androguard’s decompiler turns into Java. The droidasc CLI and Tk GUI list classes, decompile single classes, decode AndroidManifest.xml and find subclasses or interface implementations; the README presents it as a lightweight back end for agents analyzing many APKs.
description_zh: 用 Python 编写的 Android 反编译器，直接对 APK 执行查询，而不必先解包并建立索引。它在压缩的 DEX 条目中就地探测数据，利用 R8 编译器的常量重定位和指令去重所留下的布局，跨 DEX 文件搜索字符串、类型、方法和字段引用；对指定的类，则在内存中重建一个最小且自洽的 DEX，再由内置的 Androguard 反编译器副本转换为 Java 代码。droidasc 命令行和 Tk 图形界面可列出类、反编译单个类、解码 AndroidManifest.xml，并查找子类或接口实现；README 将其定位为供智能体批量分析 APK 的轻量后端。
requirements: Latest release at review: dev-0.1.2-post2, published 2026-10-14 without binary assets and matching PyPI’s droidasc 0.1.2.post2; the reviewed main commit adds only two README notes. The project began in June 2026. The README now says it has been rewritten 1:1 in Rust as the separate rust_ASC repository, which adds full-APK decompilation and is to be updated in sync.

Install with pip install droidasc or from source. pyproject.toml requires Python 3.10+ with axml and mutf8, and CI runs the unit, integration and GUI suites and gates performance regressions on Ubuntu with Python 3.11 and 3.12. APK and DEX inputs come from the user; the README’s benchmark APKs are not in the repository, and the DEX inside the test fixture holds only AndroidX, Kotlin and Material Components library classes.

Speed and memory figures are author-reported: on Telegram X, WhatsApp, Grab and Lark APKs of 59–352 MB with 10 threads, the README reports string-reference searches 62–302× and single-class decompilation 38–304× faster than JADX while using 36–141 MB, and says JADX ran out of memory on the largest. Java output comes from the bundled Androguard decompiler, one class at a time. The README targets agent workflows but describes no MCP server; agents call the CLI or Python package.
Apache-2.0; the bundled dadguard package carries Androguard code, which is also Apache-2.0. Decompiled code keeps the rights of the app’s owner.

name: APKEditor
description_en: Command-line APK editor built on ARSCLib that decodes an APK's binary resources and DEX into editable JSON, XML or smali and rebuilds a package from them, independent of aapt and aapt2. It also merges split bundles such as XAPK, APKM and APKS, refactors obfuscated resource names, and prints package information.
description_zh: 基于 ARSCLib 的命令行 APK 编辑器，不依赖 aapt 与 aapt2，可将 APK 的二进制资源与 DEX 解码为可编辑的 JSON、XML 或 smali 并重新构建安装包。还能合并 XAPK、APKM、APKS 等分包，还原被混淆的资源名称，并打印包信息。
requirements: Runs as a single executable JAR on a Java runtime; the Gradle build targets Java 8 source and target compatibility, and the README notes large inputs may need an increased -Xmx heap to avoid an OutOfMemoryError.

Operates on APK files the user supplies; the README documents decoding to XML source for un-obfuscated packages only, and rebuilding a package is distinct from recovering original Java source. Apache-2.0 licensed.

name: avatar²
description_en: Python framework from EURECOM's S3 group that orchestrates emulators, debuggers and physical devices for dynamic analysis of embedded firmware. An analysis script declares targets, such as a modified QEMU, PANDA, Unicorn, a gdbserver or an OpenOCD or J-Link debug probe, then a memory layout whose ranges can forward accesses from one target to another, and an execution plan. Execution and register or memory state can move between targets, so firmware can run in an emulator while its peripheral accesses go to the real device.
description_zh: 由 EURECOM S3 小组开发的 Python 框架，可协调模拟器、调试器和物理设备，对嵌入式固件进行动态分析。分析脚本先声明目标（如修改版 QEMU、PANDA、Unicorn、gdbserver，或 OpenOCD、J-Link 调试探针），再定义内存布局（其中的内存区间可把访问从一个目标转发到另一个目标）和执行计划。执行过程以及寄存器、内存状态可在目标之间转移，从而让固件在模拟器中运行，同时把外设访问转发给真实设备。
requirements: Latest release at review: 1.4.7, uploaded to PyPI on 2022-02-10 and tagged v1.4.7; GitHub lists no release pages. The reviewed main commit, from 2024-10-23, is nine commits ahead of that tag, adding ARMv7-M interrupt forwarding and hardware-runner plugins and pinning Unicorn 2.0.1.post1.

The core installs with pip; CI tests Python 3.7-3.9 on Ubuntu 20.04. Target endpoints are separate: python -m avatar2.installer or the targets/build_*.sh scripts build the avatar-qemu fork and PANDA, with build scripts provided for Ubuntu 20.04 only, and the scripts add a restricted deb-src repository to /etc/apt/sources.list, so the README suggests a VM or container. A Dockerfile generator builds images with selected endpoints.

An analysis needs the user's own firmware image and, for hybrid setups, the physical device reachable through a gdbserver, an OpenOCD script or a Segger J-Link probe. Architecture definitions cover ARM, including Cortex-M3 and big-endian variants, MIPS and x86/x86-64. The analyst writes the memory layout, forwarding rules and execution plan in Python.
Apache-2.0; avatar-qemu and PANDA come from separate repositories with their own licenses. The README lists research publications that describe, use or extend the framework.

name: cwe_checker
description_en: Static analyzer from Fraunhofer FKIE that searches binary executables, mainly Linux and Unix ELF files, for code paths matching Common Weakness Enumeration bug classes such as buffer overflows, use-after-free and double free, NULL pointer dereferences, format strings and integer overflows. Ghidra disassembles the binary into a common intermediate representation on which its checks run, from simple heuristics to abstract-interpretation data-flow analysis, so it covers the CPU architectures Ghidra supports, including x86, ARM, MIPS and PowerPC. Warnings are printed as text or JSON, and a bundled Ghidra script annotates them in the disassembly for manual review.
description_zh: Fraunhofer FKIE 开发的静态分析工具，在二进制可执行文件（主要是 Linux 和 Unix 的 ELF 文件）中查找符合通用缺陷枚举（CWE）漏洞类别的代码路径，例如缓冲区溢出、释放后使用与重复释放、空指针解引用、格式化字符串和整数溢出。它先由 Ghidra 把二进制反汇编为统一的中间表示，再在其上运行从简单启发式到基于抽象解释的数据流分析等各类检查，因此适用于 Ghidra 支持的 CPU 架构，包括 x86、ARM、MIPS 和 PowerPC。告警以文本或 JSON 输出，随附的 Ghidra 脚本可把告警标注在反汇编中，便于人工复核。
requirements: Latest stable release at review: v0.9, published 2024-08-20 as a source release. Prebuilt Docker images on the GitHub container registry are tagged latest (master), stable and v0.9 and are x86 only, although the image can be built natively on ARM. The reviewed master commit is 97 commits after v0.9; CHANGES.md labels it 0.10-dev, with a rewritten P-Code extractor and support for more architectures through a Ghidra update, while the crate manifests still say 0.9.0 and the online documentation covers the stable version.

Local builds need Rust 1.82+ and a Ghidra 10.2+ installation, which make all locates when GHIDRA_PATH is omitted; the Docker image builds on a Ghidra 11.2.1 headless base, and a Nix flake is also provided. Checks are tuned through src/config.json. Analysis of Linux loadable kernel modules, which runs a subset of the checks with its own configuration, and of bare-metal binaries, which needs a per-device configuration such as the bundled STM32F407VG example, is experimental.

Each run takes one binary supplied by the user. The README warns that both false positives and false negatives are to be expected and keeps the CWE-78 OS command injection check disabled on standard runs, so warnings mark code paths for manual review rather than confirmed vulnerabilities. It is also integrated as a plugin in FACT.
LGPL-3.0; the README notice allows version 3 or later.

name: jnitrace
description_en: Frida-based dynamic-analysis tool that traces an Android app's use of the JNI API, similar to frida-trace or strace but for the Java Native Interface. It logs the JNI calls that native libraries make through the JNIEnv and JavaVM structures, with include and exclude filters, backtraces and optional JSON output for later post-processing. The tracing engine is also published as a separate jnitrace-engine library.
description_zh: 基于 Frida 的动态分析工具，用于跟踪 Android 应用对 JNI API 的调用，类似 frida-trace 或 strace，但面向 Java 本地接口。它记录原生库通过 JNIEnv 与 JavaVM 结构发起的 JNI 调用，支持包含/排除过滤、回溯以及可选的 JSON 输出以便后续处理。其跟踪引擎另以 jnitrace-engine 库形式单独发布。
requirements: Installed from PyPI as jnitrace (setup.py marks version 3.3.1 and Python 3) and runs on a Linux, macOS or Windows host; building from source additionally needs Node.js.

Tracing a target needs an arm, arm64, x86 or x64 Android device running a Frida server, which the README states must provide Frida support greater than 14, with the target package already installed on the device.

Intended for apps the analyst is authorized to inspect. MIT licensed; the repository ships the tool only. The last reviewed upstream commit dates to 2023 and targets the Frida 14-era API. As checked on 2026-10-20, that 2023-04-01 commit is still the master head and the latest release is v3.3.1 from the same day; GitHub’s last recorded push was 2023-07-18, the repository is not archived and the README does not mark it as maintained, superseded or archived.

name: FLARE-VM
description_en: Mandiant FLARE installer that sets up and maintains a Windows virtual machine for reverse engineering and malware analysis. Its PowerShell script uses Boxstarter and Chocolatey to install packages from the separate VM-Packages feed and the Chocolatey community feed, chosen in a GUI or a custom config.xml that also sets environment paths, the taskbar layout and post-install registry, service and path settings. The reviewed default configuration lists 137 packages, among them Ghidra, IDA Free, x64dbg, dnSpyEx, capa, FLOSS, PE-sieve, FakeNet-NG and Wireshark; scripts in its virtualbox folder build, snapshot and export FLARE-VM and REMnux VMs in VirtualBox.
description_zh: Mandiant FLARE 团队的安装脚本，用于搭建并维护一台面向逆向工程和恶意软件分析的 Windows 虚拟机。其 PowerShell 脚本借助 Boxstarter 和 Chocolatey，从独立的 VM-Packages 软件源和 Chocolatey 社区源安装软件包；软件包可在图形界面中选择，也可通过自定义 config.xml 指定，该文件还可设置环境变量路径、任务栏布局以及安装后的注册表、服务和路径设置。所审阅的默认配置列出 137 个软件包，包括 Ghidra、IDA Free、x64dbg、dnSpyEx、capa、FLOSS、PE-sieve、FakeNet-NG 和 Wireshark；virtualbox 目录中的脚本可在 VirtualBox 中构建 FLARE-VM 和 REMnux 虚拟机，并管理和导出其快照。
requirements: Needs a Windows 10 or later virtual machine with PowerShell 5+, at least 60 GB of disk and 2 GB of memory, a username without spaces or special characters and internet access. The README says FLARE-VM should only be installed on a VM and that Windows Updates, Tamper Protection and anti-malware must be disabled on it first; it recommends a snapshot before installation and host-only networking afterward. The installer checks that it is running in a VM and warns on Windows builds other than the tested 19045, 20348 and 26100.

FLARE-VM itself has no releases because its packages download tools from external URLs outside the project's control; the only release, vbox-1.0.0 (2025-08-13), holds Linux executables for some VirtualBox helper scripts, which were tested on Debian 12 with GNOME. Package updates are best effort and untested, failures of individual packages are reported to VM-Packages, and the README suggests a fresh install when updates break. The idapro.vm package needs the user's own IDA Pro installer, and optionally a license file, on the Desktop.
The scripts are Apache-2.0. Per the README's legal notice, every downloaded or installed package keeps its own license terms, which the user must review and accept; installing accepts those terms.

name: B2R2
description_en: Binary analysis framework written in F# for .NET by KAIST's SoftSec Lab. It parses ELF, PE, Mach-O and WebAssembly files, parses, disassembles and lifts instructions into its own IR, recovers control-flow graphs and assembles code; the README's feature table covers x86/x86-64, ARMv7/AArch64, MIPS, PowerPC, RISC-V, SPARC, S390 and other ISAs as well as CIL, EVM, eBPF, WebAssembly and Python bytecode. Its b2r2 launcher starts a readelf-like format scanner, a linear-sweep disassembler, a recursive-descent explorer with a web GUI, an IR and assembly REPL and an assembler.
description_zh: KAIST SoftSec 实验室开发的二进制分析框架，以 F# 编写、运行于 .NET。它可解析 ELF、PE、Mach-O 和 WebAssembly 文件，对指令进行解析、反汇编并提升为自有中间表示，还能恢复控制流图和汇编代码；README 的功能表涵盖 x86/x86-64、ARMv7/AArch64、MIPS、PowerPC、RISC-V、SPARC、S390 等指令集，以及 CIL、EVM、eBPF、WebAssembly 和 Python 字节码。其 b2r2 启动器可调用类似 readelf 的格式扫描器、线性扫描反汇编器、带 Web 图形界面的递归下降式探索工具、面向 IR 与汇编的 REPL 以及汇编器。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.10.1, published 2026-06-17, with BinExplore archives for Linux, macOS and Windows on x64 and arm64; libraries such as B2R2.FrontEnd.API and the B2R2.RearEnd.Launcher .NET tool are on NuGet at 0.10.1. The reviewed main commit (2026-10-17) is 1,231 commits ahead of that tag and still declares 0.10.1.

Building needs the .NET 10 SDK or later, and the projects target net10.0. The README states that the core library has no external dependencies, while System.IO.Hashing, FSharp.Compiler.Service, FParsec, BenchmarkDotNet and Avalonia.FuncUI serve specific components; it presents the APIs as usable from F# and, in principle, other CLI languages, on Linux, macOS, Windows and other .NET platforms.

Input is a user-supplied ELF, PE, Mach-O or WebAssembly file, or a raw byte image loaded with an explicit ISA. The README's feature table gives CFG recovery a full mark only for x86, x86-64 and EVM and a half mark for the other ISAs, lists no lifting, CFG recovery or assembly for TMS320C6000, and notes that some areas are still in progress.
MIT license. The README cites the 2019 NDSS Binary Analysis Research workshop paper describing B2R2 and lists research papers that use or build on it.

name: rz-ghidra
description_en: Rizin plugin that embeds Ghidra's C++ decompiler and Sleigh disassembler, so no Java Ghidra installation is needed. Its pdg commands decompile the current function, optionally side by side with offsets or as XML or JSON, can return the output to Rizin as comments, and list the loaded Sleigh languages; config variables control formatting and can override the auto-detected Sleigh language. The decompiler draws on Rizin's loaded binary, types and comments, and an optional plugin brings it into the Cutter GUI.
description_zh: Rizin 插件，内嵌 Ghidra 的 C++ 反编译器和 Sleigh 反汇编器，因此无需安装 Java 版 Ghidra。其 pdg 系列命令可反编译当前函数，也可与偏移量并排显示或以 XML、JSON 格式输出，还能把结果作为注释写回 Rizin，并列出已加载的 Sleigh 语言；配置变量可调整输出格式，也可覆盖自动检测到的 Sleigh 语言。反编译器使用 Rizin 已加载的二进制、类型和注释；另有可选插件将其接入 Cutter 图形界面。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.9.0, published 2026-06-21 as a source tarball, which its notes declare compatible with the Rizin v0.9.x series and which updates the Ghidra code it uses to 12.1. The reviewed dev commit, from 2026-10-12, tracks Rizin's dev branch and is 3 commits ahead of and 5 behind that release tag. The README says version numbers do not guarantee Rizin compatibility and points distributors to rz-* tags instead.

Builds with CMake against an installed Rizin after fetching the rizinorg/ghidra and pugixml submodules. The install step is required because it installs the Sleigh files; the rz-pm package sets them up automatically. The Cutter plugin needs Cutter installed from source and -DBUILD_CUTTER_PLUGIN=ON. CI builds on Debian Bullseye, Arch Linux and Windows.
Decompilation works on binaries loaded and analyzed in Rizin, for architectures whose Sleigh specifications are installed; output is Ghidra decompiler output and needs analyst review.

LGPL-3.0-or-later, which the README notes is stricter than Ghidra's own license; the decompiler sources come from the separate rizinorg/ghidra fork. Its test binaries are built from C sources in the repository.

name: AsmResolver
description_en: C# library for reading, modifying and rebuilding Portable Executable files, covering both native Windows images and images with .NET metadata. It offers three levels of abstraction: raw headers and sections (PEFile); interpreted data directories such as imports, exports, TLS, exceptions, debug data and Win32 resources (PEImage); and a System.Reflection-like model of .NET assemblies and modules with managed, native and dynamic method bodies. It also extracts files from AppHost/single-file bundles, supports ReadyToRun images and reads PDB and Portable PDB symbols without DIA, and upstream designs it to stay robust against malformed or obfuscated binaries.
description_zh: 用于读取、修改和重建 PE（可移植可执行）文件的 C# 库，既支持 Windows 原生映像，也支持带 .NET 元数据的映像。它提供三个抽象层次：原始文件头和节区（PEFile）；导入、导出、TLS、异常、调试信息和 Win32 资源等数据目录的解析结果（PEImage）；以及类似 System.Reflection 的 .NET 程序集和模块模型，涵盖托管、原生和动态方法体。它还能从 AppHost／单文件捆绑包中提取文件，支持 ReadyToRun 映像，无需 DIA 即可读取 PDB 和 Portable PDB 符号；上游的设计目标是在面对格式异常或经过混淆的二进制时保持稳健。
requirements: Release at review: v6.0.1, published 2026-07-25 on GitHub and NuGet; the reviewed master commit is one contributing-guide commit ahead. Nightly builds come from a separate NuGet feed. Version 6.0 changed the API, and upstream publishes a guide for migrating from v5.x.

Distributed as layered NuGet packages: AsmResolver, AsmResolver.PE.File, AsmResolver.PE, AsmResolver.PE.Win32Resources, AsmResolver.DotNet, AsmResolver.DotNet.Dynamic and AsmResolver.Symbols.Pdb. The libraries target .NET Framework 3.5, 4.6.2 and 4.7.2, .NET Standard 2.0 and 2.1, .NET Core 3.1 and .NET 6, 8, 9 and 10, and the README lists Windows, Unix-like systems, Mono and NixOS. Building uses the .NET SDK; the full test suite needs additional .NET runtimes, plus Mono and Wine on macOS and Linux.

It is a library without a GUI or a C# decompiler: users write .NET code against its API and supply their own PE files or .NET assemblies. Modified or rebuilt images still have to be checked by running them.
MIT license. The test resources are purpose-built sample binaries. Robustness against malformed or obfuscated binaries is an upstream design goal.

name: DecompilerServer
description_en: Stdio MCP server built on the ICSharpCode.Decompiler engine that lets agents load managed .NET assemblies, including a Unity game's Assembly-CSharp.dll located from its game directory, then search symbols, string literals and attributes, read decompiled C# or IL, and trace callers, callees, usages and inheritance. Several assemblies stay loaded under aliases, so an agent can compare two versions structurally or diff individual method bodies, the README's example being RimWorld mod porting. Modding-oriented tools generate Harmony patch skeletons, detour stubs and transpiler anchor suggestions as text from the inspected members.
description_zh: 基于 ICSharpCode.Decompiler 引擎的 stdio MCP 服务器，智能体可借此加载托管 .NET 程序集（包括从游戏目录中定位到的 Unity 游戏 Assembly-CSharp.dll），继而搜索符号、字符串字面量和特性，阅读反编译得到的 C# 或 IL，并追踪调用方、被调用方、使用位置和继承关系。多个程序集可以用别名同时保持加载，便于智能体对两个版本做结构比较或逐个比对方法体，README 举的例子是 RimWorld 模组移植。面向模组开发的工具还能根据所查看的成员，以文本形式生成 Harmony 补丁骨架、绕行存根和 Transpiler 锚点建议。
requirements: Reviewed release: v1.4.0, published 2026-10-01; its tag points at the reviewed main commit. Release assets are framework-dependent single-file executables for Windows x64, macOS arm64 and x64, and Linux x64 and arm64 that need the .NET 10 runtime; building from source needs the .NET 10 SDK. The server speaks MCP over stdio, with README setup for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code/Copilot and Codex, and an optional script installs a locally signed build and the bundled decompiler-mcp skill for Codex on macOS.

Users supply the managed .NET assemblies to inspect, such as a game's Assembly-CSharp.dll or a third-party library; the repository contains only its own test libraries, and the README notes that native libraries do not load. Loaded aliases are registered in LocalApplicationData/DecompilerServer/contexts.json and restored on demand, and at most four contexts stay resident by default (DECOMPILER_MAX_LOADED_CONTEXTS changes the limit).

Inspection tools carry the MCP readOnlyHint annotation; loading, unloading, context selection, decompiler settings and cache tools change server state. The patch, stub and wrapper generators return source text and do not modify the loaded assemblies. Responses are compact by default; DECOMPILER_RESPONSE_MODE=extended restores the earlier response fields.
The v1.4.0 release notes report 238 passing Release tests, and the release workflow builds and runs the test suite before publishing assets; these are project-reported results. MIT.

name: Gepetto
description_en: IDA Pro plugin that sends Hex-Rays pseudocode to a hosted or local language model the user selects, to explain a function, comment it or propose new variable and function names, which the user picks from before they are applied. A chat console inside IDA also lets the model call tools that read disassembly, decompilation, cross-references, strings and types, rename and comment the database and run Python. The README warns that these general-purpose models may well be wrong and asks users to treat every result critically.
description_zh: IDA Pro 插件，把 Hex-Rays 伪代码发送给使用者选定的托管或本地大模型，用于解释函数、添加注释或提出新的变量名与函数名，由使用者勾选后再应用。IDA 内的对话控制台还允许模型调用工具，读取反汇编、反编译结果、交叉引用、字符串和类型，对数据库进行重命名和注释，并运行 Python。README 提醒这些通用模型很可能出错，要求使用者审慎对待每一个结果。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is 38 commits after the v1.5.1 release of 2025-11-19, while ida-plugin.json and pyproject.toml still declare version 1.5.0. The README requires IDA Pro 7.6 or later with the Hex-Rays decompiler. Installation uses Hex-Rays’ hcli plugin command, or copies gepetto.py and the gepetto folder into the IDA plugins directory and installs requirements.txt into IDA’s Python; pyproject.toml asks for Python 3.10+.

Each request sends the current function’s pseudocode, and in the chat console whatever the tools return, to the selected provider. Built-in providers include Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Together, Novita AI, Kluster.ai, DeepSeek and OpenRouter with the user’s own API keys, which the README notes are usually paid, plus local Ollama or LM Studio models. Further providers load as drop-in Python files or entry-point packages, which the README warns execute arbitrary code when IDA starts.

The chat console, chosen as Gepetto in IDA’s input bar, offers the model 22 tools: reading disassembly, bytes, pseudocode, cross-references, imports, symbols, strings, structures and search results; declaring C types; renaming functions, globals and local variables; setting comments; and run_python, which executes model-supplied Python inside IDA with no confirmation step. Its system prompt tells the model to carry out requested changes without asking. The Explain, Comment and Auto-rename menu actions work on one function, and Auto-rename lists the proposed names so the user selects which to apply; two actions the README does not describe, Generate C Code and Generate Python Code, save a model-written rewrite of the function to a file.

Repository tests use pytest with Hex-Rays’ idapro library and open a bundled manalyze.exe build, from the author’s Manalyze PE analyser, as a fixture; no CI workflow is published. The README’s before-and-after screenshot and its observation that renaming works better after an explanation are the author’s.

GPL-3.0 per LICENSE and ida-plugin.json; IDA Pro, the Hex-Rays decompiler and model services keep their own licences and terms. The README credits Kaspersky with initial funding and HarfangLab as the current backer.

name: GhidrAssistMCP
description_en: Ghidra extension that runs an MCP server inside Ghidra over streamable HTTP and legacy SSE, with 100 explicitly named tools (93 enabled by default) for pseudocode, disassembly, P-code, control-flow and call graphs, cross-references, strings, imports and exports, plus renaming, retyping, comments and structure inference. Since version 3.0.0 the server starts with the project manager, so agents can create, open, save and close projects and open programs before a CodeBrowser exists, while one shared server tracks whichever CodeBrowser window has focus. Six program resource templates, seven analysis prompts and a bundled script for running the server under analyzeHeadless complete the package.
description_zh: 在 Ghidra 内运行 MCP 服务器的 Ghidra 扩展，通过 streamable HTTP 和旧版 SSE 提供 100 个名称明确的工具（默认启用 93 个），涵盖伪代码、反汇编、P-code、控制流图与调用图、交叉引用、字符串、导入表和导出表，以及重命名、修改类型、注释和结构体推断。自 3.0.0 版起，服务器随项目管理器一同启动，智能体在 CodeBrowser 尚未打开时即可创建、打开、保存和关闭项目并打开程序；同一个共享服务器会跟踪当前获得焦点的 CodeBrowser 窗口。扩展另附六个程序资源模板、七个分析提示词，以及在 analyzeHeadless 下运行服务器的脚本。
requirements: Ghidra 12.0 or 12.1 Public running on Java 25 or newer; extension zips are specific to one Ghidra version. Release 3.0.0 (2026-10-09), whose tag is the reviewed commit, publishes a zip for Ghidra 12.1; installation goes through File → Install Extensions, and source builds use the bundled Gradle wrapper with Java 25 and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR. The server listens on localhost:8080 by default, with streamable HTTP at /mcp (MCP 2025-11-25) and legacy SSE at /sse (2024-11-05); the Java MCP SDK 2.0.1, Jetty and Jackson are bundled under private package names.

Programs come from the user's own Ghidra project or imports; the extension supplies no target binaries. Headless mode runs the bundled GAMCPStartServerScript.java inside analyzeHeadless against the loaded program, with wait=true to keep the session open and a completion_file option to end it; the project lifecycle tools need the GUI project manager.

Write tools change the program or project, including names, types, comments, structures, disassembly, analysis options and saves, and read and write tools carry separate MCP annotations. import_file, export_program and the five Ghidra script tools are disabled by default; a headless agent_lab profile enables sandbox-local program export while arbitrary-path import and scripts stay disabled. The README describes no client authentication; the server rejects browser requests whose Origin header is not allowed.

The project's modernization review reports 90 passing tests in buildExtension test runs against Ghidra 12.0 and 12.1, and a live Ghidra 12.1 smoke test on 2026-10-09 that predates the four project-control tools; these are project-reported. MIT. The repository moved from jtang613/GhidrAssistMCP, and its README recommends the author's GhidrAssist client.

name: dewolf
description_en: Research decompiler from Fraunhofer FKIE, developed with Singapore's DSO National Laboratories between 2019 and 2021, that runs as a Binary Ninja plugin and starts from Binary Ninja's Medium Level IL. A pipeline of preprocessing, SSA, data-flow and control-flow stages restructures code following the DREAM/DREAM++ approach and emits C-like output. Results appear in a Binary Ninja dock widget, or decompile.py prints or writes them for a whole binary or one named function in batch use.
description_zh: 由 Fraunhofer FKIE 与新加坡 DSO 国家实验室在 2019 至 2021 年合作研发的研究型反编译器，以 Binary Ninja 插件形式运行，并以 Binary Ninja 的中级中间语言（Medium Level IL）为起点。它通过预处理、SSA、数据流和控制流等阶段组成的流水线，按照 DREAM/DREAM++ 方法重建控制结构，输出类 C 代码。结果可在 Binary Ninja 的停靠窗口中查看，也可在批量场景下用 decompile.py 对整个二进制或指定函数进行反编译，并输出到终端或文件。
requirements: Release at review: v2026.7.11, published 2026-07-11 by the project's automatic release workflow; the reviewed main commit is that release, and plugin.json declares the same version and lists Windows, Linux and macOS.

Needs Python 3.10+, a separately licensed Binary Ninja (the README asks for the latest stable release, at least 3.4; plugin.json sets minimum build 4271) with its Python API installed in the same environment, and astyle for indentation; libgraph-easy-perl is needed only for ASCII graph output. The plugin is installed by cloning it into Binary Ninja's plugin folder and installing requirements.txt, which pulls the project's dewolf-logic and dewolf-idioms packages from Git.
Settings made in the Binary Ninja GUI do not apply to decompile.py, which reads a config.json in the plugin folder instead; decompiler/util/default.json lists every option.

The README calls dewolf a research prototype that is not optimized for production use and warns of bugs or decompilation failures on real-world binaries. Its tests compile C sample sources and keep GNU coreutils executables under tests/coreutils/binaries as fixtures; CI builds a Docker image around a Binary Ninja archive and license supplied from repository secrets.
LGPL-2.1 (the plugin.json notice allows any later version).

name: Dembrandt
description_en: Node.js CLI that renders a website in Playwright-driven Chromium or Firefox and reads computed styles from the DOM to extract its design system: logo, color roles with the evidence behind each pick, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion, breakpoints and component styles such as buttons and inputs. Results export as W3C design tokens (DTCG), Tailwind v4 or shadcn/ui themes, DESIGN.md, an HTML report or a brand-guide PDF, alongside WCAG contrast checks on real DOM pairs and a CI drift gate against a committed baseline. It also runs as an MCP server for agent clients.
description_zh: Node.js 命令行工具，通过 Playwright 驱动 Chromium 或 Firefox 渲染网站，并从 DOM 读取计算样式来提取其设计系统：标志、附带判定依据的颜色角色、字体排版、间距、边框、阴影、动效、断点，以及按钮、输入框等组件样式。结果可导出为 W3C 设计令牌（DTCG）、Tailwind v4 或 shadcn/ui 主题、DESIGN.md、HTML 报告或品牌指南 PDF，还能对页面中实际的前景与背景组合做 WCAG 对比度检查，并在 CI 中与已提交的基线比较、拦截设计漂移。它也能作为 MCP 服务器供智能体客户端调用。
requirements: Release at review: v0.39.2, published 2026-10-11 on GitHub and npm; the reviewed main commit is ten README, MCP-registry and Action-metadata commits ahead. SECURITY.md describes the project as pre-1.0, with fixes only for the latest 0.x release.

Requires Node.js 18+ and a one-time dembrandt install-browser step, because playwright-core ships no browser; Linux and CI hosts also need Playwright's system libraries, and Docker or CI containers may need --no-sandbox. The experimental --ai brand-color model needs the optional onnxruntime-node package. The MCP server starts with npx dembrandt mcp, and a separate GitHub Action wraps the drift gate.

Input is a live URL, rendered at 1920x1080 by default or 390x844 with --mobile; crawls merge several pages found from navigation links or from sitemap.xml after a robots.txt check. The README's limitations: dark mode needs --dark-mode, canvas/WebGL sites cannot be analyzed, some dynamically loaded content and hover or focus states can be missed, and JavaScript-heavy sites need hydration time. Pages behind a sign-in can be reached with the user's own cookies or an interactive login.

MIT. The README limits intended use to design systems you own or may analyze, on sites whose terms permit automated access, and asks users not to reproduce third-party brand identities, logos or trademarks. The optional --key flag uploads each run's snapshot to the vendor's hosted Dembrandt App, which is in beta.

name: Android Reverse Engineering Skill
description_en: Claude Code plugin and agent skill that drives jadx and Fernflower/Vineflower to decompile Android APK, XAPK, JAR and AAR files and document their HTTP APIs. A fingerprint pass first identifies the app's framework, HTTP stack, obfuscation level and native libraries, then shell scripts extract endpoints and authentication patterns across Retrofit, OkHttp, Volley, Ktor and Apollo/GraphQL, trace call flows from UI down to the network layer, and rebuild original Kotlin class names from the metadata R8 leaves behind. It installs through the bundled Claude Code marketplace, and its scripts also run standalone with a /decompile slash command.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件及智能体技能，驱动 jadx 与 Fernflower/Vineflower 反编译 Android 的 APK、XAPK、JAR 和 AAR 文件并记录其 HTTP 接口。它先用指纹步骤识别应用的框架、HTTP 栈、混淆程度和原生库，再通过 shell 脚本在 Retrofit、OkHttp、Volley、Ktor 和 Apollo/GraphQL 等栈中提取接口与鉴权特征，追踪从界面到网络层的调用链，并利用 R8 无法剥除的元数据还原原始的 Kotlin 类名。技能通过自带的 Claude Code marketplace 安装，其脚本也可独立运行，并提供 /decompile 斜杠命令。
requirements: A Claude Code client with plugin/skill support; install by adding SimoneAvogadro/android-reverse-engineering-skill as a marketplace and installing the android-reverse-engineering plugin, or from a local clone. The reviewed plugin manifest is version 1.5.0 on the master commit, ahead of the latest GitHub release v1.1.0 (2026-04-27).

The skill runs external tools it does not bundle: Java JDK 17+ and the jadx CLI are required, and Vineflower or Fernflower plus dex2jar are optional for better Java output; a dependency checker and an OS-detecting install helper are provided. Bash scripts are the primary path, with experimental PowerShell equivalents for Windows.

Users supply the Android packages to analyze; the repository ships no app files. Work is static decompilation, API documentation, call-flow tracing and Kotlin name recovery; the author reports roughly complete recovery of the Repository/ViewModel/UseCase classes on a typical app, which is a project-reported figure.

Apache-2.0 for the skill; the decompilers and other driven tools keep their own licenses. The README limits use to lawful purposes such as authorized security research, interoperability analysis, and malware analysis, and places responsibility on the user.

name: GB Recompiled
description_en: Static recompiler that turns Game Boy and Game Boy Color ROMs into portable C projects: it decodes and analyzes banked LR35902 code, emits C with machine-readable metadata, and links it with a shared SDL2 runtime for video, audio, input, saves and hardware timing. Jump targets that static analysis missed fall back to an interpreter. The repository also carries differential, replay and frame and audio capture tooling, plus a Pokémon Crystal port that builds native features on hooks into the exact ROM.
description_zh: 将 Game Boy 和 Game Boy Color ROM 转换为可移植 C 项目的静态重编译器：它解码并分析分 bank 的 LR35902 代码，生成 C 代码及机器可读的元数据，再与共享的 SDL2 运行时链接，由运行时处理视频、音频、输入、存档和硬件时序。静态分析未覆盖的跳转目标会回退到解释器执行。仓库还提供差分对比、回放以及画面和音频捕获工具，并附有一个 Pokémon Crystal 移植，借助对特定 ROM 的挂钩实现原生功能。
requirements: The README calls it an experimental recompiler and says successful code generation does not guarantee that every scene runs correctly. ACCURACY.md (generated 2026-07-13) reports 8 of 8 Blargg and 63 of 67 Mooneye test ROMs passing and states that this is not a measure of commercial-game compatibility.

Users supply their own .gb or .gbc ROMs; the repository contains no ROMs. The bundled Crystal Recompiled port is ROM-free: it requires the user's exact US/Europe Rev 1 ROM, checks its hash before writing any ROM-derived output, and keeps generated projects in ignored local or private-cache paths, and its distribution policy forbids releasing ROMs, generated C or extracted assets. That port's alpha is verified end to end only on macOS arm64.

Release v0.1.0 (2026-08-03) ships prebuilt gbrecomp archives for Linux x64, macOS Intel and Apple silicon, and Windows x64; the reviewed main commit is 13 commits ahead, last committed 2026-09-10. Building from source needs CMake 3.20+, Ninja, SDL2 development files and a C11/C++20 compiler, and generated projects build with CMake and Ninja. ANDROID.md documents a separate single-ROM APK workflow.

A CTest suite covers isolated invariants. The README notes that differential mode shares runtime devices with the interpreter, leaving SameBoy comparisons and frame, audio and state captures as separate evidence. The only GitHub workflow builds release archives and smoke-tests them with a generated fixture ROM; an optional manual job checks the Crystal port against a privately held ROM without publishing.

MIT-licensed; the vendored Dear ImGui keeps its own license. The README states no affiliation with Nintendo, and the Crystal port none with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Game Freak or Creatures. The README points contributors and coding agents to AGENTS.md.

name: CodemerxDecompile
description_en: Cross-platform desktop .NET decompiler maintained by the original JustDecompile creators as a continuation of their JustDecompile Engine, built with Mono.Cecil and an Avalonia UI. It loads assemblies into a tree of namespaces, types, members and resolved references, shows decompiled C#, VB.NET or IL with go-to-definition and back/forward navigation, and searches names, types, string literals and instructions. A create-project command exports an assembly as a Visual Studio 2015, 2017 or 2019 project.
description_zh: 由 JustDecompile 原班开发者维护的跨平台桌面 .NET 反编译器，是其 JustDecompile 引擎的延续，基于 Mono.Cecil 并采用 Avalonia 界面。它把程序集加载为由命名空间、类型、成员和已解析引用组成的树，以 C#、VB.NET 或 IL 显示反编译结果，支持转到定义和前进／后退导航，并可搜索名称、类型、字符串字面量和指令。“创建项目”命令可将程序集导出为 Visual Studio 2015、2017 或 2019 项目。
requirements: Release at review: 1.5.0, published 2024-11-18, with portable archives for Windows x64 and ARM64, Linux x64 and macOS ARM64 and x64; the reviewed master commit is from the same day and was still the latest at review. The README says the macOS app is unsigned, so macOS reports it as damaged until its quarantine attribute is removed.

Source builds need the JustDecompileEngine and AvaloniaEdit Git submodules and the .NET 7 SDK: the app targets net7.0, and the release workflow publishes one build per runtime with dotnet publish. The main view uses the engine's C# 7 and Visual Basic 10 language modes.

Release builds send usage events, such as start-up, opening files, changing language, searching and creating projects, to a Matomo cloud server together with a hashed device identifier, the app version and OS details, and they query the GitHub API for newer releases; no setting to turn this off was found in the reviewed source.
AGPL-3.0 for the app and the JustDecompile Engine; Mono.Cecil and AvaloniaEdit are MIT-licensed, per the README and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Input is the user's own .NET assemblies.

name: Reverify
description_en: Python CLI and stdio MCP server that checks a model’s structured claims about a binary, such as bytes or typed values at an offset, strings, imports and exports, instruction mnemonics, emulation results and tested or Z3-proved equivalence, and returns VERIFIED, REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE with the evidence the tools observed. Grounded and refuted results are kept in a per-binary ledger on disk, so a reset or later session resumes from them instead of from a summary, and a reconstruct loop has a model propose claims until an informative set verifies. A separate rollover command replaces context compaction in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode with file hand-offs and fresh sessions.
description_zh: Python 命令行工具和 stdio MCP 服务器，用于检查模型对二进制文件提出的结构化断言，例如某偏移处的字节或类型化数值、字符串、导入与导出、指令助记符、模拟执行结果，以及经测试或经 Z3 证明的等价性，并连同工具实际观察到的证据返回 VERIFIED、REFUTED 或 INCONCLUSIVE。已确证和已驳斥的结果保存在磁盘上按二进制文件划分的台账中，重置后或之后的会话可据此继续，而不依赖摘要；reconstruct 循环则让模型不断提出断言，直至一组有信息量的断言通过验证。另有 rollover 命令，用文件交接和新会话取代 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 或 OpenCode 的上下文压缩。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is 25 commits after the v0.11.0 GitHub release of 2026-09-04; PyPI’s newest version is 0.10.0, and the README’s status section still describes v0.9.0. The core is pure Python with no dependencies, and pyproject.toml declares Python 3.8+. The full extra adds capstone, unicorn, lief and z3-solver, and the angr extra adds the function, call and cross-reference claims, which return INCONCLUSIVE without an engine. The toolkit also parses PE, ELF and Mach-O files, scans byte patterns, decodes Protobuf and TLV data and generates Frida hook scripts.

The verifier and benchmarks need no model. reconstruct calls an OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured by OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_MODEL, orchestrate can drive Claude through the Claude Agent SDK on a Claude Code login, and the MCP server gives any MCP client parsing, disassembly, pattern-scan, semantic, claim, ledger and checkpoint tools. Ledgers and checkpoints are written under .reverify in the working directory. Users supply the binaries to analyse; the repository holds benchmark sources and result records, not target binaries.

reverify rollover install edits the user settings of each supported CLI it finds to add hooks and switch off native compaction, keeping backups and offering uninstall. The README warns that a Claude Code or Codex session not started through its launcher can then grow without limit, and reports one session that reached 909k tokens.

The headline benchmark applies a fixed textbook push rbp; mov rbp, rsp prologue guess, not a live model, to the entry points of system binaries. BENCHMARK.md reports that guess refuted on 69 of 71 Windows 11 files and never falsely verified, and 0 false VERIFIED among 475 known-false claims on 50 Windows binaries; CI repeats both checks on Linux, Windows and macOS and fails on any false VERIFIED. The author notes that 0 of N bounds the error rate rather than proving it zero. These are project-reported results.

MIT. SECURITY.md limits use to authorised work such as malware analysis, CTF, interoperability research and software the user owns or may analyse, and excludes circumventing licensing or copy protection on software the user does not own or license.

name: wxapkg
description_en: Desktop GUI for Windows and macOS, built with Wails, that unpacks WeChat mini-program .wxapkg packages for study. It scans the mini-program package folders of local WeChat 3.x and 4.x installations, including per-user folders, or takes a file or folder the user selects; packages that the PC client stores encrypted are decrypted first. Each packaged file is written to its recorded path, with optional beautification of JSON, HTML and JavaScript.
description_zh: 基于 Wails 构建的 Windows 与 macOS 桌面图形工具，用于解包微信小程序 .wxapkg 包以供研究。它会扫描本机微信 3.x 和 4.x 安装中的小程序包目录（包括各用户目录），也可处理用户选定的文件或目录；PC 客户端以加密形式存储的包会先行解密。包内每个文件都按其记录的路径写出，并可选择美化 JSON、HTML 和 JavaScript 代码。
requirements: Release at review: v2.0.0, published 2026-04-16, with a Windows x64 executable and a macOS universal app; earlier v1.x releases shipped Windows executables only. The reviewed main commit adds only a settings dialog for the default output directory after that release.
The README names Windows and macOS as the supported platforms. Building from source needs Go 1.25 as declared in go.mod, the Wails v2 CLI and npm for the Vue frontend.

Input is .wxapkg packages already on the machine, found in WeChat's package folders or selected manually. The output is the files stored in the package: the reviewed code has no WXML or WXSS decompilation step, so compiled view code stays compiled, and reading mini-program information is still an unchecked item in the README's feature list.

No license file or license declaration was found. The README disclaimer limits use to learning and researching the design ideas and principles in software, with users bearing all legal responsibility; analyze only packages you are authorized to inspect.

name: React Native Decompiler
