description_en: HexHive's static binary rewriter for x64 and aarch64 Linux ELF binaries, which turns a binary into symbolized, reassemblable assembly so instrumentation can be inserted without source code and without heuristics. Bundled passes add a binary-only AddressSanitizer and AFL coverage instrumentation, plus a coarse-grained control-flow-integrity pass on aarch64, and the symbolized assembly can also be edited by hand or by other tools before reassembly. The KRetrowrite variant of the x64 rewriter instruments Linux kernel modules with BASan or kcov for kernel fuzzing.
description_zh: HexHive 开发的静态二进制改写工具，面向 x64 与 aarch64 的 Linux ELF 二进制：将二进制转换为符号化、可重新汇编的汇编代码，从而无需源码、也不依赖启发式规则即可插入插桩。附带的改写模块可添加仅针对二进制的 AddressSanitizer 和 AFL 覆盖率插桩，aarch64 上另有函数入口粗粒度控制流完整性模块；符号化的汇编也可在重新汇编前手工或用其他工具修改。x64 改写器的 KRetrowrite 变体可用 BASan 或 kcov 为 Linux 内核模块插桩，用于内核模糊测试。
requirements: There are no releases or tags, and setup.py says 1.0.0. The reviewed master commit, from 2025-04-26, adjusts an x64 pass added four days earlier that randomizes instruction order within functions; before that, the latest commits, from 2023 and 2024, fixed capstone options and executable stacks on older kernels.

Written in Python 3 (the README names 3.6) with pyelftools, capstone 4.0.2 or later, intervaltree and archinfo pinned to 9.1.11752, which the README says to install with pip rather than from distribution packages. x64 output is reassembled with an ordinary compiler such as gcc, linking -lasan for BASan, or with afl-gcc or afl-clang for AFL coverage; on aarch64, retrowrite -a assembles and links. The README's KRetrowrite setup calls a setup.sh that sits in the demo folders rather than at the repository root.

Inputs are the user's own binaries or kernel modules. Per the README feature table, the x64 rewriter needs position-independent, unstripped binaries from standard compilers and has no C++ support, while the aarch64 rewriter also takes stripped and non-PIE binaries but not kernel modules or C++; --ignore-no-pie and --ignore-stripped skip the checks, to be used with caution. The two architectures use different rewriting algorithms: the IEEE S&P 2020 paper describes the x64 version and a separate HexHive thesis the aarch64 version.

CI runs a SPEC CPU benchmark script on a self-hosted runner, and test scripts clone and rewrite coreutils, SQLite and Debian packages. Demos cover userspace, kernel-module and fuzzing setups; the Docker fuzzing demo bundles fuzz seeds and a patched AFL 2.52b archive but also needs a self-built clang 8, a git bundle of the repository and the separately downloaded LAVA-M corpus, and kernel fuzzing setup downloads about 10 GB of syzkaller VM files.
MIT according to the LICENSE file and README, although GitHub does not recognize the license; capstone is included as a submodule under its own license.

name: House
description_en: NCC Group’s Python and Flask web interface for Frida-based runtime analysis of Android apps, intended to make writing Frida scripts simpler. From a local browser page the analyst can enumerate loaded classes, the classes in a DEX file, class loaders and a class’s methods, then generate and keep tracing scripts for several functions, including ones in dynamically loaded DEX or JAR files. A configurable monitor logs file, HTTP, WebView, SQL, IPC and SharedPreferences calls.
description_zh: NCC Group 基于 Python 和 Flask 开发的网页界面，用于借助 Frida 对 Android 应用进行运行时分析，旨在简化 Frida 脚本的编写。分析者可在本地浏览器页面中枚举已加载的类、DEX 文件中的类、类加载器及某个类的方法，再为多个函数生成并保存跟踪脚本，其中包括动态加载的 DEX 或 JAR 文件中的函数。可配置的监控功能会记录文件、HTTP、WebView、SQL、IPC 和 SharedPreferences 相关调用。
requirements: The reviewed master commit c3641e3 dates from 2020-12-27; the project has no releases or tags. The README says House was tested with Frida 12.8.6 and needs Frida 12.8.3 or later for DEX/JAR hooking, while requirements.txt and the Pipfile leave frida unpinned, so current Frida releases may not work without changes.

Runs from source with Python 3 and pip or pipenv (Flask, Flask-SocketIO 4.3.2, Flask-Login, Jinja2, IPython and frida), serving the interface on 127.0.0.1, port 8000 by default. The README requires a rooted Android device connected over USB with a frida-server matching the local frida-python version, and recommends attaching only one USB device. The Stetho sideload option expects the analyst to place a stetho.jar on the device; it is not bundled.

The repository bundles the README’s demo app test_apk/overloads.apk (package com.ha0k3.overloads) and a small test_apk/dyhello.dex as test fixtures, plus copies of the Ace editor and Bootstrap for the web interface. The monitor’s hook list in scripts/monitor/monitor_hook.json is described as experimental. Intended for apps the analyst is authorized to test.
MIT (NCC Group). Frida and the bundled web libraries keep their own licenses.

name: ABCDE
description_en: Kotlin toolkit for OpenHarmony reverse engineering that parses Ark bytecode (.abc) files, the format HarmonyOS app packages carry in modules.abc, along with HAP packages and resource index (.index) files. Its Compose desktop viewer browses classes, methods, fields, literal arrays, imports and exports and disassembles methods, showing imported modules and resource references in readable form; an experimental mode translates some methods literally into JavaScript, and a CLI dumps class lists and resource indexes. The parsing core is also published as a JVM library, and the separate abc-decompiler builds on a patched fork of it.
description_zh: 使用 Kotlin 编写的 OpenHarmony 逆向工具包，可解析方舟字节码（.abc）文件，即 HarmonyOS 应用包中 modules.abc 的格式，也能解析 HAP 包和资源索引（.index）文件。其基于 Compose 的桌面查看器可浏览类、方法、字段、字面量数组及导入导出信息，并反汇编方法，以可读形式显示导入模块和资源引用；实验性功能可把部分方法直译为 JavaScript，命令行则可导出类列表和资源索引。解析核心也作为 JVM 库发布，另一个项目 abc-decompiler 即基于它的补丁分支。
requirements: No releases or tags are published. The README points to GitHub Actions builds, but no workflow artifacts remained available at review, so the jar has to be built locally; the reviewed main commit of 2025-11-28 is also the latest push. Decompilation to JavaScript is labelled experimental: functions containing try/catch and some instructions, such as the async ones, are unsupported, and the output is a literal, unoptimized translation.

Building needs JDK 17+. ./gradlew :abcdecoder:packageReleaseUberJarForCurrentOS produces a desktop uber-jar for the current OS, while CI's -Puniversal build bundles the Compose runtimes for Linux x64/arm64, Windows x64 and macOS x64/arm64; Gradle resolves dependencies through Aliyun Maven mirrors as well as Maven Central and Google. ./gradlew publishToMavenLocal publishes the core modules for use as io.github.yricky.oh:abcde-jvm, and the abclen size-report and findStr string-search examples show library use.

Inputs are .abc, .hap and resources.index files from the user's own OpenHarmony or HarmonyOS app packages; the repository ships no sample apps. The committed isa.json instruction table is generated from OpenHarmony's arkcompiler_runtime_core isa.yaml, which the updateIsaDefine Gradle property fetches again from Gitee.

CI only builds the universal jar. Most JUnit tests read sample .abc, .hap or resources.index files from the author's local paths or an abcPath environment variable, so only a few encoding and checksum tests run from the repository alone, and no disassembly or decompilation accuracy results are reported.
Apache-2.0; the GUI bundles the JetBrains Mono font under the SIL OFL.

name: Interruptor
description_en: Frida library, taken from the Dexcalibur project, that uses Frida’s Stalker to trace a process’s system calls and print strace-like lines with the calling thread, module and offset, decoded flag values and file paths resolved from descriptors. A trace can be limited to chosen modules and syscalls by name or pattern, started when a given library loads, extended with Interceptor-style per-syscall callbacks, and used to write drcov basic-block coverage files. The README documents Linux and Android on AArch64 and x64; the source also contains AArch32 Linux and macOS arm64 and x64 entry points.
description_zh: 源自 Dexcalibur 项目的 Frida 库，借助 Frida 的 Stalker 跟踪进程的系统调用，输出类似 strace 的记录，标明调用线程、模块与偏移，解码标志位取值，并根据文件描述符还原文件路径。跟踪范围可按名称或模式限定到指定模块和系统调用，可在某个库加载时启动，可附加 Interceptor 风格的逐系统调用回调，还能生成 drcov 基本块覆盖率文件。README 说明支持 AArch64 与 x64 上的 Linux 和 Android；源码中另有 AArch32 Linux 以及 macOS arm64、x64 的入口。
requirements: Latest npm release at review: @reversense/interruptor 1.0.12, published 2023-04-02; the newest GitHub release is v1.0.9 (2023-03-29). The reviewed main commit of 2026-09-23 adds unreleased changes, including refactored arm64 register handling and a preadv2/pwritev2 argument fix, without a version bump, and the README still calls the project a work in progress.

It is used inside the analyst’s own Frida agent: install the npm package, build from source with npm and TypeScript, or load a webpack-bundled per-architecture script. The README says passing a TypeScript agent directly to frida needs Frida 16 or later, and package.json depends on @types/frida-gum ^17.3.0. Android examples attach to a USB device with frida -U; the README warns that the CodeShare quick-start cannot be configured and may fail on obfuscated or multi-threaded apps.

The README’s support list names the Linux syscall API on AArch64 (SVC, with HVC marked work in progress) and x64 (SYSCALL); the AArch32 Linux and macOS factories in the source have no documented status. The agent tracer cannot follow child or multiple processes, and a standalone host-side tracer is marked TODO. Coverage needs an output path the target process can write. CI runs Mocha tests of the Linux AArch32 and arm64 factories on Node 16; no device test results are published. Intended for software the analyst is authorized to inspect.

package.json and the npm metadata declare GPL-3.0-only, but the LICENSE file is x64dbg’s modified GPL-3.0 text, whose added exception concerns x64dbg plugins rather than this project, so GitHub cannot classify it. The README also promotes the separate commercial Dexcalibur Pro.

name: de4js
description_en: Browser-based JavaScript deobfuscator and unpacker, built as a Jekyll site that also works offline as a progressive web app. It detects or lets the user pick an encoding and reverses Dean Edwards' Packer, eval- and array-based obfuscators, some Obfuscator.IO output, JSFuck, JJencode, AAencode, URL encoding, My Obfuscate and WiseLoop, then beautifies and highlights the result, with options to unescape strings, merge strings, recover object paths and evaluate constant expressions. An optional userscript sends the code to the JS Nice service to rename unreadable identifiers.
description_zh: 在浏览器中运行的 JavaScript 反混淆与解包工具，以 Jekyll 网站形式构建，也可作为渐进式 Web 应用离线使用。它可自动识别或由使用者选择编码方式，还原 Dean Edwards 的 Packer、基于 eval 和数组的混淆器、部分 Obfuscator.IO 输出、JSFuck、JJencode、AAencode、URL 编码、My Obfuscate 和 WiseLoop，再对结果进行美化和语法高亮，并提供反转义字符串、合并字符串、恢复对象路径和计算常量表达式等选项。另有可选的用户脚本把代码发送到 JS Nice 服务，为难以阅读的标识符重新命名。
requirements: The repository is archived. The last release, v1.12.0, was published 2021-03-28, and the reviewed master commit from 2021-11-12 adds only dependency updates and a fix to how option values are converted to booleans. The README notes that Obfuscator.IO is always up to date and that automatic tools, this one included, usually do not match its latest version. The homepage, lelinhtinh.github.io/de4js, still served the app through a redirect at review.

No installation is needed for the hosted page. Local copies run with docker-compose, or with Ruby 2.1+, Bundler and the GitHub Pages Jekyll gems, at localhost:4000/de4js/; npm run build also needs workbox-cli to generate the offline service worker. The Wise unpackers load from the NotSoWise git submodule, which must be checked out.

Input is pasted code, an opened file or a script fetched from a URL. The Eval, JSFuck, Array, _Number, Obfuscator.IO and AAencode decoders and the expression-evaluation option run all or part of the input with eval inside a Web Worker, so untrusted code executes in the browser's worker context. The JS Nice userscript sends code to jsnice.org over plain HTTP and does not work offline.
package.json defines no tests and the repository has no automated tests or CI. Whether a decoder succeeds depends on the obfuscator and its version, so output should be checked by reading it.
MIT; the bundled js-beautify, highlight.js, clipboard.js, math.js, Workbox and magic-check code and the AAencode and JJencode decoders keep their own notices.

name: Awesome AI Reverse Engineering
description_en: A single-README, Chinese-language list of AI-assisted reverse-engineering projects, grouped into JavaScript reversing, binary and native analysis, Android and iOS security, and browser automation and traffic analysis. Its entries are mostly MCP servers, agent skills for Claude, Cursor and Codex, and IDE plugins that connect large language models to tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, JADX and Frida. Each row is a project name, a link and a one-line Chinese blurb.
description_zh: 以单个 README 维护的中文清单，收录与 AI 结合的逆向工程项目，按 JavaScript 逆向、二进制与原生分析、Android 与 iOS 安全、浏览器自动化与流量分析分组。条目大多是 MCP 服务器、面向 Claude、Cursor、Codex 的智能体技能，以及把大语言模型接入 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Binary Ninja、JADX、Frida 等工具的 IDE 插件。每一行是项目名称、链接和一句中文说明。
requirements: The reviewed README, from the commit dated 2026-09-29, lists 35 projects across four sections: 11 under JavaScript reversing, 9 under binary and native analysis, 9 under Android and iOS security, and 6 under browser automation and traffic analysis. The list carries a last-updated 2026-04 badge.

Each entry gives only a name, a link to a third-party repository and a short Chinese description, with no stated completion, accuracy or maintenance status. The list mixes MCP servers, agent skills and IDE plugins, and several entries are dual-use — anti-bot/WAF traffic evasion, anti-detection browsers, and APK ad or bloat removal with repackaging — so each linked project must be reviewed at its own source for scope, rights and lawful, authorized use.

The list links out and bundles no tools or target files of its own; the GhidraMCP server and the SimoneAvogadro Android reverse-engineering skill it points to are already in this catalog. Linked projects and the software they analyze keep their own licenses.

The README shows an MIT license badge, but the repository contains only README.md with no LICENSE file, and GitHub detects no license, so the list itself states no clear reuse terms. An independent discovery list.

name: dyld_cache_extract
description_en: macOS application and command-line tool that reads a dyld_shared_cache file from macOS or iOS, shows its header, mappings and image list, and copies one library or every library out to a directory. The CLI offers --info, --extract and --extract-all; the GUI presents the same header details and lets users select images to extract. The README marks the project obsolete and points to the author's dyld-cache-dump.
description_zh: macOS 应用及命令行工具，可读取 macOS 或 iOS 的 dyld_shared_cache 文件，显示其头部、映射区和镜像列表，并将单个或全部动态库复制到指定目录。命令行提供 --info、--extract 和 --extract-all，图形界面显示同样的头部信息，并可选择要提取的镜像。README 已将项目标为过时，并推荐作者的 dyld-cache-dump。
requirements: The README marks the project obsolete and refers users to dyld-cache-dump. The last commits, on 2023-06-12, fix the build for the then-current Xcode and update CI and the README. Releases 0.1.0 (2017-03-06) and 0.1.1 (2017-06-18) each attach a zipped Dyld Cache Extractor app; there is no newer release.

Builds on macOS with Xcode from dyld_cache_extract.xcodeproj, whose schemes cover the CLI tool, the GUI app and the DCE static library; the PIMPL, GitHubUpdates and xcconfig submodules must be initialized. CI builds and analyzes Debug and Release configurations of the CLI and GUI on macos-latest, with tests disabled.

Needs a dyld_shared_cache file from the user's own macOS or iOS system; the repository contains no caches or extracted libraries. The parser reads only the original header fields (magic, mapping and image tables, dyld base address) of a single cache file and copies each image's bytes plus the __LINKEDIT region; the reviewed code has no split sub-cache handling, and support for current macOS or iOS caches is not documented.
MIT license (2016, Jean-David Gadina, XS-Labs).

name: FLARE IDA Pro utilities
description_en: Archived collection of IDAPython plugins and scripts from Mandiant's FLARE team for malware and native-code analysis in IDA Pro. It searches code for precomputed API-name hashes used by shellcode, recovers strings built on the stack (statically, or by emulation with flare-emu in ironstrings), applies function types to structure fields and indirect calls, annotates imports with MSDN function, argument and constant information, and uses idb2pat to generate pattern files from an IDB's functions for building FLIRT signatures. Other scripts track static arguments to functions such as string decoders, link Objective-C selector references to their implementations in Mach-O files, and graft stub implementations of common Windows API imports so that decoding or unpacking code can run under IDA's Bochs emulation.
description_zh: Mandiant FLARE 团队已归档的 IDAPython 插件与脚本合集，用于在 IDA Pro 中分析恶意软件和原生代码。它可在代码中搜索 shellcode 使用的预计算 API 名称哈希，恢复在栈上拼接的字符串（静态分析，或在 ironstrings 中借助 flare-emu 模拟执行），为结构体字段和间接调用应用函数类型，用 MSDN 中的函数、参数和常量信息注释导入函数，并通过 idb2pat 从 IDB 中的函数生成可用于制作 FLIRT 签名的模式文件。其他脚本可追踪字符串解码函数等调用的静态参数，在 Mach-O 文件中把 Objective-C 选择器引用关联到其实现，还能为常见 Windows API 导入函数植入简易实现，使解码或解包代码可在 IDA 的 Bochs 模拟模式下运行。
requirements: The repository is archived and read-only, with no releases or tags; the reviewed master commit of 2024-10-29 is its last. Nothing is packaged: the README says to copy plugins/ into IDA's plugins folder and python/ into IDA's python folder or onto PYTHONPATH, and scripts such as annotate_IDB_MSDN.py, ironstrings.py and code_grafter.py are run through File → Script file.

Needs IDA Pro with IDAPython; the README gives Windows %PROGRAMFILES% paths and names no supported IDA version. The code spans several IDA generations: apply_callee_type was fixed for IDA 7.6 SP1 and idb2pat was ported to Python 3, while stackstrings, argtracker and the decompiler_scripts still use Python 2 syntax, and the StackStrings plugin warns that it only works under Python 2 because of its vivisect dependency. Dialog-based tools import PyQt5; ironstrings, objc2_analyzer and revil_string_decrypt need flare-emu and Unicorn, the decompiler_scripts need the Hex-Rays decompiler, and code_grafter targets IDA's Bochs IDB emulation mode.

Samples and IDBs come from the analyst. The repository bundles sc_hashes.db, a SQLite database of about 50 MB holding precomputed hashes of export names from Microsoft DLLs, with make_sc_hash_db.py to rebuild it from a DLL directory the user chooses. The MSDN annotator expects an MSDN_data directory that is not shipped; the MSDN_crawler script builds it with Python 2.7 from an extracted copy of the MSDN documentation and IDA's tilib.
There are no tests or CI. Behaviour is documented through the README, per-tool READMEs and linked FireEye and Mandiant blog posts.

Apache-2.0 for the repository, while msdn_crawler.py is a GPL-2.0-or-later derivative of the zynamics msdn-crawler. IDA Pro, the Hex-Rays decompiler and Microsoft DLLs and documentation keep their own terms.

name: Binlex
description_en: Binary trait-lexer framework that extracts instructions, basic blocks and functions from executables and emits searchable JSON traits for similarity, hunting and signature work. It models code with a genomics-inspired hierarchy and computes features such as MinHash, TLSH, SHA256, entropy and wildcard byte patterns, so samples can be compared, clustered and turned into signatures at scale. It ships a CLI suite, a Rust API, Python bindings and an IDA plugin, can generate YARA rules from its patterns, and runs processors locally or over IPC and HTTP.
description_zh: 二进制特征词法框架，从可执行文件中提取指令、基本块和函数，并输出可检索的 JSON 特征，用于相似度分析、威胁狩猎和签名工作。它以仿基因组学的层级结构对代码建模，计算 MinHash、TLSH、SHA256、熵和通配字节模式等特征，从而在大规模样本间进行比较、聚类并生成签名。它提供命令行工具套件、Rust API、Python 绑定和 IDA 插件，可依据其模式生成 YARA 规则，并支持本地或通过 IPC 与 HTTP 运行处理器。
requirements: The reviewed master commit declares a Rust 2024-edition workspace at version 2.0.0. The latest stable GitHub release is v1.1.1 (2023-03-04); the v2.0.0 line is still at release candidates, the most recent being v2.0.0-rc2 (2025-01-14), whose prebuilt zips cover Linux (Debian and Arch), macOS (amd64 and aarch64) and Windows, plus an IDA plugin archive and a server archive. The reviewed master is ahead of those tags.

The README lists Linux, macOS and Windows; input formats PE, ELF and Mach-O; and AMD64, I386 and CIL architectures, with disassembly through Capstone 0.12. Build and install with cargo build --release --workspace, build the Python bindings with maturin, package with make zst/deb/wheel, install the IDA plugin with pip and python -m binlex_ida install, and the repository also provides Docker Compose files for its server, web, MCP and Python images.

Supply the binaries to analyze yourself; the repository commits no sample binaries, and its tests are Rust source. Binlex extracts static traits and hashes and generates patterns and YARA rules; it does not run the target, and derived signatures and similarity scores still need analyst validation.
MIT license; contributions require signing the repository's CLA.

name: GhidrAssist
description_en: Ghidra extension by Jason Tang, who also wrote GhidrAssistMCP, that adds a tabbed GhidrAssist window to CodeBrowser for LLM-assisted analysis of the open program. Its tabs explain decompiled or disassembled functions with a security summary, keep persistent chats with context macros, MCP tool calling and an optional ReAct agent mode, propose function and variable renames, retypes and structures for review before they are applied, and build a semantic knowledge graph of functions, calls and security features with community detection, alongside Lucene retrieval over reference documents the analyst adds. A SymGraph tab imports and publishes names, types, graph data and documents through the hosted symgraph.ai service.
description_zh: 由 GhidrAssistMCP 作者 Jason Tang 开发的 Ghidra 扩展，在 CodeBrowser 中加入多标签页的 GhidrAssist 窗口，借助大语言模型分析当前打开的程序。各标签页可解释反编译或反汇编后的函数并附安全摘要，保存支持上下文宏、MCP 工具调用和可选 ReAct 智能体模式的持久对话，为函数和变量提出重命名、类型修改及结构体建议并在审阅后应用，还能构建涵盖函数、调用关系和安全特征的语义知识图谱并进行社区检测，同时可借助 Lucene 检索分析人员添加的参考文档。SymGraph 标签页则通过托管的 symgraph.ai 服务导入和发布名称、类型、图谱数据及文档。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2.2.0, published 2026-05-29 with extension zips for Ghidra 12.0 and 12.1 Public; the reviewed master commit is three commits later and only updates model guidance and max-token handling. The README and getting-started guide state a Ghidra 11.0 minimum, but release zips are built per Ghidra version and recent ones cover only 12.x. Installation goes through File → Install Extensions, after which the plugin is enabled under CodeBrowser's File → Configure → Miscellaneous; source builds use Gradle with GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR.

Analysis needs at least one configured LLM provider. The reviewed provider types cover Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini and xAI APIs, OpenAI and Gemini subscription sign-in through OAuth, the local Claude Code CLI, a LiteLLM proxy, and local Ollama, LM Studio or Open WebUI endpoints; the documentation's provider tables also list an Anthropic OAuth type that the source does not define. Explanations, chats, Actions, agent runs and the graph's Semantic Analysis step send pseudocode or disassembly to the active provider, so only a local or self-hosted endpoint keeps code on the machine, while graph re-indexing and Security Analysis run without the model. Chats, explanations, graph data and feedback are kept in local SQLite databases and a Lucene index whose paths are set in Settings.

Programs come from the user's own Ghidra projects. Actions suggestions are applied only for the rows the user checks. Chats can reach MCP servers over SSE or streamable HTTP or launch them over stdio; built-in tools read the current function and address, apply the Actions edits and query the semantic graph, and the README pairs the plugin with GhidrAssistMCP for decompilation, cross-reference and other Ghidra-specific tools. Calls to tools whose names do not look read-only wait for an allow-once, allow-for-session or deny decision, and this classification relies on tool-name keywords.

The SymGraph tab looks up the program by SHA-256 without a key, but importing, publishing and uploading need a SymGraph API key, and publishing uploads the raw binary itself when the service does not already hold it. The repository has no tests or CI workflows.
MIT, per LICENSE and the README; Ghidra, model providers and SymGraph keep their own terms. The repository moved from jtang613/GhidrAssist.

name: game-and-watch-patch: Nintendo Game & Watch custom firmware
description_en: Custom firmware for the Mario and Zelda Game & Watch consoles that patches new C code into the user's own stock firmware backups, so the original firmware runs alongside the retro-go emulator. A Python patcher hooks stock function calls, relocates and LZMA-compresses stock code and data to free flash, and can merge both models' firmware into one image. Committed symbol maps, a cross-reference mapper and an analysis-ELF builder support the reverse engineering, and a journal records the author's first firmware-patching work.
description_zh: 面向马里奥和塞尔达两款 Game & Watch 掌机的自定义固件：把新编写的 C 代码修补进使用者自己的原厂固件备份，使原厂固件可与 retro-go 模拟器并存。Python 补丁工具会挂接原厂函数调用，重新定位原厂代码与数据并以 LZMA 压缩以腾出闪存，还能把两款机型的固件合并为一个镜像。仓库提交的符号表、交叉引用分析脚本和分析用 ELF 生成器支撑逆向工作，另有一份日志记录作者首次修补固件的过程。
requirements: The reviewed main commit (2026-10-19) is 111 commits past the last tag, v0.12 of 2025-02-25, and no release attaches binaries; the relocation, merged-image, analysis tooling and most tests arrived after that tag. The README lists more Mario features (whole firmware in internal flash, removable song and sleep illustrations, timeouts, clock graphics mods) than Zelda ones and says Zelda's external-flash savings are still to come.

Requires the user's own internal and external flash backups of a Mario or Zelda unit, placed as internal_flash_backup_<device>.bin and flash_backup_<device>.bin; the patcher rejects images whose SHA-1 does not match the stock firmware. The repository commits no firmware, ROMs or keys: tools/re/README.md says the .syms files hold only the project's annotations and that ELFs derived from Nintendo's firmware must never be committed, and docs/mario.md says no ROMs or ROM-hack patches are hosted.

Targets the consoles' STM32H7B0 microcontroller. Builds need GNU Make, the arm-none-eabi GCC toolchain and Python 3.6+ with Pillow, NumPy, pycryptodome, pyelftools, capstone and colorama; flashing uses gnwmanager, and the Mario internal-only mode also needs a patched OpenOCD for an undocumented extra 128 KB of internal flash. An Ubuntu 22.04 Dockerfile installs gnwmanager's OpenOCD and Arm toolchain for x86-64 Linux hosts.

tests/test_golden.py rebuilds fixed option sets and compares output SHA-1 hashes with tests/golden.json, recorded for Arm GNU Toolchain 15.2.Rel1; it skips without the stock backups or under another GCC version. Other unit tests cover relocation, Thumb assembly, layout and symbols, and tools/emu runs patched images through menu tests in the GWemu emulator. CI only runs pre-commit lint checks and builds the Docker image.

COPYING is BSD-3-Clause (2020, Konrad Beckmann, Thomas Roth, STMicroelectronics); the vendored ST CMSIS and HAL sources keep their own notices, and the stock firmware and games remain Nintendo's. The repository's CLAUDE.md is guidance for Claude Code.

name: Driver Buddy Reloaded
description_en: IDA Pro Python plugin for triaging Windows kernel drivers, building on NCC Group's original DriverBuddy. Its auto-analysis identifies the driver model (WDM, KMDF, UMDF, WDF, Mini-Filter, Stream Minidriver, AVStream or PortCls), locates the device-control dispatch routines, labels IRP, IO_STACK_LOCATION and WDF structures and calls, and discovers and decodes IOCTL codes through Hex-Rays ctree, switch-table and immediate-operand scans. It also reports device names, symbolic links and device ACLs, pool tags, flagged APIs and opcodes, name-based call chains and heuristic vulnerability leads with per-IOCTL risk scores, in an IDA findings window, a JSON file and an HTML report.
description_zh: 用于分诊 Windows 内核驱动的 IDA Pro Python 插件，在 NCC Group 最初的 DriverBuddy 基础上发展而来。其自动分析可识别驱动模型（WDM、KMDF、UMDF、WDF、Mini-Filter、Stream Minidriver、AVStream 或 PortCls），定位设备控制派遣例程，标注 IRP、IO_STACK_LOCATION 和 WDF 结构及调用，并通过 Hex-Rays ctree、switch 跳转表和立即数操作数三种扫描发现并解码 IOCTL 码。它还会报告设备名、符号链接与设备 ACL、池标记、被标记的 API 和指令、基于名称的调用链，以及带逐个 IOCTL 风险评分的启发式漏洞线索，结果显示在 IDA 结果窗口中，并写入 JSON 文件和 HTML 报告。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2.5.1, published 2026-07-08 as a zip; the reviewed main commit of 2026-10-19 is four commits later, adding an IOCTL-recovery fix for issue #41 with a new regression fixture, DriverEntry typing for the MajorFunction annotator and the licence change noted below. The README says it runs on IDA 7.6+, 8.x and 9.0+ with Python 3, with API differences handled by ida_compat.py, and ida-plugin.json lists Windows, Linux and macOS hosts. IDA 9.0+ installs it with hcli plugin install; 7.6 and 8.x need the script and its package folder copied to the top level of the plugins directory.

Analysts load their own Windows kernel driver (.sys) in IDA. The Hex-Rays decompiler is optional but drives the strongest IOCTL scan, with switch-table and immediate-operand scans as fallbacks, and the experimental DispatchDeviceControl search works only for x64 drivers. Each run writes findings.json, report.html, pooltags.txt and an analysis log next to the IDB, and optional stages are toggled in config.py.

tests/test_dbr.py is a pure-Python regression suite that needs no IDA; run_cross_version.ps1 runs the pipeline under IDA 7.6 SP1, 8.4 and Free 9.3, and run_golden.ps1 compares findings on reference drivers with committed golden JSON captured with the IDA 8.4 decompiler. The README reports that decompiler-based scanning raised IOCTL recovery from 7/28 to 28/28 on HEVD and from 4/17 to 17/17 on ALSysIO64 with no false positives. There is no CI, and these results are project-reported.

tests/drivers bundles IDA databases (.i64) and golden findings for eight reference drivers as regression fixtures: ALSysIO64, HEVD, IObitUnlocker, MODAPI, WinRing0x64, amp, beep and zam64 .sys. Those drivers keep their own vendors' terms.

LICENSE was replaced on 2026-07-10 with the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, which permits only noncommercial purposes, while release 2.5.1 and earlier carry GPL-3.0 and ida-plugin.json still declares GPL-3.0. IDA Pro and Hex-Rays keep their own terms. The README calls its findings heuristic lead generators for manual review rather than confirmed vulnerabilities.

name: FA (Firmware Analysis)
description_en: Python framework, mainly used as an IDA plugin, that turns the manual steps of locating symbols, such as finding a string, following its cross-reference and taking the function start, into reusable signatures. Hjson SIG files, grouped into per-platform projects, chain commands that search bytes, strings, immediates or Keystone-assembled opcodes, filter by operands and cross-references, and then set names, types, constants, enums and struct members; Python scripts can drive the same interpreter. In IDA it adds an FA menu and toolbar to find all of a project's symbols, draft a temporary signature from the current function and export symbols plus a C header, and a separate loader runs signatures over a raw ELF file without IDA.
description_zh: 一个主要以 IDA 插件形式使用的 Python 框架，把定位符号时的手工步骤（例如查找字符串、跟随交叉引用、跳到函数起始处）写成可复用的签名。Hjson 格式的 SIG 文件按平台归入不同项目，其中串联的命令可搜索字节、字符串、立即数或用 Keystone 汇编出的指令，按操作数和交叉引用筛选，再设置名称、类型、常量、枚举和结构体成员；也可用 Python 脚本调用同一解释器。在 IDA 中，它添加 FA 菜单和工具栏，用于查找项目的全部符号、根据当前函数生成临时签名草稿，以及导出符号和 C 头文件；另有一个加载器可在不使用 IDA 的情况下对原始 ELF 文件运行签名。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.0.11, published 2026-03-25 without attached files; it tags the reviewed master commit, and the same version is on PyPI as fa 1.0.11. The README installs it by cloning the repository and running pip install -e, says the code base is very IDA-oriented and only considers Ghidra, radare2 or other disassemblers for the future.

The README supports IDA 8.0+, and a March 2026 commit added IDA 9.0 support to make-offset. The package requires Python 3.8+; its dependencies, including keystone-engine, capstone, hjson and rpyc, are installed into IDA's Python. IDA can also run the plugin in script mode to write a symbols file, while the ELF loader script imports pyelftools, which is listed only in the testing requirements.

The binaries, IDA databases and signatures come from the analyst: the repository ships only two small test projects under fa/signatures and no signature sets for real firmware. The README groups signatures into projects partly to lower false positives, and the ELF loader reports symbols with several matches instead of choosing one.

CI lints with flake8 and runs pytest on Python 3.8 to 3.12; the tests check find-bytes on mocked memory segments and ELF symbol search on a small ARM ELF built at test time with Keystone and simpleelf, and neither runs IDA. GPL-3.0 license text; pyproject.toml classifies it as GPLv3 or later.

name: DexKit
description_en: C++ DEX parsing library with Kotlin and Java APIs that loads an APK, DEX bytes or an app’s class loader and finds classes, methods and fields by their characteristics rather than their obfuscated names. Matchers combine package scope, modifiers and raw access flags, field, parameter and return types, annotations, the strings and numeric constants a method uses and the methods it calls, while batch queries locate many targets from strings at once; results expose opcodes, callers, invoked methods and fields used. Its guides centre on keeping Xposed hook points working across obfuscated app versions, and the same queries serve as a fast, scriptable search over an app’s bytecode.
description_zh: 以 C++ 实现的 DEX 解析库，提供 Kotlin 与 Java API，可加载 APK、DEX 字节数据或应用的类加载器，并按特征而非混淆后的名称查找类、方法和字段。匹配条件可组合包名范围、修饰符与原始访问标志、字段类型、参数类型和返回类型、注解、方法使用的字符串与数值常量以及其调用的方法；批量查询可依据字符串一次定位多个目标，查询结果还提供操作码、调用者、被调用方法和所用字段。其文档以让 Xposed Hook 点在混淆后的不同应用版本间保持可用为主要场景，同样的查询也可用来快速、可编程地检索应用字节码。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2.3.0, published 2026-09-22 with no attached files, which added numeric-literal reading and raw DEX access-flag matching and optimized caching and string queries. The reviewed master commit of 2026-10-10 is two core fixes ahead of that tag. Packages are published on Maven Central as org.luckypray:dexkit; the artifact ID changed from DexKit with 2.0.

Android projects need JDK 11+, Kotlin 1.5+, AGP 4.2+ and minSdkVersion 21+, with 23+ recommended because libdexkit.so may not load from compressed APK libraries on older settings. Since 1.1.0 it also runs on Windows, Linux and macOS from a source checkout built with gcc or clang, CMake and Ninja or Make, using MSYS2 on Windows, and CI builds the native libraries on all three. The APK, DEX data or class loader to query comes from the user; the repository’s only app is its own demo.

The guides present DexKit as a tool for Xposed module developers, and the README examples run inside an Xposed hook. Matches depend on the conditions the user writes, so they identify candidate classes and members rather than recover original names. Unit tests with smali fixtures are in the repository, but the reviewed workflows only build the native libraries and packages.

Everything outside Core/ is Apache-2.0, while the native code in Core/ is LGPL-3.0, although the README’s license badge links only to the LGPL. The README credits AOSP’s slicer, ThreadPool and parallel-hashmap as third-party sources. Apps analysed with it keep their own terms.

name: AndroidReverse101
description_en: A Chinese-language Android reverse-engineering course by Evil0ctal, planned as 100 daily lessons. It starts from number systems, ARM assembly, the Dalvik/ART runtime and APK loading, then covers APK and DEX structure, Smali editing and repackaging, Frida and Xposed hooking, JNI and native-library analysis, traffic analysis, obfuscation and app hardening, with commands and code for tools such as jadx, apktool, readelf, GDB/LLDB, Frida and Burp Suite. A Crackmes folder adds copies of OWASP's UnCrackable and r2pay practice apps, and a community Indonesian translation follows the published lessons.
description_zh: Evil0ctal 编写的中文 Android 逆向课程，计划分 100 天、每天一课。课程从进制、ARM 汇编、Dalvik/ART 运行时和 APK 加载机制讲起，继而介绍 APK 与 DEX 结构、Smali 修改与重新打包、Frida 和 Xposed Hook、JNI 与 Native 库分析、抓包分析、代码混淆及应用加固，并结合 jadx、apktool、readelf、GDB/LLDB、Frida、Burp Suite 等工具给出命令和代码。Crackmes 目录收录 OWASP UnCrackable 与 r2pay 练习应用的副本，另有社区贡献的印度尼西亚语译本与已发布课程对应。
requirements: Reviewed at commit 9b72d20 (2025-12-31), the merge of a community Indonesian translation; the Chinese lessons and crackmes were committed between 22 and 25 February 2025, and there are no releases. The README outlines 100 days in three phases, but the tree holds 44 lessons (Days 1–41, 60, 70 and 100), and the Indonesian translation covers the same 44, many in shortened form.

No outside target files are needed to begin: the Day 20 lesson supplies crackme source for learners to compile, and the Crackmes folder commits five practice APKs, UnCrackable-Level1.apk, UnCrackable-Level2.apk, UnCrackable-Level3.apk, r2pay-v0.9.apk and r2pay-v1.0.apk, whose Git blobs are identical to the crackmes in OWASP's MASTG repository. Only Level 1 has a written walkthrough; the README's Crackme 2 link points to a file that is not in the tree.

Lessons assume a desktop host with adb and an Android device, and name tools including jadx, apktool, baksmali, readelf, GDB/LLDB, IDA Pro, Ghidra, Frida with frida-server on the device, Burp Suite and Wireshark; the Xposed lesson starts from a device rooted with Magisk.

Many phase-two lessons and the Day 70 and Day 100 exercises are framed around modifying third-party apps, including defeating licence, paid-feature, root-detection, certificate-pinning and anti-debugging checks. The README and lessons carry no note on legal use or authorization.

The repository is MIT-licensed (copyright 2025 Evil0ctal); the crackmes come from OWASP's CC BY-SA 4.0 MASTG repository, and the tools named keep their own terms. The lessons mention AI as a reverse-engineering subject.

name: fuji-cam-wifi-tool: reconstructing Fujifilm X-series Wi-Fi remote control
description_en: Reimplements the Wi-Fi remote-control protocol of Fujifilm X-series cameras as a C++ library and an interactive command-line client that joins the camera's access point. Its headers name the control, event and JPEG live-view ports, message types and camera property codes, and source comments keep hex traces of exchanges along with what "the app" sends; the client connects, fires the shutter, records video, adjusts exposure settings and focus point, and streams live view, optionally into a Linux webcam device. README calls the tool very limited and mostly undocumented, so the protocol knowledge lives in code and comments rather than a specification.
description_zh: 以 C++ 库和交互式命令行客户端重新实现 Fujifilm X 系列相机的 Wi-Fi 遥控协议，客户端需接入相机自建的无线接入点。头文件列出控制、事件和 JPEG 实时取景所用端口、报文类型及相机属性代码，源码注释保留了若干交互的十六进制记录，并注明“the app”发送的内容；客户端可连接相机、触发快门、录制视频、调整曝光参数与对焦点，并传输实时取景画面，还可选择输出到 Linux 摄像头设备。README 称该工具功能很有限、基本没有文档，因此协议知识只存在于代码和注释中，并无成文规范。
requirements: Reviewed at master commit c597fc4 of 2021-03-17, the repository's last push; there are no releases or tags. The README describes an attempt to reverse-engineer the protocol, calls the tool very limited and mostly undocumented, and suggests reading the code. Its connection steps name the X-T10 and a source comment mentions focus-point ranges on the X-T100; no compatibility list for other X-series models is given.

Requires the user's own Fujifilm X-series camera with Wi-Fi remote control: the computer joins the camera's access point, the client connects to 192.168.0.1 on ports 55740–55742, and the first connection must be confirmed on the camera, where the tool registers as "HackedClient". The repository contains no camera firmware, Fujifilm app or capture files; the README gives Wireshark display filters for viewing control messages and streamed JPEG frames.

README documents CMake builds on macOS, Linux and Windows (CMake 2.8.11 minimum, C++11). The interactive shell needs the hkr/linenoise-ng submodule initialized, and Windows builds link Winsock. Optional OpenCV support adds stream_cv, which can feed live view into a Linux v4l2loopback device for use as a webcam.
The repository has no tests or CI. Message meanings are inferred in code comments, several of which are marked unknown or TODO, and command behavior on cameras remains contributor-reported.
Released under the Unlicense, a public-domain dedication; AUTHORS.txt lists five contributors. Fujifilm cameras, firmware, apps and trademarks keep their own rights.

name: pyinstxtractor-ng (PyInstaller Extractor Next Generation)
description_en: Fork of PyInstaller Extractor (pyinstxtractor) by the same author that extracts the bundled CArchive files and PYZ modules from Linux ELF and Windows PE executables built with PyInstaller, writing .pyc files with repaired headers for a separate bytecode decompiler. Unlike the original script, it unmarshals the PYZ archive with the xdis library, so it does not have to run under the Python version that built the executable, and it automatically decrypts PYZ entries that PyInstaller's optional AES encryption protected, using the key module bundled in the same executable. A one-directory mode extracts the PYZ next to the other files so the result can be run directly, and --info prints archive metadata such as versions, entry points and encryption without writing files.
description_zh: PyInstaller Extractor（pyinstxtractor）的同一作者所做的分支版本，可从 PyInstaller 构建的 Linux ELF 和 Windows PE 可执行文件中提取打包的 CArchive 文件和 PYZ 模块，并输出修复了文件头的 .pyc 文件，供另行使用的字节码反编译器处理。与原脚本不同，它借助 xdis 库反序列化 PYZ 归档，因此无须在构建该可执行文件时所用的 Python 版本下运行；对于经 PyInstaller 可选 AES 加密保护的 PYZ 条目，它会利用同一可执行文件中打包的密钥模块自动解密。单目录模式会把 PYZ 内容提取到其他文件旁边，便于直接运行提取结果；--info 选项则只输出版本、入口点和加密情况等归档元数据，而不写入任何文件。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2026.07.03, published 2026-07-03, with a Linux binary and a Windows .exe built by PyInstaller, so those builds need no Python installation; the same version is on PyPI as pyinstxtractor-ng 2026.7.3. The reviewed main commit is two commits ahead of that tag and only relaxes the pycryptodome requirement from exactly 3.17 to 3.19.1 or later below 4.

Running the script needs Python 3.8+, xdis pinned to 6.3.0 and pycryptodome; a leftover Poetry section in pyproject.toml still caps Python below 3.13. Release binaries come from a manually triggered workflow that builds with Python 3.8 and PyInstaller 5.10.1, and the repository has no tests or test executables.

The script header lists PyInstaller 2.0 through 5.10.1 as supported, and the README states no version range. Entries that can be neither decompressed nor decrypted are saved unchanged with an .encrypted suffix.

The PyInstaller executable comes from the user, and turning the recovered bytecode into source needs a separate decompiler. Recovered code remains subject to the rights of the original program’s owner.
GPL-3.0-only.

name: RETracker
description_en: Python reverse-engineering framework for the Polyend Tracker music device that patches the vendor's stock firmware, replacing an unused USB RAWHID handler with its own command handler. With the patched firmware flashed, a host CLI reads, hex-dumps and disassembles device memory in ARM or Thumb mode, writes memory, runs code at an address, assembles and executes position-independent "Polyp" modules such as a pad text scroller and screen fades, and copies files to the SD card over USB. Its fwtool.py also unpacks and repacks the Intel HEX .ptf firmware images for loading into a disassembler.
description_zh: 面向 Polyend Tracker 音乐设备的 Python 逆向工程框架：为厂商原版固件打补丁，用自己的命令处理程序替换一个未使用的 USB RAWHID 处理程序。刷入打过补丁的固件后，主机命令行工具即可按 ARM 或 Thumb 模式读取、十六进制转储和反汇编设备内存，还能写入内存、在指定地址执行代码，汇编并运行称为“Polyp”的位置无关模块（如在打击垫上显示滚动文字和屏幕淡入淡出），以及通过 USB 向 SD 卡复制文件。其 fwtool.py 还可解包和重新打包 Intel HEX 格式的 .ptf 固件镜像，便于载入反汇编器。
requirements: Only Polyend Tracker firmware 1.5.0 is supported; the README says a private 1.6.0 port was not released because Polyend removed the code the patches relied on. The reviewed main commit of 2024-06-19 only announces a discussion thread, the last code change dates from 2022, and there are no releases or tags.

Patching needs the user's own copy of the stock PolyendTracker_1.5.0.ptf image, which the repository does not include, and the patched image is flashed through the device's normal firmware-update menu. The README warns that the update screen behaves differently with patched images, recommends backing up the SD card first and points to the Tracker's emergency update procedure for recovery.

Needs Python 3 with capstone, keystone-engine, pyusb, intelhex and simple-hexdump; the host finds the device over USB by vendor and product ID. The README's reverse-engineering notes treat the hardware as a Teensy 3.6-class MK66FX microcontroller, give the firmware load address and a RAM address used for Polyps, and say IDA Pro, and probably Ghidra or Binary Ninja, can load the Intel HEX image directly.
There are no tests or CI. Behaviour is documented through README examples and a linked demo video.
No license file was found and GitHub detects none, so reuse terms are unstated. Polyend's firmware keeps its own rights, and the README disclaimer places any device damage at the user's risk.

name: CoBRA (Coefficient-Based Reconstruction of Arithmetic)
description_en: Trail of Bits' C++23 simplifier for Mixed Boolean-Arithmetic (MBA) expressions, an obfuscation technique that rewrites simple computations as interleaved arithmetic, bitwise and shift operations. Given an expression and a bit width from 1 to 64, cobra-cli returns a simpler equivalent: a worklist scheduler combines signature-vector and change-of-basis techniques, semilinear handling of constant masks, polynomial recovery, decomposition of mixed products and subexpression lifting, and each result is checked on random inputs or, optionally, with a Z3 equivalence proof. The same engine is available as a library and as an optional LLVM pass plugin that simplifies MBA expressions it detects in LLVM IR.
description_zh: Trail of Bits 开发的 C++23 混合布尔-算术（MBA）表达式化简器。MBA 是一种混淆技术，会把简单运算改写为算术、按位与移位运算交织的复杂形式。cobra-cli 接受一个表达式和 1 至 64 位的位宽，输出更简单的等价式：工作列表调度器组合签名向量与基变换技术、带常量掩码的半线性处理、多项式恢复、混合乘积分解和子表达式提升，每个结果都会用随机输入抽查，也可选用 Z3 做等价性证明。同一引擎还以库的形式提供，并可编译为 LLVM 优化遍插件，对其在 LLVM IR 中检测到的 MBA 表达式进行化简。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.3.0, published 2026-06-30 without prebuilt binaries. The reviewed master commit is eight commits ahead: README edits, a CI dependency bump, a fix that requires LLVM only when the pass is built, and a fix that lets cobra-core build under MSVC.

Builds from source with CMake 3.20+ and a C++23 compiler (GCC 13+, Clang 17+ or Apple Clang 16+); a dependency superbuild builds Abseil and Highway, and GoogleTest when tests are enabled. The LLVM pass plugin needs LLVM 19 to 22, runs through opt as cobra-simplify, replaces an expression only when the simplified form is cheaper and drops nuw/nsw flags. Z3 checking is compiled in only when CMake finds Z3; otherwise cobra-cli warns that --verify is ignored. CI builds with Clang 22 and LLVM 22 on Ubuntu 24.04 on every run, and with GCC 14 and on macOS 15 only for version tags; Windows is not in CI.

cobra-cli takes the obfuscated expression as text, with at most 16 variables by default, so expressions in a binary must first be recovered with other tools or reach the pass as LLVM IR. The README's known limitations are deeply interleaved mixed-polynomial MBAs that exhaust the worklist budget, a few candidates that are correct only on Boolean inputs and are reported as verify-failed, and no general logic minimization.

The README reports 1,195 tests, and DATASETS.md reports 75,023 of 75,126 parsed expressions from 35 dataset files and seven sources simplified and spot-checked (99.86%). The OSES subsets are disabled for running out of memory or taking minutes per expression, so their figures come from an earlier run; DATASETS.md says the numbers are checked on every CI run, but the reviewed CI workflow excludes the dataset benchmark tests.

Apache-2.0 for CoBRA. The test/datasets files are redistributed from third-party research projects: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES lists most as effectively GPL-3.0-only, Loki's as AGPL-3.0-only, and the OSES and ObfuscatorX sets with unspecified or unknown licenses.

name: PiCCANTE
description_en: Raspberry Pi Pico firmware and hardware designs for a low-cost CAN bus interface aimed at exploring and reverse engineering vehicle networks. It runs two CAN 2.0B channels on RP2040 boards or three on RP2350 boards through the PIO-based can2040 library and exposes them over USB as a GVRET device for SavvyCAN and as per-channel SLCAN devices for Linux SocketCAN via can-utils. A configuration shell, a partial ELM327 emulator for OBD-II PID requests with ISO-TP multi-frame replies, and Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and a web interface on Pico W boards complete the firmware, alongside perfboard and KiCad PCB designs with 3D-printable cases for an OBD-II dongle.
description_zh: 基于 Raspberry Pi Pico 的低成本 CAN 总线接口固件与硬件设计，用于探索和逆向分析车辆网络。它借助基于 PIO 的 can2040 库，在 RP2040 开发板上运行两路、在 RP2350 开发板上运行三路 CAN 2.0B 通道，并通过 USB 以 GVRET 设备的形式供 SavvyCAN 使用，同时为每个通道提供 SLCAN 设备，经 can-utils 接入 Linux SocketCAN。固件还包括配置命令行、可处理 OBD-II PID 请求（含 ISO-TP 多帧应答）的部分 ELM327 模拟器，以及 Pico W 开发板上的 Wi-Fi、蓝牙和网页界面；仓库另附 OBD-II 适配器的洞洞板与 KiCad PCB 设计及可 3D 打印的外壳。
requirements: Only release at review: v0.0.1, published 2025-05-03 with UF2 and ELF firmware for Pico, Pico W, Pico 2 and Pico 2 W; a dev-latest pre-release is rebuilt from main and was built from the reviewed commit of 2026-01-26. The README marks the ELM327 emulator as partial, lacking CAN setup, protocol auto-detection and filters, and lists SD-card logging and software CAN filters as planned. CAN FD and CAN XL are not supported.

Hardware is any Raspberry Pi Pico or Pico 2 board with one to three 3.3 V CAN transceivers such as the SN65HVD; the Pico 2 W is recommended for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The README warns that the 120-ohm termination resistor on most transceiver breakout boards must be removed before joining an existing, terminated bus, and urges caution when connecting to vehicle systems. The OBD-II dongle can add a buck converter, an SD card slot and a voltage divider for battery voltage.

Source builds need the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK, CMake 3.13+ and the GCC ARM toolchain, with FreeRTOS-Kernel, a can2040 fork, littlefs, TinyUSB, pico-extras and FreeRTOS-FAT-CLI as submodules; PICO_BOARD defaults to pico2_w, and the web interface is a separate Svelte project in Web/. CI builds firmware for the four Pico boards on pushes to main and on pull requests, and no test suite is documented.

GPL-3.0-or-later per LICENSE.txt and the README notice; the README attributes the CAN 2.0B-only limit to can2040's licensing, and the bundled DHCP server code carries an MIT notice. No separate license is stated for the KiCad, STL and STEP hardware files.

name: Gymnasticon: bridging proprietary exercise-bike data to standard cycling sensors
description_en: Node.js bridge that reads power and cadence from exercise bikes whose own apps or services are gone or closed, and re-broadcasts them as standard Bluetooth LE Cycling Power and Cycling Speed and Cadence sensors and as an ANT+ bike power profile, so that Zwift, TrainerRoad, bike computers and watches can use the bike. The author's development notes describe working out the Flywheel Home Bike's stats packets on its Bluetooth UART service after the vendor shut its home service down; Peloton support reads the bike's data cable through a USB serial adapter, while the Schwinn IC4 and Keiser M clients parse the standard Fitness Machine Service and Keiser's documented broadcasts. Bike and app compatibility is project-reported.
description_zh: 一个 Node.js 桥接程序：从官方应用或服务已停用或不开放的健身单车读取功率和踏频，再以标准的低功耗蓝牙 Cycling Power、Cycling Speed and Cadence 传感器及 ANT+ 自行车功率配置文件重新广播，使 Zwift、TrainerRoad、码表和运动手表能够使用这辆单车。作者的开发笔记记录了在厂商关停家用服务后，如何在 Flywheel Home Bike 的蓝牙 UART 服务上解析出其统计数据包；Peloton 支持通过 USB 串口适配器读取单车的数据线，Schwinn IC4 和 Keiser M 客户端则分别解析标准的 Fitness Machine Service 和 Keiser 公开文档中的广播数据。单车与应用的兼容性均为项目报告。
requirements: Latest GitHub release at review: v1.4.0, published 2021-02-21 with a Raspberry Pi SD card image; npm's latest is 1.4.1 from 2021-03-24, and the reviewed main commit of 2021-04-21, which adds autodetection for all supported bikes, is still the newest on main. The README lists the Flywheel, Peloton (with an additional cable), Schwinn IC4/IC8 aka Bowflex C6 and Keiser M3i, M3i-TBT and M3iX bikes as tested and the LifeFitness IC5 as probably working; a simulated bot bike serves testing.

Needs the user's own supported bike; no vendor app, firmware or account is used. A Raspberry Pi Zero W is recommended, and the tested hosts are Raspbian Buster on Pi Zero W, 3B+ and 4, macOS 10.14+ and Debian Buster on x86-64. BLE bikes need a Bluetooth 4.1+ adapter with multi-role support, or two adapters; ANT+ output needs an ANT+ USB stick, and Peloton bikes need the extra serial cable linked from the README.

The SD card image is the project's own Raspbian Buster build made with pi-gen scripts in deploy/, with the default pi/raspberry account and SSH disabled; on first boot it switches the root filesystem to an overlay with a read-only boot partition and reads gymnasticon.json from the boot partition. Manual installs use Node.js 12.16.1+ from npm, with libudev-dev on Linux and cap_net_raw or a systemd unit for Bluetooth access, and depend on the abandonware noble and bleno libraries, gd-ant-plus and serialport.

CI builds the package and runs tape unit tests on Node.js 12 and 14; they cover the Flywheel, IC4, Keiser and Peloton parsers on sample packets, the simulated bike and utilities, not live bikes or training apps. power-scale and power-offset options let riders correct bikes that report inaccurate power.
MIT. Bike and app names belong to their owners.

name: IW4L: a Rust runtime that plays Modern Warfare 2 from the user’s installed game
description_en: Implements a standalone runtime for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) in Rust on Bevy and wgpu, loading maps, models, textures and weapons from the user’s installed game through native FastFile readers and translating its Direct3D 9 shaders to WGSL. Bots, demo recording and replay, and multiplayer over custom UDP with a QUIC master are implemented, while README warns that gameplay remains incomplete, with missing behavior, bugs and desyncs. README states that the whole project is written by an LLM; NOTICE names the community projects consulted and says the original binaries were read with Ghidra.
description_zh: 以 Rust 基于 Bevy 和 wgpu 实现《使命召唤：现代战争 2》（2009）的独立运行时：通过原生 FastFile 读取器从使用者已安装的游戏中载入地图、模型、纹理和武器，并将其 Direct3D 9 着色器转换为 WGSL。已实现机器人、录像录制与回放，以及基于自定义 UDP 和 QUIC 主服务器的多人游戏；但 README 提醒游戏玩法仍不完整，存在缺失行为、错误和不同步。README 声明整个项目由大语言模型编写；NOTICE 列出参考过的社区项目，并说明曾用 Ghidra 阅读原版二进制文件。
requirements: Needs the user’s own MW2 Multiplayer installation, which BUILD.md describes as the Windows depot of a Steam copy; Black Ops and MW3 data are optional. The repository and release archives contain no game data, and CONTRIBUTING.md forbids attaching, committing or linking original game files.

Builds with stable Rust through rustup and GNU Make. Linux needs a C/C++ toolchain and X11, Wayland, ALSA, udev and xkbcommon development packages; macOS needs only the Xcode command-line tools. The Windows release is a password-protected iw4l-windows.zip; given a server operator’s .iw4l-server descriptor, iw4l.exe installs SHA-256-verified executable updates from that operator.
Releases are tagged demo builds, v0.1.0-demo.23 at review. APIs, caches and the wire protocol change between commits, so multiplayer peers must run the same build.

No CI workflow or cargo test suite: make publish-check rejects test modules, and the only permanent checks are two owner-approved end-to-end scenarios driving real clients on MW2 maps with the user’s game data. Fidelity to the original game is not measured.
Apache-2.0 source with two bundled OFL fonts; game assets and trademarks remain their owners’.

NOTICE says no third-party source is vendored and names references read during development, including OpenAssetTools, IW4x, KisakCOD and Plutonium’s decompiled Black Ops II scripts. A provenance note records replacing a movement module after reported similarities to GPL code.

name: Skate 3 Rust Engine: a Bevy rewrite built on Skate 3 reverse-engineering research
description_en: Reimplements Skate 3’s skating, tricks, grinds and offboard movement in a new Rust and Bevy engine that runs on assets converted from the user’s own Xbox 360 copy, adding difficulty settings and a .skate custom-map format. Physics notes cite functions and constants read from the original executable in IDA, and audio research reads traces from a research-hooks branch of a separate Skate 3 static recompilation. README says gameplay parity is still a work in progress, credits dumbad’s years of format research and states that AI coding tools were used to write the rewrite.
description_zh: 在新的 Rust 与 Bevy 引擎中重新实现《Skate 3》的滑行、技巧、擦边滑行和下板移动，运行时使用从使用者自有 Xbox 360 版游戏转换得到的素材，并加入难度设置和 .skate 自定义地图格式。物理说明引用了在 IDA 中读取的原版可执行文件的函数和常量，音频研究则读取另一个《Skate 3》静态重编译项目 research-hooks 分支产生的跟踪记录。README 称游戏玩法与原版的一致性仍在完善中，肯定了 dumbad 多年的格式研究，并说明这次重写借助了 AI 编程工具。
requirements: Play needs the user’s Skate 3 Xbox 360 ISO, or an extracted default.xex with its data folder; setup converts the skater, animations, disc maps and HUD assets into a local data folder, and ISO extraction needs internet access. Skate 3 assets are not included; the bundled format-demo map is described as original procedural content.

Runs on Windows: the release ZIP starts skate3rust.exe and needs an SDL3-compatible gamepad. Source builds need Rust with the MSVC toolchain and LLVM, using BUILD.bat and PLAY.bat; the portable package script needs Python 3.13.

tools/recomp-trace reads traces from the research-hooks branch of Hailey-Ross/skate3recomp, which users must build from their own copy of the game; its README warns that the recompilation’s timing and threading differ from the console game.

The Windows release workflow runs Python tests for the updater, setup and asset pipeline, but not the Rust crates’ own tests. tools/regression-checks compares maps, spawns and customiser output with a user-recorded baseline. Parity results are project-reported.

Original code is GPL-3.0-only, copyright dumbad and contributors; the vendored, patched Bevy crates and tools under tools/vendor/ keep their own licenses, and no rights are granted to Electronic Arts’ code, data, assets or trademarks or to third-party maps and mods. Unofficial and unaffiliated with EA.
tools/claude-skills holds Claude Code skills for developing the engine.

name: Rikugan
description_en: IDA Pro and Binary Ninja plugin that runs its own agent loop inside the disassembler: a model the user chooses streams its answers and calls more than 60 in-process tools for navigation, decompilation, disassembly, cross-references, strings, types, annotations, scripting and host IL or microcode edits. An orchestrator can map a binary and spawn parallel subagents, findings persist in a RIKUGAN.md file beside the database, and experimental commands apply plain-language patches or, on Binary Ninja, remove control-flow flattening and other obfuscation. README says it was vibecoded with Claude Code.
description_zh: IDA Pro 与 Binary Ninja 插件，在反汇编器内运行自己的智能体循环：使用者选定的模型以流式输出作答，并调用 60 多个进程内工具，涵盖导航、反编译、反汇编、交叉引用、字符串、类型、注释、脚本以及宿主 IL 或微码编辑。编排器可先梳理整个二进制文件，再并行派出子智能体；分析结论保存在数据库旁的 RIKUGAN.md 中；实验性命令可按自然语言描述打补丁，或在 Binary Ninja 上去除控制流平坦化等混淆。README 称该项目是与 Claude Code 一起“氛围编程”完成的。
requirements: README requires IDA Pro 9.0+ with the Hex-Rays decompiler or Binary Ninja in UI mode, and Python 3.10+, while pyproject.toml asks for 3.11+; ida-plugin.json lists IDA 9.0 to 9.2 on Windows, Linux and macOS. Windows also needs the latest Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 redistributable, and the install scripts are piped from raw GitHub.

Needs at least one model provider: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, MiniMax, Codex, local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Tool results from the open database go to the chosen provider; profiles limit which data the model may read and which tools it may use.

Version 1.4.0 (released 2026-09-25) at review. README says the agent asks permission before running scripts and never executes the target binary; natural-language patching (/modify) and the Binary Ninja /deobfuscation skill are marked experimental.

CI runs Ruff format and lint checks, mypy on the core and provider modules, pytest with an IDA mock and a desloppify score-regression gate. The repository publishes no benchmark; a Synacktiv article of 2026-10-13 compared it with another Binary Ninja agent on two CREBench tasks and attributed most of the gap to a prompt difference.
MIT per LICENSE and both plugin manifests; IDA Pro, Hex-Rays, Binary Ninja and model services keep their own licences and terms.
README calls the project a work in progress whose first version was built in a single night, and the repository carries an AGENTS.md developer guide.

name: ollvm-unflattener
description_en: Python command-line deobfuscator for the control-flow flattening applied by Obfuscator-LLVM (OLLVM). Given a flattened function's address, it uses Miasm's symbolic execution to track the dispatcher's state variable, records which blocks each state value selects and which state follows it, and writes a copy of the binary in which the function is reassembled with Keystone in its recovered order; an optional mode also follows the function's calls. The README covers 32- and 64-bit x86 Windows and Linux binaries and contrasts this approach with MODeflattener's static one.
description_zh: 针对 Obfuscator-LLVM（OLLVM）控制流平坦化的 Python 命令行去混淆工具。给定被平坦化函数的地址后，它借助 Miasm 的符号执行跟踪分发器的状态变量，记录每个状态值对应的基本块及其后继状态，再用 Keystone 按恢复出的顺序重新汇编该函数，并写出一份修改后的二进制副本；可选模式还会沿该函数的调用继续处理。README 涵盖 32 位和 64 位 x86 的 Windows 与 Linux 二进制，并将这种做法与 MODeflattener 的静态方法作了对比。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.0, published 2025-04-16 without attached binaries; its notes call it most likely the final release, and the reviewed master commit is that tag and the repository's last push. The tool runs from a clone as python unflattener -i <input> -o <output> -t <hex address>, with -a to follow calls; there are no tests or CI.

The README requires Python 3.10+ and Git; requirements.txt lists miasm, graphviz and keystone-engine without version pins. The code handles PE and ELF files for x86_32 and x86_64 and raises an error for other formats or architectures.

The analyst supplies the obfuscated binary and the target function's address. Functions scoring below 0.9 on a dominator-based flattening heuristic are left unchanged, the dispatcher and state variable are located by structural assumptions about OLLVM's layout, and -a only follows calls into the .text section. Output is a patched copy in which the original function bytes are overwritten with int3 padding and the reassembled function is written at its start.

The samples folder bundles small obfuscated test programs for 32- and 64-bit Linux and Windows (CFF.bin, CFF_full.bin, CFF_full_linux64.bin, CFF_win.exe, CFF_win_full.exe, CFF_win64.exe and CFF_win64_full.exe), their deob_* outputs and C/C++ sources for most of them; a comment in CFF_full.c says Claude generated that test program. The README's only reported result is a before/after control-flow graph of target_function in CFF_full.bin, with no check that deobfuscated binaries behave like the originals.
Apache-2.0; the dependencies keep their own licenses, including GPL-2.0-only for Miasm and GPL-2.0 with a FOSS exception for Keystone.

name: javascript-deobfuscator (LostMyCode)
description_en: Browser-based Vue app that restores the strings Obfuscator.io hides behind string-array lookups in JavaScript. The user pastes the obfuscated script and names its string array or decoder function, such as _0x439c; the tool classifies the calls as plain array indexing, a one-argument decoder or a two-argument RC4-style decoder, runs the script's own decoder to replace each call with its string literal, rewrites bracketed property access as dot notation and beautifies the result. The author hosts a demo at deo.sigr.io.
description_zh: 基于浏览器的 Vue 应用，用于还原 Obfuscator.io 藏在字符串数组查找背后的 JavaScript 字符串。用户粘贴混淆脚本，并填写其中的字符串数组或解码函数名（如 _0x439c）；工具会把调用识别为直接数组下标、单参数解码函数或双参数 RC4 式解码函数，借助脚本自带的解码函数把每次调用替换为字符串字面量，再把方括号属性访问改写为点号形式并美化输出。作者在 deo.sigr.io 提供演示站点。
requirements: Supply the obfuscated script and identify the target function name yourself; a built-in tip shows call shapes such as _0x439c[103], _0x439c('0x4') and _0x439c('0x2','f]Xg'). The README covers only the Vue CLI 4 project commands (npm install, serve, build and lint), and a GitHub Actions workflow builds the site with Node.js 16 and deploys it to GitHub Pages.
Unversioned: package.json reports 0.1.0 and marks the package private, there are no GitHub releases or npm package, and the reviewed master commit of 2024-05-31 is the latest push.

Only these string-array patterns are handled, with a fourth pattern marked experimental, and unrecognized input returns an error. The code has no passes for control-flow flattening, proxy functions, dead code or Obfuscator.io's other transformations, so those remain in the output. Decoding evaluates the pasted script with eval inside a browser web worker, so the input's own code runs; it is not a static AST transformation. The page template also loads js-beautify from cdnjs and a Google Analytics tag.
The repository has no tests, and the README's only result is an example screenshot.
The repository has no license file and GitHub detects no license, so it grants no stated reuse terms.

name: bun-demincer
description_en: Node.js pipeline that recovers readable JavaScript from Bun-compiled standalone executables. It extracts the embedded module graph and assets, splits the bundle into one file per module, flags npm vendor code with a fingerprint database, and deobfuscates with wakaru, format-preserving renames recovered from export mappings and optional Gemini-suggested names. Dependency-graph clustering, manual or LLM-assisted cluster labels and cross-version artifact transfer then organize and update the output.
description_zh: 从 Bun 编译的独立可执行文件中恢复可读 JavaScript 的 Node.js 流程。它提取内嵌的模块图和资源，把打包代码拆成每个模块一个文件，用指纹库标记 npm 第三方代码，再借助 wakaru、依据导出映射恢复名称的保格式重命名以及可选的 Gemini 命名建议进行反混淆。之后通过依赖图聚类、手工或借助 LLM 的聚类命名，以及跨版本迁移已有成果，来整理和更新输出。
requirements: The reviewed master commit of 2026-03-06 is the repository’s ninth, three days after its initial release commit of 2026-03-03; there are no tags or releases. It needs Node.js 18+ and the npm dependencies in package.json, including node-canvas for cluster PNGs; Bun is needed only to run extracted code. The README says Bun stores the code in a __BUN Mach-O section, appended ELF data or a .bun PE section; extract.mjs parses the Mach-O section header and otherwise searches for Bun's trailer.

Input is a Bun-compiled executable; the repository contains no target binaries or recovered code, and .gitignore excludes pipeline output. data/vendor-fingerprints-1000.json (26 MB) holds property-name and string-literal fingerprints for 23,746 files from 1,668 npm packages and can be rebuilt from a local node_modules. The README says steps 1–4 are automated, while cluster labels need manual input or an LLM.

ai-rename.mjs and ai-rename-scoped.mjs send module source to Google's Gemini API with a GEMINI_API_KEY (default model gemini-3-flash-preview); their names are model suggestions. The README's round-trip reassembly calls a build.mjs it marks as part of the user's project, which this repository does not contain.
The reviewed tree has no tests or CI. The README states MIT, but there is no license file and package.json has no license field. Four of the nine commits carry a Claude Opus 4.6 co-author trailer.

name: GolangAnalyzerExtension
description_en: Ghidra extension whose Golang Analyzer reads the runtime header and module data in Go binaries built with go1.6 through go1.27 to identify the Go version, rename functions, correct their arguments, comment source files and line numbers, add Go types to the Data Type Manager and label Go strings. A plugin window lists the recovered functions, types, source files and strings with links to Go source, and WebAssembly builds are handled when a separate Wasm loader such as ghidra-wasm-plugin is installed. A bundled script also renames functions that decode gobfuscate-style obfuscated strings and comments the decoded text.
description_zh: Ghidra 扩展，其 Golang Analyzer 读取 go1.6 至 go1.27 所编译 Go 二进制中的运行时头部和模块数据，用以识别 Go 版本、重命名函数、修正参数、以注释标出源文件与行号，把 Go 类型加入数据类型管理器，并标注 Go 字符串。插件窗口列出恢复出的函数、类型、源文件和字符串，并可链接到 Go 源码；另行安装 ghidra-wasm-plugin 等 Wasm 加载器后，也能处理 WebAssembly 构建。随附的脚本还会为解码 gobfuscate 式混淆字符串的函数重命名，并以注释写出解码后的文本。
requirements: Latest release at review: 1.4.0, published 2026-07-21 from the reviewed master commit, with notes stating support for go1.6 through go1.27. It provides prebuilt zips for Ghidra 12.0 through 12.0.4 and for 12.1, 12.1.2, 12.1.3 and 12.1.4, the last two built on 2026-10-14; install the zip matching the Ghidra release through File > Install Extensions and restart Ghidra. Source builds use Gradle with GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR set to a Ghidra installation.

Analysis runs on Go executables the user supplies, and the analyzer is enabled by default. Source has function handlers for x86, ARM, PowerPC and RISC-V; WebAssembly needs a separate Wasm loader. Function disassembly is off by default, and optional PcHeader-address and Go-version settings override detection. Function-name guessing by pattern matching and BSim exists in source, but its option is not registered and stays off.

The repository commits generated name-guessing data: a 4.3 MB list of calling-function names under test resources and a 53 KB H2 BSim database under scripts, with scripts that produce them by compiling a small sample Go program with each listed Go toolchain and running Ghidra headless. The copy under src/main/resources is empty at this commit, and no target binaries are committed. JUnit tests cover version, header, string and name-data parsing; there is no CI workflow.

The MIT license sits in GolangAnalyzerExtension/LICENSE (2021, mooncat-greenpy); it is not at the repository root, so GitHub detects no license. Output annotates the Ghidra program and needs analyst checking; it does not produce Go source.

name: IDA iOS Helper
description_en: IDA Pro plugin that cleans up Hex-Rays pseudocode and adds navigation helpers for iOS user-mode binaries and the kernelcache, enabling its components according to the loaded file. For Objective-C and Swift code it hides reference-counting calls, selectors and static class arguments, collapses os_log sequences, turns property helpers into plain assignments or field reads, lists cross-references to a method's selector, and adds Swift type declarations and readable stack strings. For kernelcaches it types the results of safeMetaCast and typed operator new, names and types kalloc_type_view globals, fixes this arguments and lists the possible implementations of a virtual call, while shared helpers remove __break calls, rewrite ranged conditions, collapse block initializers and mark outlined functions.
description_zh: 一款 IDA Pro 插件，用于清理 Hex-Rays 伪代码，并为 iOS 用户态二进制和 kernelcache 提供导航辅助，会根据所加载的文件启用相应组件。对 Objective-C 和 Swift 代码，它可隐藏引用计数调用、选择器和静态类参数，折叠 os_log 调用序列，把属性辅助函数还原为普通赋值或字段读取，列出方法选择器的交叉引用，并加入 Swift 类型声明和可读的栈上字符串。对 kernelcache，它可为 safeMetaCast 和带类型的 operator new 的返回值设置类型，为 kalloc_type_view 全局变量命名并设置类型，修正 this 参数，并列出虚函数调用的所有可能实现；通用辅助功能则会移除 __break 调用、改写范围条件、折叠 block 初始化代码并标记外提（outlined）函数。
requirements: Requires IDA Pro 9.0+, and most listed features rewrite Hex-Rays pseudocode, so they assume IDA's decompiler is available. Installation uses IDA's own pip to install the ida-ios-helper package, which needs Python 3.10+ and pins the author's idahelper library at 1.0.18, and then copies ida-plugin.json and ida_plugin_stub.py into IDA's plugins folder.

Latest release at review: 1.0.23, published 2026-06-25 with the wheel and source archive that are also on PyPI. The reviewed master commit is six commits ahead, adding an Objective-C fast-enumeration component and Swift type fixes that are not yet released, and its ida-plugin.json still declares version 1.0.19 and pins ida-ios-helper==1.0.19.

The iOS binaries or kernelcaches come from the analyst. Virtual-call navigation needs vtable symbols in the database, and typing typed operator new results first needs the Locate all kalloc_type_view action. A Swift importer added in June 2026 and not described in the README runs the separate ipsw tool's swift-dump command on the input file to name and type Swift class methods.

CI only checks Python 3.10 compatibility with vermin and runs ruff lint and format checks; there are no automated tests. The repository also holds headless idat probing scripts and a Claude Code skill used while developing the plugin. GPL-3.0.

name: MAMBO
description_en: Dynamic binary modification framework from the University of Manchester that runs unmodified Linux user-space programs on 32-bit Arm (A32/T32), AArch64 and RV64GC RISC-V, translating their code into a code cache as it executes. An event-driven C plugin API registers callbacks on code-scanning and execution events and emits instrumentation; sample plugins count instruction mixes, branches and blocks, trace memory accesses and system calls, find hotspots, simulate caches, check memory errors and detect data races.
description_zh: 曼彻斯特大学开发的动态二进制修改框架，可在 32 位 Arm（A32/T32）、AArch64 和 RV64GC RISC-V 上运行未经修改的 Linux 用户态程序，并在执行过程中把代码翻译到代码缓存里运行。事件驱动的 C 插件 API 可在代码扫描与执行事件上注册回调并生成插桩代码；示例插件可统计指令构成、分支与基本块次数，跟踪内存访问和系统调用，查找热点，模拟缓存，检查内存错误并检测数据竞争。
requirements: The reviewed master commit of 2025-01-21 updates the HiPEAC 2025 tutorial. There are no versioned releases; GitHub releases 1 and 2 only host talk slides. The README says application compatibility is improved as needed, lists SPEC CPU2006, PARSEC 3.0, GCC, LibreOffice and GIMP among programs that work on Arm, and notes that most development happens in a private tree.

Builds and runs on an Armv7, Armv8 or RV64GC Linux system, physical or virtual, with GCC, libelf development files and Ruby 1.9.1+; the build generates instruction encoders and decoders from the bundled PIE specifications and links dbm statically. The authors use armhf/arm64 Debian, Ubuntu and Arch Linux ARM and Ubuntu 22.04 on RISC-V; for other hosts, a Dockerfile downloads Ubuntu 24.04 preinstalled server images for Arm64 and RISC-V and runs them under QEMU. Plugins are compiled in through the makefile's PLUGINS list.

Known issues listed in the README: SA_SIGINFO handlers receive incorrect siginfo_t data, synchronous-signal handlers cannot sigreturn, code-cache invalidation after munmap or cache flushes only happens in the calling thread, and RISC-V signal handling is incomplete. MAMBO is not designed to protect itself from the program it translates, so the README says it cannot serve as a secure sandbox without hardening.

CI builds MAMBO in Ubuntu 20.04 chroots under QEMU user emulation for arm64, armhf and riscv64 and only runs /bin/ls under it; the instruction, signal and self-modifying-code programs in test/ are not run by CI. The authors ask users to cite their 2016 ACM TACO paper and list later ICPE 2018, CC 2020, VEE 2020 and ISPASS 2023 papers.
Apache-2.0, with the same license in pie/. Programs to instrument are supplied by the user.

name: garmin-ble: a Python client for Garmin's GFDI watch protocol
description_en: Python library that talks to Garmin watches over their proprietary GFDI V2 Bluetooth LE protocol, with no Garmin Connect, phone or cloud service. It implements the handshake, multi-link routing, COBS framing, CRC16 checks and protobuf service messages, streams typed readings such as heart rate, HRV, SpO2, stress, Body Battery and accelerometer data, and adds a simulator and recorded-session replay for work without hardware. Its acknowledgements credit Gadgetbridge for the protocol logic and schemas, while a published journal shows how the author decoded the accelerometer payload, which Gadgetbridge only logged, from labelled recordings.
description_zh: 一个 Python 库，通过 Garmin 手表专有的 GFDI V2 低功耗蓝牙协议与手表通信，无需 Garmin Connect、手机或云服务。它实现了握手、多链路路由、COBS 分帧、CRC16 校验和 protobuf 服务报文，可流式读取心率、HRV、血氧、压力、Body Battery 和加速度计等类型化数据，并提供模拟器和录制会话回放，便于在没有硬件时开发。致谢部分说明协议逻辑和 schema 源自 Gadgetbridge；另有一份公开的分析记录，展示作者如何依据带标注的录制数据解出加速度计载荷，而 Gadgetbridge 此前只记录其十六进制内容。
requirements: Reviewed at main commit b662032 (2026-09-27), four commits after v0.3.2 of 2026-08-01, which is also the latest PyPI release; those commits add examples and an announcement video. pyproject marks the package Alpha and the CHANGELOG warns that the pre-1.0 API may change. The README roadmap lists BLE transport, live telemetry, the Watch API, simulator and replay as done, protobuf settings and device state as in progress, and notifications, media control and FIT/GPX file transfers as planned.

Requires the user's own Garmin watch and a Bluetooth LE adapter on the computer; the README warns that the watch allows one BLE connection at a time, so it must be disconnected from the phone first. No Garmin Connect, firmware or SDK is used, and the repository's data files are the author's labelled accelerometer recordings. The README gives no list of tested watches; the bundled simulator profiles model a fenix 7 and a Venu 3, and the CHANGELOG notes that GFDI has no capability query, so a metric's support shows only when the watch accepts or declines its service.

Python 3.10+ with bleak and protobuf, installed from PyPI or from source; development extras add pytest, pytest-mock and pytest-asyncio. Compiled protobuf modules are committed next to their .proto sources, and most examples accept --simulate.

CI runs the pytest suite on Ubuntu with Python 3.10–3.13. Tests cover COBS, CRC16, GFDI, MLR and Smart framing, the bleak-backed transport with mocks, frame tracing, capture files and replay, and watch lifecycle, protobuf and telemetry behavior against the simulator. rev_eng.md documents how the 17-byte accelerometer packet was decoded from nine labelled recordings. Behavior on real watches remains author-reported.

AGPL-3.0-only, matching the Gadgetbridge-derived code the README acknowledges, although the README also calls the library clean-room. Garmin watches, apps and trademarks keep their own rights. One commit message calls the tilt game example a test of unsupervised vibe coding.

name: VanBus
description_en: Arduino library for ESP8266/ESP8285 and ESP32 boards that receives and transmits packets on the VAN (Vehicle Area Network) comfort bus that PSA fitted to Peugeot and Citroën models until about 2009. It decodes the signal from a GPIO pin, wired through a CAN transceiver or a receive-only resistor divider, in software into packets with identifier, command flags, data and a 15-bit CRC that it can check or try to repair by flipping single bits, and reports queue and error statistics. Example sketches dump raw packets, send a packet, and parse comfort-bus traffic into readable fields on the serial port or a live web page.
