The README recommends practicing on a snapshot one built oneself before analyzing another; users supply the libapp.so or snapshot to study.

samples/ commits arm-app.so and arm64-app.so, which the introduction notebook describes as builds of the default Flutter app; the samples/appjit.snapshot path it shows for AppJIT input is not committed. utils/ adds Radare2-metadata and import generators and a Node script that replays the pub package registry as of a past date through a local HTTPS proxy, using a committed self-signed CA plus a pub.dartlang.org certificate and key; that certificate expired in 2022.
AGPL-3.0.

name: ToCode
description_en: Python CLI that exports a binary, IDA database, Android APK, .NET assembly or whole application folder into a source-like project tree for coding agents: recovered C (Java for APKs, C# and IL for .NET) with matching assembly and function summaries, recovered headers and types, section dumps, JSON indexes of functions, strings, imports, exports, reachability and call-graph clusters, and generated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files. It drives IDA, Binary Ninja, radare2 with r2ghidra or angr, and for folders links each import to the defining file's function using the platform's loader rules. Its tocode mcp server keeps the decompiler open so an agent can record names, types and comments and re-render only the affected files.
description_zh: 一个 Python 命令行工具，可把二进制、IDA 数据库、Android APK、.NET 程序集或整个应用目录导出为供编码智能体阅读的类源码项目树：还原的 C 代码（APK 为 Java，.NET 为 C# 和 IL）及对应汇编与函数摘要、还原的头文件和类型、节区数据转储，函数、字符串、导入、导出、可达性和调用图聚类的 JSON 索引，以及生成的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md。它可调用 IDA、Binary Ninja、配合 r2ghidra 的 radare2 或 angr；处理目录时按各平台加载器规则，把每个导入项链接到定义它的文件中的函数。其 tocode mcp 服务会保持反编译器打开，让智能体记录名称、类型和注释，并只重新生成受影响的文件。
requirements: PyPI release at review: tocode-cli 0.3.2, uploaded 2026-10-16; the reviewed main commit is a merge commit one commit ahead of tag v0.3.2. The repository was created on 2026-05-20. It needs Python 3.10+ on Windows, Linux or macOS and installs with pip or uv, or with install.sh or install.ps1 from a clone.

A decompiler backend is not bundled: IDA through the ida-domain and idapro libraries, Binary Ninja headless where the license allows it or through its built-in MCP server or an RPC bridge in a running UI, radare2 with r2ghidra, or the optional angr extra of about 450 MB, whose pseudo-C the README calls lower quality. .NET exports need a .NET 9+ runtime and download dnlib and ICSharpCode.Decompiler from nuget.org after a prompt, checked against pinned SHA-256 hashes; APKs use the droidasc package.

Supply the binaries or application folders yourself. Exports copy section data, non-code APK entries and native libraries from the input, so they are as sensitive as the analyzed files. The README warns that the Binary Ninja RPC bridge exposes the whole Python VM without authentication and must stay bound to 127.0.0.1.

The eval directory defines a blind source-recovery benchmark: nine small C programs are built with and without debug info, a headless Claude Code agent restricted to the ToCode MCP server and file tools works on the stripped build, and a judge scores names, types, an LLM grade per function, behavior on test inputs and leakage. No benchmark results are committed; tests use generated fixtures and a fake Binary Ninja module, and the repository commits no binaries.
MIT (LICENSE, pyproject.toml). tocode skill install adds a workflow skill for Claude Code and Codex.

name: esp32_image_parser
description_en: Tenable's Python command-line tool, described in its repository as a toolkit for reverse engineering ESP32 firmware, that reads the partition table of an ESP32 flash dump and rebuilds an app partition such as factory or ota_0 as an Xtensa ELF file. Other actions list the partitions, dump a partition's raw bytes and parse an NVS partition's key-value entries as text or JSON; create_elf loads the app image with esptool, maps its flash, DRAM and IRAM segments to ELF sections and adds symbols from a bundled ROM symbol table.
description_zh: Tenable 发布的 Python 命令行工具，其仓库简介称之为辅助逆向 ESP32 固件的工具包：它读取 ESP32 闪存转储中的分区表，并将 factory、ota_0 等应用分区重建为 Xtensa ELF 文件。其他操作可列出分区、导出某个分区的原始字节，并将 NVS 分区的键值条目解析为文本或 JSON；create_elf 借助 esptool 载入应用镜像，把其中的闪存、DRAM 和 IRAM 段映射为 ELF 节区，并加入仓库自带 ROM 符号表中的符号。
requirements: No commits since 2020-02-29 and no releases or tags. Setup is pip install -r requirements.txt, which lists makeelf, esptool and hexdump without versions; the script imports esptool's module namespace and calls its LoadFirmwareImage for the original esp32 chip type.

Input is a full flash dump from the analyst's own device. The parser reads the partition table at the default 0x8000 offset, and create_elf accepts only app-type partitions and needs an output file name; segments it cannot map, such as RTC IRAM, are reported rather than converted.

The repository commits no firmware images: besides the Python scripts it holds symbols_dump.txt, a readelf-style table of about 890 symbols mostly at ESP32 ROM addresses, which create_elf reads from the current working directory into every ELF. MIT licensed (LICENSE.md).

name: Mirage
description_en: Python framework from IoT-security research at LAAS-CNRS for analysing wireless communications, with lightweight protocol stacks for Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth, Enhanced ShockBurst, Mosart, Zigbee, Wi-Fi and infrared that a command-line interpreter drives through chainable modules. For protocol analysis it offers per-protocol scan, information and sniffing modules, BLE ATT/GATT discovery that saves the discovered attribute table, HCI monitoring of an Android phone through its btsnoop log over ADB, PCAP reading and writing, and an experimental HackRF software-radio receive path with FSK demodulators and BLE and Zigbee decoders. Its author has deprecated it in favour of the WHAD tool suite.
description_zh: 源自 LAAS-CNRS 物联网安全研究的 Python 无线通信分析框架，内置低功耗蓝牙（BLE）、经典蓝牙、Enhanced ShockBurst、Mosart、Zigbee、Wi-Fi 和红外等轻量协议栈，由命令行解释器调用可串联的模块。用于协议分析时，它为各协议提供扫描、信息查询和嗅探模块，可发现 BLE 的 ATT/GATT 层并保存所得属性表，可通过 ADB 读取 Android 手机的 btsnoop 日志来监视 HCI 通信，支持读写 PCAP，并提供基于 HackRF 的实验性软件无线电接收路径，包含 FSK 解调器以及 BLE 和 Zigbee 解码器。作者已宣布弃用该项目，转而开发 WHAD 工具集。
requirements: Version 1.2 according to mirage/__init__.py; the repository has no tags or GitHub releases. The README, last edited 2025-04-13 at the reviewed commit, declares the project officially deprecated and no longer maintained and points to its successor WHAD (whad-team/whad-client); the last code change is from 2022-11-24. It installs from this source tree with setup.py, since the PyPI package named mirage is an unrelated JWST data simulator.

setup.py depends on scapy, pyusb, pyserial, pycryptodomex, keyboard, psutil, terminaltables and matplotlib, and its classifiers list Python 3.6 and Linux. Live capture needs supported radio hardware: Bluetooth HCI adapters, a BBC micro:bit running BTLEJack firmware, Nordic and Sniffle sniffers, Ubertooth, a Crazyradio PA for Enhanced ShockBurst and Mosart, an RZUSBStick for Zigbee, a Wi-Fi interface, the IRma infrared device, a ButteRFly nRF52840 dongle or a HackRF One for the experimental SDR path. Their firmware lives in separate repositories; this repository holds only Python sources and no firmware images.

Without radio hardware, PCAP files serve as input interfaces (BLE link-layer PCAPs use DLT 256), and the ADB and hcidump interfaces read HCI traffic recorded on an Android phone or Linux host. The documentation site linked from the README returned HTTP 404 at review; its Sphinx sources are on the LAAS Redmine.

The README and setup.py describe Mirage as an offensive framework whose modules and example scenarios also cover man-in-the-middle, jamming, hijacking, cloning and injection, including experimental InjectaBLE attacks. Capture only devices and networks you are authorised to observe.
MIT (LICENSE.txt, copyright 2019 Romain Cayre). The README cites SSTIC 2019 and IEEE ISSRE 2019 papers describing the framework.

name: uniden-r8-ble: reconstructing the Uniden R8 radar detector's BLE telemetry
description_en: Decodes the undocumented Bluetooth Low Energy output of a Uniden R8 radar detector into a receive-only collector for a Raspberry Pi, with live telemetry, alert start/update/end events, SQLite history and optional MQTT and Home Assistant publishing. The author worked the protocol out from the wire on a real detector, building on earlier R8w findings from AegisX86/UnidenR8wlink, and grades every claim in PROTOCOL.md by its evidence: measured on this R8, seen on another model, decompiled from an app but untested, or inference. Unknown fields are carried through raw rather than given invented meanings.
description_zh: 将 Uniden R8 雷达探测器未公开的低功耗蓝牙输出解码为可在 Raspberry Pi 上运行的只读采集程序，提供实时遥测、警报开始／更新／结束事件、SQLite 历史记录，以及可选的 MQTT 与 Home Assistant 发布。作者在真实设备上直接从通信数据推断协议，并以 AegisX86/UnidenR8wlink 先前针对 R8w 的发现为基础；PROTOCOL.md 中的每项结论都按证据分级：在这台 R8 上实测、在其他型号上见到、从应用反编译但未测试，或推断。未知字段按原始数据保留，而不赋予臆造的含义。
requirements: Reviewed at the main-branch head of 2026-09-09 (package version 0.1.0). README reports 1 Hz telemetry decoded without errors on a moving vehicle and one real Ka-band alert captured on the R8, while PROTOCOL.md still grades active-alert fields as inherited from R8w captures; it also states that the live stream carries no position, and that settings blocks remain undecoded.

Requires the user's own Uniden R8 and a Linux host with BlueZ, documented on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with an optional systemd service, gpsd-connected GNSS receiver, PiSugar battery and MQTT broker. No vendor app, firmware or captures are committed; README says raw captures are kept in a git-ignored local store, and Bluetooth addresses and coordinates are redacted before publication.

Python 3.11+, with bleak as the optional BLE extra and paho-mqtt for publishing. README says the installed package sends no application commands to the detector and that an AST audit, run by selftest and in CI, checks this; commands used for the coordinate experiments were sent from separate scripts at the owner's instruction, as SAFETY.md records.

CI runs ruff and pytest on Python 3.11–3.13 plus a selftest job; README badges 754 tests, which need no hardware, broker, gpsd or network. README notes that MQTT and the dashboard have not met real hardware.

MIT license. README states the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Uniden and is diagnostic software, not a substitute for the detector's own display or warnings. HANDOFF.md is written for a person or an agent taking over the project.

name: Redress
description_en: Command-line tool, built on the GoRE library, that recovers metadata from stripped binaries produced by the Go compiler. It reports the compiler version, build ID, GOROOT, main-package path and Go module information; lists project, standard-library and vendored packages; prints interfaces, structs and their methods as Go type declarations; and projects the source tree as packages, files and functions with estimated line ranges. Run inside radare2 through r2pipe, it adds function and type flags and analyzes main.init and main.main.
description_zh: 基于 GoRE 库的命令行工具，可从 Go 编译器生成、已剥离符号的二进制文件中恢复元数据。它能报告编译器版本、构建 ID、GOROOT、main 包路径和 Go 模块信息；列出项目包、标准库包和 vendor 包；把接口、结构体及其方法输出为 Go 类型声明；并按包、文件和函数推测源码树布局，估计各函数的行号范围。通过 r2pipe 在 radare2 中运行时，它会为函数和类型添加标记，并分析 main.init 与 main.main。
requirements: Reviewed at commit fe38d96 (2024-10-12) on develop, the default branch. The stable master branch is 96 commits ahead, all automated "Update Gore version" commits: a daily workflow bumps the GoRE dependency whenever GoRE publishes a new release, then tags and builds a release. Latest release at review: v1.2.98 (2026-10-20), built against GoRE v0.14.7, while develop's go.mod still pins v0.11.5; the README is identical on both branches.

Release archives are amd64-only builds for Linux, macOS and Windows. Source builds need Go 1.21+ according to go.mod, with Make targets for each platform; the r2 subcommand is meant to run from radare2 as #!pipe redress r2.

Input is an executable built with the Go compiler. The README's examples use a macOS cryptominer sample first reported by Malwarebytes, which the repository does not include; it commits no test binaries. GoRE recovers functions from the pclntab and types from the typelink list, fully supporting Go 1.7 and later and only partially 1.5 and 1.6, and its compiler-version detection is a string search that the GoRE README says is not perfect.

Redress is AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE). GoRE is mostly BSD-licensed, but its AGPL features such as GOROOT extraction make any build without the gore_bsd tag AGPL. Output reconstructs symbols, types and a source layout, not Go source code, and the README notes that some packages cannot be classified.

name: ghidra-nanomips
description_en: Ghidra processor module that adds nanoMIPS disassembly and decompilation through a SLEIGH specification of the little-endian 32-bit nanoMIPS instruction set, including its multithreading instructions. NCC Group's announcement says it was written while reverse engineering MediaTek 5G baseband firmware, implements the instructions met in that firmware and leaves some complex P-Code emulation unimplemented, yet decompiles most of the baseband code the team analyzed.
description_zh: 为 Ghidra 增加 nanoMIPS 反汇编和反编译能力的处理器模块，以 SLEIGH 规范描述小端 32 位 nanoMIPS 指令集，包括其多线程指令。NCC Group 的发布文章称，该模块是在逆向分析 MediaTek 5G 基带固件时编写的，实现了该固件中遇到的指令，部分复杂 P-Code 仿真尚未实现，但已能反编译团队分析过的大部分基带代码。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.3.3, published 2025-11-06 from the reviewed main commit, with an extension zip built for Ghidra 11.4.2; v0.3.1 and v0.3.2 also target 11.4.2, while the README's build example uses Ghidra 11.0.3. For another Ghidra release, build from source with Gradle and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, then add the zip through File > Install Extensions.

The module defines the single language nanomips:LE:32:default, and its importer opinion file is a commented-out template, so the language is chosen manually when importing, for example for a raw binary. The README lists the nanoMIPS32 ISA, privileged-architecture, multithreading, ELF ABI and I7200 core manuals it was written from; those documents are not included.

Release notes record p-code fixes for LWM/RESTORE, BITREVH and memory references, a compiler-spec fix for a decompiler varnode error and PC-relative address display for ADDIUPC. The repository has no tests or CI, and the specification still carries TODO notes on effective-address handling.

GPL-3.0; build.gradle keeps the Apache-2.0 header of Ghidra's extension skeleton. extension.properties names James Chambers and Robert Herrera as authors. Users supply the firmware to analyze; the announcement's MediaTek walkthrough is an illustration, not a bundled sample.

name: SMDA
description_en: Python recursive disassembler library built on Capstone that recovers control-flow graphs from PE, ELF and Mach-O files, .NET assemblies, raw DEX files and memory dumps with a known base address, through x86/x64, AArch64, 32-bit ARM/Thumb, CIL and Dalvik backends. Its JSON reports list functions, basic blocks, instructions and the edges between them, enriched with symbols from imports, exports, PDB, Go, Rust and Delphi metadata, referenced strings, Windows API references inferred with the ApiScout method and position-independent code hashes. Function discovery deliberately favours completeness over precision; the README names SMDA as capa's disassembler backend and MCRIT's code-analysis layer, and IDA Pro or Binary Ninja analyses can be exported into the same report format.
description_zh: 基于 Capstone 的 Python 递归反汇编库，借助 x86/x64、AArch64、32 位 ARM/Thumb、CIL 和 Dalvik 后端，从 PE、ELF、Mach-O 文件、.NET 程序集、原始 DEX 文件以及已知基址的内存转储中恢复控制流图。其 JSON 报告列出函数、基本块、指令及其间的边，并补充来自导入表、导出表、PDB、Go、Rust 与 Delphi 元数据的符号、被引用的字符串、用 ApiScout 方法推断的 Windows API 引用以及位置无关代码哈希。函数发现有意以完整性优先于精确性；README 称 SMDA 是 capa 的反汇编后端和 MCRIT 的代码分析层，IDA Pro 或 Binary Ninja 的分析结果也可导出为同一报告格式。
requirements: Reviewed at the v5.0.1 release commit of 2026-10-20, which is also the latest GitHub release and PyPI version; v5.0.0 of 2026-10-16 added the 32-bit ARM backend. The CHANGELOG states that version numbers are a release counter, not semantic versioning, and pyproject.toml classifies the package as Beta.

pip install smda needs Python 3.11+ and pulls in capstone 5.0.2 or later below 6, demangle 0.6.0, dncil, dnfile, LIEF 0.16+ and purepdb. CI runs the tests on Python 3.11 to 3.14 on Ubuntu and on 3.11 on Windows and macOS. The analyze.py, batch_analyze.py and export scripts are not installed by pip and need a clone; the IDA frontend needs IDA Pro 8.4+, headless IDA export needs IDA 9.1+ with the optional ida-domain package, and Binary Ninja export needs a licensed Binary Ninja whose Python API is importable.

The README rates the intel backend as production quality and benchmarked against other disassemblers, AArch64 as matching IDA closely on its test corpora, and the ARM, CIL and Dalvik backends as recent; the managed backends are not benchmarked on obfuscated code and report file offsets rather than virtual addresses. Dalvik accepts raw single-DEX files only, not APKs, multi-dex, ODEX or CDEX, and recognized machine types such as big-endian ARM32, MIPS, PowerPC, SPARC and RISC-V have no backend. Binaries, memory dumps and IDA or Binary Ninja databases come from the analyst; for a headerless dump pass the architecture and base address, and ApiScout resolution needs WinAPI profiles matching the dumped system, of which data/ bundles Windows 7 SP1 and Windows XP SP3 profiles. The default analysis budget is 300 seconds, enforced cooperatively, a timed-out report is a lower bound, and synthesizing binaries from reports is experimental.

The tests use XOR-encoded binaries that are decoded in memory: programs built for the project, a DEX file whose classes are Apache HttpClient code (blockblast_classes_xored), and malware samples including Mirai builds for 12 architectures, Asprox, Cutwail, Bashlite, Komplex and njRAT, plus AArch64 Mach-O malware from Objective-See and Malpedia under tests/aarch64_macho_corpus, whose README forbids executing them. The CI benchmark additionally uses .github/workflows/data/malpedia.zip, a 74 MB password-protected Malpedia corpus whose password is a repository secret, so AGENTS.md says the benchmark cannot be reproduced locally.

BSD-2-Clause (LICENSE); NOTICE lists third-party parts, including rust_demangler-derived code under MIT and MSVC symbol names from LLVM's demangler tests under Apache-2.0 with the LLVM exception. AGENTS.md gives guidance to AI coding agents working on the code.

name: Javascript Deobfuscator
description_en: Browser-based workbench for deobfuscating JavaScript by hand, also hosted on GitHub Pages, that pairs a Monaco editor with step-by-step rewriting and evaluation commands instead of a one-click pipeline. Formatting commands beautify the code and, on a selection or the whole file, decode escaped strings, convert hex numbers, turn bracketed property access into dot notation and rename _0x-style identifiers to short names; evaluation commands push declarations onto a code stack, evaluate a selected expression against it and substitute JSON results, replace captured variables automatically and collapse chains of aliases. The README says the process is not automatic and expects the analyst to know JavaScript.
description_zh: 一个在浏览器中手动反混淆 JavaScript 的工作台，也部署在 GitHub Pages 上，以 Monaco 编辑器搭配逐步改写和求值命令，而非一键式流程。格式化命令可美化代码，并对选区或整个文件解码转义字符串、转换十六进制数字、把方括号属性访问改为点号形式、把 _0x 式标识符改为短名称；求值命令可把声明压入代码栈，在其基础上对选中的表达式求值并用 JSON 结果替换，自动替换捕获到的变量，以及合并层层别名。README 说明这一过程并非自动完成，要求分析者熟悉 JavaScript。
requirements: No releases or tags; the reviewed master commit of 2023-06-29 is the latest code change, and a CI workflow builds the Vite site on each push to master and deploys it to the gh-pages branch that serves the hosted copy. Running it locally needs Node.js and npm for vite serve or vite build; package.json requires Monaco Editor ^0.39.0, js-beautify ^1.14.8 and Vite ^4.3.9 and declares no Node.js version.

The evaluation commands pass the selected code and the code stack to JavaScript's eval in the page itself, so those parts of the obfuscated script run unsandboxed in the user's browser; the README suggests keeping the browser console open. The string, number and renaming helpers, and the console-only experimental ones, work by regular expressions, and the README warns that they can corrupt complex strings and that hex renaming does not detect name collisions.
Users paste in the script they analyze, and the editor contents are kept only in the tab's sessionStorage. package.json declares MIT, but the repository has no license file and GitHub detects none.

name: ICSim (Instrument Cluster Simulator)
description_en: OpenGarages' Instrument Cluster Simulator for practising CAN bus reverse engineering on a Linux virtual CAN interface instead of a car. One SDL window draws a dashboard whose speedometer, turn signals and door-lock indicators react to the CAN frames it sniffs, while a separate controls program turns gamepad or keyboard input into those frames and replays a recorded sample of generic CAN traffic as background noise. In training mode the arbitration IDs and byte positions behind each signal are randomized from a seed shared by both programs, and the highest difficulty level adds further random data to the target messages, so learners have to find the relevant messages themselves.
description_zh: OpenGarages 开发的仪表盘模拟器，可在 Linux 虚拟 CAN 接口上练习 CAN 总线逆向分析，而无需真车。一个 SDL 窗口绘制仪表盘，其车速表、转向灯和车门锁指示会根据它监听到的 CAN 帧变化；另一个控制程序把手柄或键盘输入转换成这些帧，并回放一段录制的通用 CAN 流量作为背景噪声。训练模式下，两个程序依据共享的随机种子打乱各信号对应的仲裁 ID 和字节位置，最高难度还会在目标报文中加入额外的随机数据，学习者必须自己找出相关报文。
requirements: Reviewed at the master head of 2025-09-18, which merged a fix for canvas glitches; the changes before it, from December 2023 and January 2024, added the Meson build and cleaned up compiler warnings. There are no tags or releases, tests or CI. The default signal layout is generic, and -m bmw switches some signals to IDs that the source labels for a BMW X1.

Runs on Linux with SocketCAN: the README creates a vcan0 virtual interface by loading the can and vcan kernel modules with sudo, and setup_vcan.sh repeats those commands. Building needs SDL2, SDL2_image and can-utils, which Meson checks for through candump; controls launches canplayer to replay data/sample-can.log and reads data files from ./data/. The README suggests an Xbox-style gamepad, and the source also maps keyboard keys; its troubleshooting notes cover SDL header paths and one Arch Linux report that needed sdl2_gfx.

The repository commits lib.o, a prebuilt x86-64 ELF object for can-utils' lib.c that both the Makefile and Meson link into icsim; the README says to rebuild it from can-utils when it does not link on another architecture. It also ships data/sample-can.log, a recorded log of generic CAN traffic used as background noise, plus PNG, SVG and layered-image artwork; it includes no vehicle firmware or software.

The exercise is to sniff the simulated bus, for example with candump, and infer which IDs and bytes drive each gauge; the controls usage text calls disabling the background traffic with -X cheating for that practice. Difficulty runs from 0 to 2, with 1 as the default, and only level 2 adds random bytes.
GPL-3.0 (LICENSE; meson.build declares GPL-3). lib.c keeps the Volkswagen Group Electronic Research copyright from can-utils, offered under BSD-style terms or GPL-2.0.

name: frida-trace (NowSecure library)
description_en: JavaScript library for Frida agents that traces native functions from a declarative description: each function is listed with its return type and input and output arguments, including pointers, UTF-8 and UTF-16 strings and byte arrays whose length is bound to another argument or the return value, with conditions such as reading an output pointer only when the call succeeds. It resolves the functions from a module's exports or a vtable, attaches Frida's Interceptor and hands one event per call to callbacks. Helper scripts in the same repository generate trace boilerplate from C headers through libclang.
description_zh: 供 Frida 代理脚本使用的 JavaScript 库，按声明式描述跟踪原生函数：每个函数都列出返回类型及输入、输出参数，参数类型包括指针、UTF-8 与 UTF-16 字符串，以及长度绑定到其他参数或返回值的字节数组，还可设置条件，例如仅在调用成功时读取输出指针。它从模块导出表或虚函数表解析函数，挂接 Frida 的 Interceptor，并为每次调用向回调传递一个事件。同一仓库中的辅助脚本可借助 libclang 从 C 头文件生成跟踪样板代码。
requirements: Not Frida's own frida-trace command-line tool, which shares the name. The latest npm release, 4.0.1 of 2025-06-16, matches the reviewed main commit 9b92c17 and ports the library to Frida 17; 4.0.0 of January 2024 moved it to ES modules.

It runs inside an agent script that the user writes, compiles (for example with frida-compile) and loads into a process Frida can attach to; it has no command-line interface of its own. Types cover bool, byte, short, int, pointer, byte arrays, UTF-8, UTF-16 and C strings, and the captured values are only as accurate as the signatures the user declares.

The header tools live in frida-trace-tools, version 3.3.0 in the repository and not published on npm; they need Node.js and frida-libclang, and the README still runs them from an older ./bin path. The bundled example host application and agent still depend on frida 16 and frida-trace ^3.0.0. The repository has no tests or CI.
MIT. Instrumentation needs a target process the user is entitled to inspect.

name: Appshark
description_en: ByteDance's static taint-analysis engine for Android APKs, designed for very large apps, that scans an app against JSON rules naming entry methods, sources, sinks and sanitizers as Jimple signatures, for vulnerability and privacy-compliance review. It works on Soot's Jimple IR and reuses FlowDroid's manifest and resource parsing, but implements its own field-sensitive pointer and taint analysis. Results go to results.json, which records app, component and permission information, deep links and JavaScript bridge interfaces alongside each source-to-sink path, with an HTML page per finding.
description_zh: 字节跳动开发的 Android APK 静态污点分析引擎，面向超大型应用设计：它依据 JSON 规则扫描应用，规则以 Jimple 签名指定入口方法、源、汇和净化器，用于漏洞与隐私合规审查。它基于 Soot 的 Jimple 中间表示，并复用 FlowDroid 的清单与资源解析模块，但指针分析和污点分析均为自行实现，且区分字段。结果写入 results.json，其中记录应用、组件和权限信息、深层链接及 JavaScript 桥接接口，以及每条从源到汇的路径，每项发现另有一个 HTML 页面。
requirements: Requires JDK 11; the README says it does not work on JDK 8 or JDK 16 because of dependency compatibility. ./gradlew build -x test produces AppShark-0.1.2-all.jar. Latest release at review: v0.1.2, published 2022-09-22 with prebuilt jars; the reviewed main commit, still versioned 0.1.2, is 123 commits ahead of it, including September 2026 commits that add scan resource budgets, a bounded jadx workspace and validation of untrusted rule graphs. The startup guide still links the v0.1.1 jar.

Input is the APK to analyze, named by apkPath in a JSON5 config passed to the jar, with rules taken from config/rules, which holds seven sample rules such as unZipSlip, PendingIntentMutable and ContentProviderPathTraversal. The repository bundles 18 Android SDK platform stub jars, config/tools/platforms/android-14 through android-33/android.jar (API levels 15 and 21 absent, about 18 to 47 MB each), used as the default SDK path, plus five small compiled test classes; the javaSource option runs jadx from config/tools/jadx/bin, which the repository does not include.

Findings are static source-to-sink paths whose coverage depends on the rules and settings: the argument guide says too short a maxPointerAnalyzeTime can cause false positives and negatives, and the FAQ shows a slice-mode entry missing an aliased path. The README's security notice limits the UI and server to local testing. Apache-2.0.

name: Wallbreaker
description_en: Frida-based explorer for the live Java heap of a running Android app, loaded as an objection plugin or used through its small Python package. classsearch and objectsearch find loaded classes by pattern and live instances of a class, returning object handles; classdump prints a class's declared fields, static field values and methods, and objectdump prints an instance's field values, can view it as a superclass and lists every entry of a collection or map. Analysts use it to see the runtime data and concrete implementations that static decompilation leaves open.
description_zh: 基于 Frida 的工具，用于查看正在运行的 Android 应用的实时 Java 堆，可作为 objection 插件加载，也可通过其小型 Python 包调用。classsearch 与 objectsearch 按模式查找已加载的类，或查找某个类的存活实例并返回对象句柄；classdump 打印类声明的字段、静态字段值和方法，objectdump 打印实例的字段值，可将其按父类查看，并列出集合或映射中的全部条目。分析者借此查看静态反编译无法确定的运行时数据和具体实现。
requirements: Archived by its owner and read-only. Latest release at review: 1.0.3, tagged and uploaded to PyPI on 2022-05-10 with no release assets; the only later commit adds the GPL-3.0 LICENSE file (2023-03-26).

README installs objection with pip and clones the repository into objection's plugin folder, then loads it with explore -P or plugin load and runs the commands as plugin wallbreaker …. The PyPI package depends on frida and click and ships the command agent as a library; its connection helper attaches through Frida to a USB or remote device by process name or PID, and wallbreaker/main.py defines no command-line entry point. setup.py classifiers list Python 3.4–3.8 on macOS, Windows and Linux.

The target is a running Android app reachable by Frida. The bundled agent.js is compiled from the repository's own TypeScript sources with frida-compile 9 and Frida 14-era typings; it calls the global Java bridge and does not bundle frida-java-bridge, which Frida 17 (May 2025) no longer provides to ordinary scripts.
GPL-3.0. Output is a structural view of objects at one moment in one process, not decompiled source.

name: Protobuf Decoder
description_en: Pawit Pornkitprasan's React web application for decoding Protocol Buffers data without the original .proto files, offered as a hosted page or run locally, with all decoding done in the browser. Pasted hex or base64 input, or an uploaded file, is split into a table of byte ranges, field numbers, wire types and contents: varints are shown as unsigned, two's-complement and zigzag integers, fixed32 and fixed64 values as integers and floating-point numbers, and length-delimited fields as nested messages when they parse cleanly, otherwise as UTF-8 strings or bytes. It skips a leading gRPC message header and can optionally split a stream of varint length-delimited messages.
description_zh: Pawit Pornkitprasan 开发的 React 网页应用，用于在没有原始 .proto 文件的情况下解码 Protocol Buffers 数据；既有在线托管页面，也可在本地运行，所有解码都在浏览器中完成。粘贴的十六进制或 base64 数据（也可上传文件）会被拆分成表格，列出字节范围、字段编号、线路类型和内容：varint 同时显示为无符号整数、补码整数和 zigzag 编码整数，fixed32 和 fixed64 显示为整数和浮点数，长度分隔字段若能完整解析则显示为嵌套报文，否则显示为 UTF-8 字符串或字节。它会跳过开头的 gRPC 报文头，还可选择按 varint 长度前缀拆分连续的多条报文。
requirements: No releases or tags; package.json declares a private 0.1.0 package. The reviewed master commit of 2026-10-17 is a Dependabot dependency bump, and the most recent functional changes added file upload in 2024 and varint length-delimited input in 2025. CircleCI runs the Vitest unit tests on Node 20.11 and uploads coverage to Codecov.

The hosted page at protobuf-decoder.netlify.app needs only a browser, and the app states that all decoding is done locally in JavaScript. Running it locally needs Node.js and npm: npm install, then npm start for the Vite development server, or npm run build for a static build.

Decoding is schema-less and heuristic: field names and declared types are not recovered, each length-delimited field is guessed to be a nested message, string or bytes, the source marks repeated-field support as a TODO, and the group wire types are not handled, so decoding stops there and the remaining input is shown as left-over bytes. It only decodes; there is no editing, re-encoding or proxy integration, and users supply their own captured messages.
MIT (Copyright 2019 Pawit Pornkitprasan).

name: BTD (Bin To DNN)
description_en: Research artifact for the USENIX Security 2023 paper “Decompiling x86 Deep Neural Network Executables”. BTD decompiles x86 executables emitted by the DNN compilers TVM, Glow and NNFusion into model specifications: operator types, network topology, dimensions and parameters such as weights and biases. It splits IDA disassembly into functions, infers each operator's type with a trained classifier over assembly tokens, records Intel Pin traces filtered by taint analysis, recovers dimensions and parameters with a trace-based symbolic execution engine, then rebuilds the model in PyTorch and compares its output with the original executable.
description_zh: USENIX Security 2023 论文《Decompiling x86 Deep Neural Network Executables》的研究产物。BTD 将 DNN 编译器 TVM、Glow 和 NNFusion 生成的 x86 可执行文件反编译为模型规格：算子类型、网络拓扑、维度以及权重和偏置等参数。它把 IDA 的反汇编结果拆分为函数，用基于汇编词元训练的分类器推断每个算子的类型，用 Intel Pin 记录执行轨迹并经污点分析过滤，借助基于轨迹的符号执行引擎恢复维度和参数，最后在 PyTorch 中重建模型，并将其输出与原可执行文件对比。
requirements: Research artifact with no tagged releases; the reviewed master commit (2026-03-13) fixes README typos. The paper appears in the USENIX Security 2023 proceedings, arXiv 2210.01075 is the authors' 25-page extended version, and the README reports Available, Functional and Reproduced artifact-evaluation badges.

README prerequisites: Ubuntu 18.04, gcc/g++ 7.5, Python 3.6.9+ with numpy 1.19.5, torch 1.9+, torchvision 0.11.2, fastBPE and tqdm, Intel Pin 3.14, and IDA Pro 7.5 for disassembly. IDA is commercial and not included, so precomputed disassembly is supplied; the authors recommend their Docker image. Their server had 256 GB RAM, and logging and filtering traces for every executable took over a week and nearly 1 TB, so filtered traces are shipped and the rest of the evaluation takes about a day and under 120 GB.

Evaluation inputs are downloaded separately from Dropbox or the Zenodo dataset (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7219867): 63 executables built from 7 ONNX models with Glow 2020–2022 and TVM v0.7–v0.9.dev at O0 and O3, their disassembly and filtered traces, operator-inference training data and checkpoints, and the Docker image. The repository itself commits scripts, Pin tool sources, per-executable JSON metadata and a cat test image stored as input tensors in cat.bin and cat_transpose.bin.

Scope is x86 CPU executables from the evaluated compiler versions; the main evaluation covers TVM and Glow, with NNFusion handled by separate scripts. Per-model decompilation scripts under evaluation/ serve as the interface rather than a general command-line tool.

HKUST Academic Software License (LICENSE, COPYING): academic or nonprofit researchers may use, copy and modify it for educational or academic research only, and publications must include the stated acknowledgment; GitHub reports no SPDX license.

name: opendash: reconstructing the Scanmatik SM3 J2534 adapter protocol
description_en: Speaks the undocumented protocol of the Scanmatik SM3, a J2534 vehicle interface that otherwise talks only to its own Windows software, and exposes it to an Android phone as an ELM327 bridge with a diagnostics app on top. The author recovered the framing — a 16-byte header with sequence, CRC-based and sum-based check words, opcode and length — by capturing the device's bundled driver and measuring the replies, and docs/protocol.md separates what was established from what is still open. Reported results come from one Opel Astra J over five sessions with the car present.
description_zh: 直接使用 Scanmatik SM3 未公开的协议——这款 J2534 车辆接口原本只与自家 Windows 软件通信——并以 ELM327 桥接的形式提供给 Android 手机，其上还有一个诊断应用。作者通过抓取设备随附驱动的通信并测量响应，恢复了报文结构：包含序号、基于 CRC 与求和的校验字、操作码和长度的 16 字节报头；docs/protocol.md 区分了已确认与仍待解决的部分。所报告的结果来自一辆 Opel Astra J、共五次有车在场的测试。
requirements: Reviewed at the main-branch head of 2026-10-16, one README-only commit after the v0.4.2-beta release. README reports reading identification, standard OBD-II data and GM service 0x22 parameters, and module-driven streaming at about 98.7 Hz per packet, on one Opel Astra J 1.7 CDTI; the ELM327 bridge has been exercised against emulated modules but not yet against the car, and two long recordings stopped early for reasons not yet understood.

Requires the user's own Scanmatik SM3 reached over its Wi-Fi access point. Standard SAE J1979 PIDs ship with the app; richer per-brand catalogues are generated from a GM GDS2 installation the user already has, and README says they are not distributed because the data belongs to GM. No catalogue data, vendor driver, firmware or driving recordings are committed.

The app is read-only by design: README lists the diagnostic services it permits, and requests that write data, control inputs and outputs or routines, clear codes or request security access are refused before reaching the socket. One known actuator command sits behind a settings switch that requires the phone's device lock and is off by default.

Android 8.0+ app built with Gradle, AGP 9.4.1, Kotlin 2.4.20 and JDK 21. A separate Rust core implements framing, check words, ISO-TP and ELM327 handling but is not yet wired into the app, whose Kotlin bridge README says has moved ahead of it. CI runs cargo test, which replays 200 recorded writes and checks the computed check word against what the device sent, and builds the debug APK without the Rust core; Kotlin unit tests exist but are not run in CI.
GPL-3.0 (LICENSE). Scanmatik, GM, GDS2 and Opel remain trademarks of their owners.

name: Reverse API Engineer
description_en: Python CLI that turns the HTTP traffic a website actually produces into a typed API client. A browser session, driven by the user through Playwright or by an AI agent through Playwright or Chrome DevTools MCP servers or Vercel's agent-browser CLI, is recorded to a HAR file; a coding agent run through the Claude Agent SDK, OpenCode, Cursor or GitHub Copilot then reads the capture and writes a client, README and usage example in one of ten languages. A separate collector mode gathers structured JSON/CSV data with web search and fetch.
description_zh: 把网站实际产生的 HTTP 流量转换为带类型 API 客户端的 Python 命令行工具。浏览器会话可由用户通过 Playwright 操作，也可由 AI 智能体借助 Playwright 或 Chrome DevTools MCP 服务、或 Vercel 的 agent-browser 命令行来驱动，并记录为 HAR 文件；随后由经 Claude Agent SDK、OpenCode、Cursor 或 GitHub Copilot 运行的编码智能体读取该记录，以十种语言之一编写客户端、README 和用法示例。另有独立的 collector 模式，借助网页搜索与抓取收集 JSON/CSV 结构化数据。
requirements: Reviewed at main commit 4e15017 (2026-10-26). The latest release is v0.14.0, published on GitHub and PyPI on 2026-09-23; the changelog's unreleased section adds security dependency updates. pyproject marks the project beta and requires Python 3.11+, the README supports Linux, Apple Silicon macOS and 64-bit Windows because of its cryptography dependency, and CI runs ruff, mypy and pytest on Linux, macOS and Windows with Python 3.11 to 3.13.

Agent mode launches its browser tooling through npx, so it needs Node.js; the chrome-mcp provider drives the user's real Chrome with existing sessions and cookies and needs Chrome 146+ and Node.js 20.19+. Manual mode needs the [manual] extra and a Playwright Chromium. Generation needs a model backend: the default SDK is the Claude Agent SDK with Sonnet 4.6, and the README asks for an API key for agent mode, while OpenCode starts with a free default model and can use locally installed Ollama models that support tool calling and a 64k+ context.

The input is traffic from sites the user browses. The engineer prompt tells the model to hardcode every credential, cookie, token and session value found in the HAR, so captures and generated clients must be handled as secrets. The README warns that generated code runs locally and should be reviewed before it is executed, and that sites with aggressive bot detection may block capture; generated clients call undocumented internal endpoints that can change, and their use stays subject to each site's terms.

The examples directory holds generated clients for public endpoints of Apple and Uber careers, Ashby job boards, AutoScout24 listings, IKEA's catalog and Mintlify's documentation assistant. An optional local check generates a client for a fixture website and verifies it against changed live responses. MIT license. Its RAE abbreviation stands for Reverse API Engineer.

name: go-fAST
description_en: Go library for parsing, traversing, transforming and regenerating JavaScript abstract syntax trees, which its README presents for code analysis, obfuscation and deobfuscation. Its parser builds on goja's parsing code, a generated SWC-style visitor API supports depth-first rewriting and cloning of nodes, a resolver tracks scopes and bindings, the ext package adds node-removal, side-effect and value-inference helpers, and a generator prints JavaScript from the tree. The documentation calls it a lightweight, faster alternative to Babel that deliberately omits parent, sibling and reference maps and automated mutation helpers.
description_zh: 一个用 Go 编写的库，用于解析、遍历、转换和重新生成 JavaScript 抽象语法树，README 将其定位于代码分析以及混淆与反混淆。其解析器基于 goja 的解析代码，自动生成的 SWC 式访问者 API 支持深度优先地改写和克隆节点，解析器（resolver）跟踪作用域与绑定，ext 包提供删除节点、判断副作用和推断取值的辅助函数，代码生成器则从语法树输出 JavaScript。文档称它是比 Babel 更轻、更快的替代品，并刻意省去了父节点、兄弟节点和引用映射以及自动化的修改辅助功能。
requirements: Latest tag at review: v0.1.0, created 2026-07-02 and served by the Go module proxy under the lowercase module path github.com/t14raptor/go-fast; there are no GitHub releases. The reviewed master commit of 2026-10-04 is 11 commits ahead of that tag, with parser, resolver and generator fixes and a new PreserveParens parse option.

go.mod requires Go 1.24 and depends only on nukilabs/ftoa and nukilabs/unicodeid. Unit tests cover the parser, generator, resolver and statement helpers, but the only CI workflow checks that the generated union, visitor and clone files are up to date and does not run them. Guides and example visitors, such as unrolling sequence expressions and expanding variable declarations, are on the project's GitBook documentation site.

It is a library rather than a ready-made deobfuscator: users write their own visitors for the transformations they need and supply the JavaScript they analyze. The README does not state which ECMAScript versions it parses.
MIT (copyright 2024 T14Raptor); the README credits goja for parsing code and SWC for the visitor API design.

name: OpenBaud
description_en: Rust MCP server and Codex plugin that gives coding agents audited access to local serial devices, from identifying ports by USB metadata and sending framed requests to recording every received and transmitted byte in lossless .obcap captures. Device behaviour confirmed during exploration is kept as YAML device profiles, typed commands and workflows that validate checksums and decode scalars, bit fields and record arrays, and the same commands can be replayed against a capture without hardware. Its worked demo decodes OBP/1, a small binary protocol the author wrote for an ESP32-S3 test board, not an existing vendor protocol.
description_zh: 以 Rust 编写的 MCP 服务器兼 Codex 插件，为编程智能体提供可审计的本地串口设备访问：按 USB 元数据识别端口、发送分帧请求，并把收发的每个字节记录到无损的 .obcap 捕获文件中。探索中确认的设备行为保存为 YAML 设备配置、类型化命令和工作流，可校验校验和并解码标量、位字段和记录数组；同样的命令还能在没有硬件时对捕获文件重放。其完整演示解码的是作者为 ESP32-S3 测试板编写的小型二进制协议 OBP/1，而非现有的厂商协议。
requirements: A young project: the repository was created on 2026-08-23 and had 48 commits at the reviewed v0.3.0 release commit of 2026-10-09. Cargo.toml declares version 0.3.0 and rust-toolchain.toml pins Rust 1.96.0. The README and plugin guide document installation only for Codex, through codex plugin marketplace add with the stable branch or a release archive; the server itself runs as openbaud mcp over stdio, and no other MCP client is documented.

The v0.3.0 release provides plugin archives for macOS ARM64 and Intel, Linux x64 and ARM64, Windows x64 and a universal bundle, each with a SHA-256 file. The Node launcher needs Node.js 18+, and macOS binaries are ad-hoc signed but not notarized. A source checkout commits only the project's own macOS ARM64 runtime build, plugins/openbaud/bin/darwin-arm64/openbaud with a SHA-256 sidecar; other hosts build their runtime with plugins/openbaud/scripts/build-runtime and a Rust toolchain.

Requires the user's own serial or USB-serial hardware. MCP tools cover listing and opening ports, raw read, send and request, running stored commands and workflows, captures, frame diagnosis and session statistics. Raw writes and device commands are marked potentially destructive, writes go to an append-only audit log, commands declared risk: danger need explicit acknowledgement, and commands with requires preconditions are refused until the session has established that device state. The README warns that serial writes can reconfigure or actuate hardware and advises starting unknown devices read-only.

The example workspace holds a real OBP/1 request/response capture recorded from the author's ESP32-S3 board on 2026-08-24, whose radar points are generated by test firmware and flagged simulated_scene on the wire, and further captures whose notes describe a serial protocol tester sweep of AT, ELM327 OBD-II, Marlin, GPS NMEA and particulate-sensor framings. The reviewed tree contains no firmware, including that test firmware, and the media/pv directory the README cites for the demo video source is absent at this commit. CI runs Clippy, package validation, tests, native builds and MCP smoke tests on the five supported hosts.

MIT (LICENSE, Cargo.toml). The bundled skill tells agents to use OpenBaud's tools instead of ad-hoc shell serial access and to record verified behaviour as reusable commands; these are the project's own workflow rules.

name: Tigard
description_en: Open-hardware board built around the FTDI FT2232H that connects a computer to a target device's UART, SPI, I2C, JTAG and SWD interfaces through level shifters that operate from 1.8 to 5.5 V. One of the chip's two ports is dedicated to UART and the other is shared by the remaining interfaces; switches select the reference voltage and the SPI/JTAG or I2C/SWD wiring, and a logic-analyzer header lets an external analyzer watch the traffic. Tigard has no software of its own: it is designed to work with existing x232H tools, and the README gives settings for reading SPI flash, JTAG debugging with OpenOCD or Black Magic Debug, SWD debugging with OpenOCD, boundary scan, and iCE40 or AVR programming.
description_zh: 以 FTDI FT2232H 为核心的开源硬件板卡，通过工作电压为 1.8–5.5 V 的电平转换器，把计算机连接到目标设备的 UART、SPI、I2C、JTAG 和 SWD 接口。芯片的两个端口中，一个专用于 UART，另一个由其余接口共用；拨动开关用于选择参考电压以及 SPI/JTAG 或 I2C/SWD 接线方式，逻辑分析仪排针则可让外接分析仪观察通信。Tigard 本身不带软件，而是按现有 x232H 工具的支持方式设计；README 给出了读取 SPI 闪存、用 OpenOCD 或 Black Magic Debug 进行 JTAG 调试、用 OpenOCD 进行 SWD 调试、边界扫描，以及为 iCE40 或 AVR 编程的设置方法。
requirements: Requires a Tigard board, bought assembled from the sellers the README lists (Crowd Supply, Mouser, 1BitSquared and SecuringHardware.com) or built from the published design, plus physical access and wiring to the target. The README's hookup sequence starts with the voltage switch on VTGT and distinguishes target-powered, Tigard-powered and self-powered setups; for in-circuit SPI work it says to make sure no other device is communicating with the flash chip.

master holds the v1.1 design files for KiCad 5 (schematic, PCB, footprints, 3D models and a render), unchanged since release v1.1 of 2021-09-21 apart from README and .gitignore updates; the newest commit, from 2026-10-08, adds Black Magic Debug to the README. Release v1.2, published 2026-05-29 from a separate v1.2 branch, moves the design to KiCad 9 and attaches Tigard_v1.2.zip, and its notes state no functional difference from v1.1. The repository contains no firmware or host software.

Host tools are separate projects with FT2232H support: USB-serial drivers for UART, flashrom, pyftdi or libmpsse for SPI and I2C, OpenOCD (the README's JTAG and SWD configurations need v0.12+), Black Magic Debug, UrJTAG and the commercial, Windows-only TopJTAG for boundary scan, iceprog, and avrdude, which has built-in Tigard support from 7.1. The README notes FT2232H limits for I2C (controller mode only, no clock stretching, possible conflicts with other controllers) and reports that UrJTAG runs TCK about five times faster than requested.

CC-BY-SA 4.0 (LICENSE.txt, copyright 2020 Franklin Harding), which GitHub does not classify. The README encourages home-built boards but asks their makers to use another color, accurate USB manufacturer descriptors and serial numbers without the TG prefix. Data read from a target keeps its owner's rights.

name: axmlprinter
description_en: Java library and command-line tool that parses Android binary XML, such as the compiled AndroidManifest.xml inside an APK, and prints it as readable XML. Red Naga's near-complete rewrite of the Android4ME AXMLPrinter tolerates manipulated files seen in the wild, including out-of-order string tables and mangled start tags, and can write the classic AXML format back out. Since v2.0.0 it also reads the protobuf XML used in Android App Bundles and detects which format it was given.
description_zh: 用于解析 Android 二进制 XML（例如 APK 中编译后的 AndroidManifest.xml）并输出为可读 XML 的 Java 库和命令行工具。它是 Red Naga 对 Android4ME AXMLPrinter 几乎全部重写的版本，能够处理实际样本中被篡改的文件，包括字符串表乱序和起始标签被改写等情况，并可重新写出传统 AXML 格式。自 v2.0.0 起，它还能读取 Android App Bundle 使用的 protobuf 格式 XML，并自动识别输入格式。
requirements: Latest release v2.0.1, published 2026-03-25 with a prebuilt jar, is tagged at the reviewed master commit 5a8d3e5. v2.0.0 of 2026-01-16 added read-only protobuf support through a contributed pull request; converting between AXML and protobuf is not supported.

Build with the Gradle wrapper (./gradlew jar) into a self-contained jar run as java -jar axmlprinter-*.jar with a binary XML file and an optional output path, which applies to AXML only. CI builds and tests on JDK 17, and JitPack builds with OpenJDK 17; it depends on protobuf-java 4.34.1 and includes AOSP's Apache-2.0 aapt2 Resources.proto. Framework resource IDs are resolved only for common Android resources.

Input is a single compiled XML file the analyst has already taken from an APK or app bundle, not the archive itself. The tests include binary manifest fixtures named large_from_malware.xml and qihoo_jiagu_issue8.xml, the latter from an issue about a manifest that failed to parse, plus a smaller test.xml.
Apache-2.0, crediting Android4ME's 2008 code alongside Red Naga's.

name: Hetty
description_en: Open-source HTTP toolkit for security research, which its author aims to make an alternative to Burp Suite Pro. A single Go binary runs a machine-in-the-middle HTTP proxy backed by its own generated root CA, logs proxied requests and responses in per-project databases with search filters and scope rules, and serves a web admin interface. From that interface an analyst can hold requests and responses for manual review, then edit, forward or cancel them, or copy logged requests into a Sender module to edit and resend them.
description_zh: 用于安全研究的开源 HTTP 工具包，作者希望把它做成 Burp Suite Pro 的替代品。单个 Go 程序即可运行一个使用自生成根 CA 的中间人 HTTP 代理，把经过代理的请求和响应记录到按项目划分的数据库中，支持搜索过滤和范围规则，并提供 Web 管理界面。分析者可在界面中拦下请求和响应进行人工检查，再编辑、放行或取消；也可把已记录的请求复制到 Sender 模块，修改后重新发送。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.7.0, published 2022-03-29, with Linux, macOS and Windows builds for x86_64 and arm64; the README also lists Homebrew, snap and Scoop packages and Docker images. The reviewed main commit (2026-06-27) is 14 commits ahead of that release, among them the January 2025 switch from BadgerDB to a single bbolt database file (by default hetty.db in the .hetty folder of the user's home directory). The hetty.xyz getting-started guide still describes the older BadgerDB directory. The README says Hetty is under active development.

Run hetty, open the admin interface on port 8080 and create a project; only then are proxied requests logged. By default the server listens on all interfaces (:8080). On first start Hetty creates a root CA certificate and private key in that .hetty folder. To inspect HTTPS from their own browser, analysts trust that CA (hetty cert install adds it to the system trust store, and optionally to Firefox and Java) or use --chrome, which launches Chrome with the proxy settings applied and certificate errors ignored. Hetty logs only traffic from clients the analyst points at the proxy; the docs recommend the --chrome profile or a browser proxy extension over system-wide proxy settings.

Source builds need Go 1.23 and Yarn: the Makefile builds the Next.js admin interface and embeds it into the Go binary with CGO disabled. The README's link to source-build instructions is still marked as coming soon.
MIT license (© 2019–2025 Hetty Software). The README's feature list covers proxy logs with search, the request sender, interception, scope and project storage.

name: FlowDroid
description_en: Static data-flow (taint) analysis for Android apps and Java programs, built on Soot and usable as a command-line tool or as Maven libraries. Given an APK, the Android SDK platforms directory and a definition of sources and sinks, it models component lifecycles and callbacks to build a call graph and reports flows from sensitive sources to sinks; the bundled SourcesAndSinks.txt is a starting point for privacy leaks, and StubDroid summaries model library methods. Options cover inter-component flows from a supplied ICC model file, path reconstruction, implicit flows, reflection and timeouts that trade precision and recall for speed, and the analysis is described in the PLDI 2014 paper “FlowDroid: precise context, flow, field, object-sensitive and lifecycle-aware taint analysis for Android apps”.
description_zh: 面向 Android 应用和 Java 程序的静态数据流（污点）分析工具，基于 Soot 构建，可作为命令行工具使用，也可作为 Maven 库集成。输入 APK、Android SDK 的 platforms 目录以及源点和汇点定义后，它会对组件生命周期和回调建模以构建调用图，并报告从敏感源点流向汇点的数据流；随附的 SourcesAndSinks.txt 可作为分析隐私泄露的起点，StubDroid 摘要则用于对库方法建模。选项涵盖依据用户提供的 ICC 模型文件分析组件间数据流、路径重建、隐式流、反射，以及用精度和召回率换取速度的超时设置；其分析方法发表于 PLDI 2014 论文《FlowDroid: precise context, flow, field, object-sensitive and lifecycle-aware taint analysis for Android apps》。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.15.1, tagged 2026-02-23 and published to Maven Central under de.fraunhofer.sit.sse.flowdroid, including soot-infoflow-cmd-2.15.1-jar-with-dependencies.jar for the command line. GitHub releases since v2.14 attach no files, the last with JARs being v2.13 of 2024-04-02, and the README's Maven example still names 2.12.0. The reviewed develop commit of 2026-09-28 declares 2.16.0-SNAPSHOT.

The command line needs an APK, the Android SDK platforms directory and a sources-and-sinks file, and users supply the apps they analyze. The README says FlowDroid runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and warns that large apps can take very long; options skip static-field or exceptional flows, and additive timeouts for the data-flow, callback-collection and result stages return partial results.

Building needs Maven, a JDK and the current Soot snapshot; the README asks for JDK 11 or above, but the reviewed pom.xml compiles for Java 17 against Soot 4.8.0-SNAPSHOT. The README says the full test suite takes about 30 minutes and also needs JDK 8 with its rt.jar, the ANDROID_JARS variable and the DroidBench submodule, a separate repository of benchmark apps.

The repository commits 25 APKs as test inputs: test apps named after the cases they exercise, such as SourceToSink1.apk and ThreadRunnable.apk, under soot-infoflow-android/testAPKs and soot-infoflow-integration/testAPKs, the deliberately vulnerable InsecureBank.apk, and one hash-named APK whose manifest identifies another developer's app (com.RZStudio.cube). soot-infoflow-android/lib holds JUnit, Hamcrest and protobuf-java JARs.
LGPL-2.1; the README notes that modified versions must be shared under the LGPL. Results depend on the configuration and on the chosen sources and sinks.

name: Boomerang Decompiler
description_en: Fork of the SourceForge Boomerang project, a general machine-code decompiler that translates executables into C. The README lists x86 (IA-32 only), PowerPC and ST20 code in ELF, PE, DOS MZ, DOS/4GW LE and Mach-O files; instruction semantics are defined in SSL specification files, and library signature files plus printf- and scanf-style format strings help recover types. It provides a boomerang-cli command-line tool and a Qt boomerang-gui application, with unit, regression and recompilation test suites.
description_zh: SourceForge 上 Boomerang 项目的分支，是一款通用的机器码反编译器，可将可执行文件转换为 C 代码。README 列出的支持范围为 ELF、PE、DOS MZ、DOS/4GW LE 和 Mach-O 文件中的 x86（仅 IA-32）、PowerPC 和 ST20 代码；指令语义由 SSL 规格文件定义，库函数签名文件以及 printf、scanf 类格式字符串可辅助恢复类型。它提供 boomerang-cli 命令行工具和基于 Qt 的 boomerang-gui 图形界面，并附有单元、回归和重编译测试套件。
requirements: Inactive legacy project: the reviewed develop commit of 2020-12-28 is the repository's last push, and the Changelog still marks v0.6.0 as in development. The last release, v0.5.2 (2020-01-11), provides Linux x86_64 and Windows x64 builds, while the README recommends building develop from source.

Building needs a 64-bit OS, a C++17 compiler (GCC 7+, Clang 6+ or MSVC 2017+), CMake 3.13+, Qt5 (5.12+ known to work), Capstone 4.0.1+, GNU bison 3.3+ and flex 2.6+; Python 3 runs the regression tests, which are not supported on Windows. The README documents Linux, macOS 10.13+ with Xcode 10 and Homebrew, and Windows with Visual Studio 2017.
Supply the executable to decompile. x86 support covers 32-bit code only, the v0.6.0 development line removed SPARC support, and the generated C needs analyst review.

data/samples commits about 240 small test binaries for macOS, DOS, ELF, PowerPC, Windows and x86, most named after the test programs in tests/recompilation-tests and tests/sources, plus three Linux distribution builds of the true utility; tests/regression-tests stores the expected decompiler output for them. data/signatures holds hand-written library prototype files, not vendor headers.
BSD-style terms in LICENSE.TERMS, carried over from the University of Queensland, Sun Microsystems and the original authors; GitHub reports no SPDX match.

name: UBI Reader
description_en: Python module and command-line scripts that read UBI and UBIFS images, including ones inside raw NAND dumps, by locating the first UBI or UBIFS data in a file. They extract files or whole UBI and UBIFS images, list and copy single files, display UBI headers, volume tables and the UBIFS super and master nodes, and search physical erase blocks when debugging failed extractions. ubireader_utils_info also derives the mtd-utils parameters, written as a shell script and config file, needed to rebuild an image to the same specification.
description_zh: 读取 UBI 和 UBIFS 镜像的 Python 模块与命令行脚本，通过定位文件中首个 UBI 或 UBIFS 数据来处理镜像，也适用于原始 NAND 转储。它们可提取文件或完整的 UBI、UBIFS 镜像，列出并复制单个文件，显示 UBI 头部、卷表以及 UBIFS 的超级节点和主节点，并能在提取失败时按条件搜索物理擦除块进行调试。ubireader_utils_info 还能推算出 mtd-utils 参数，生成按相同规格重建镜像所需的 shell 脚本和配置文件。
requirements: Reviewed at main commit 5f45e50 (2026-09-13). The latest release is 0.8.16, published on 2026-09-04 on GitHub and as the ubi-reader package on PyPI; pyproject lists ONEKEY and Jason Pruitt as authors, and unblob's reviewed main commit depends on ubi-reader>=0.8.15. The README's separate testing branch, with repair tools and parameter overrides for broken images, was last updated in 2018.

Requires Python 3.10+, installed from PyPI or from source with Poetry; dependencies are lzallright for LZO, zstandard and cryptography. Creating special files during extraction needs root, and socket files are skipped unless settings.py is changed. Files encrypted with an fscrypt v1 policy are decrypted only when the user supplies the master key.

Input is a UBI or UBIFS image or NAND dump that the user supplies. The repository commits no firmware or flash images; its only test checks the guard against path traversal in extracted file names, and CI runs it with pytest on Python 3.10.

Known issues in the README: the journal is not replayed, so uncommitted data is not recovered, and depending on how the NAND was dumped the data bits may not be error-corrected. Offsets and PEB or LEB sizes can be given when guessing fails. GPL-3.0 (LICENSE; pyproject says GNU GPL); extracted firmware contents keep their vendors' rights.

name: ktool
description_en: Pure-Python toolkit for static Mach-O and Objective-C analysis, used as the ktool command line, a terminal browser (ktool open) or a library, with no compiled dependencies. Its commands print load commands, linked libraries, symbol tables, imports and exports, Objective-C classes and protocols, Swift types, function starts and code-signing entitlements, and dump reconstructed Objective-C headers or .tbd stubs. It can also list and extract kexts from kernel caches, split and combine fat binaries, change install names and insert load commands.
description_zh: 纯 Python 编写的 Mach-O 与 Objective-C 静态分析工具包，可作为 ktool 命令行、终端浏览界面（ktool open）或程序库使用，没有需要编译的依赖。其命令可列出加载命令、链接库、符号表、导入与导出符号、Objective-C 类和协议、Swift 类型、函数起始地址以及代码签名权限（entitlements），并可导出重建的 Objective-C 头文件或 .tbd 存根。它还能列出并提取内核缓存中的 kext，拆分和合并 fat 二进制文件，修改安装名并插入加载命令。
requirements: Latest PyPI release at review: k2l 2.0.0, uploaded 2024-01-10 and also tagged on GitHub. The reviewed master head of 2026-03-07 declares version 2.1.2 in pyproject.toml, which has not been published. The README marks the terminal GUI as still in active development and lists file and img4 utilities that the reviewed command parser does not define.

Install with pip install k2l: the package requires Python 3.6.2 or later, depends on Pygments and adds windows-curses on Windows. The README reports running it on Windows, macOS, Linux (including ARM64), iOS through iSH, Android through Termux, WebAssembly and Brython. Unless KTOOL_NO_UPDATE_CHECK is set, each run asks PyPI for a newer k2l in a background thread.

Inputs are Mach-O files, fat binaries or kernel caches the user supplies; the repository commits no Mach-O binaries. tests/src holds two small Objective-C test sources, an entitlements plist and libSystem.tbd, a text-based stub of the watchOS libSystem export list of the kind found in Apple's SDKs, used to link the arm64_32 test build; tests/build.ninja compiles the test binaries locally with Xcode's clang, lipo and codesign.
The macOS GitHub Actions workflow builds those test binaries, runs tests/unit.py and exercises the insert, edit, lipo, dump and symbols commands; its run on the reviewed commit failed.

MIT (LICENSE, copyright 2021 _kritanta). EXTERNAL_LICENSES notes that the chained-fixup code is based on the author's code for Binary Ninja's Mach-O view plugin and includes an Apache-2.0 license for it.

name: JADX MCP Server (Qtty)
description_en: MCP server for Android APK analysis in which a Python FastMCP process talks to the agent over stdio and drives a long-lived local JVM daemon that embeds JADX 1.5.6 as a library, so no JADX GUI is involved and a loaded APK stays warm between sessions. Its 23 tools return classes, decompiled sources with size-capped outlines, methods, fields, smali, cross-references and callees read from a dex-derived index, type hierarchies and overrides, exported and deep-link components, the manifest and resource files, plus a whole-APK sweep for framework sink call sites grouped by impact category.
description_zh: 用于 Android APK 分析的 MCP 服务：Python FastMCP 进程通过 stdio 与智能体通信，并驱动一个常驻本地的 JVM 守护进程，后者以库的形式内嵌 JADX 1.5.6，因此无需 JADX 图形界面，已加载的 APK 也能在会话之间保持就绪。它的 23 个工具可返回类列表、超出大小上限时改为大纲的反编译源码、方法、字段、smali、基于 dex 索引的交叉引用与被调函数、类型层次与重写关系、导出组件和深层链接组件、清单与资源文件，并能在整个 APK 中按影响类别扫描框架敏感调用点。
requirements: The repository has a single commit, dated 2026-08-20, and no releases or tags. Its GitHub description still calls it a pure-Java MCP server; README explains that the MCP layer moved to Python after concurrent tool calls hung the Java SDK's transport. Unlike JADX-AI-MCP, it uses no JADX GUI plugin.

Building needs Java 17+ (README says it is built and run on 21) and Maven 3.6+ for the Spring Boot daemon jar; the MCP layer needs Python 3.10+ with the pinned mcp 1.27.2 and httpx 0.27.2. The MCP client launches mcp_server/jadx_mcp.py, which starts the daemon on first use. The daemon binds 127.0.0.1:8765 with a 24 GB default heap and keeps one APK loaded by default; README puts a large APK at about 26 GB.

Input is an APK the analyst supplies. List and source tools are capped by default to bound response size, and README says the sink sweep is blind to reflection and to wrappers that rename the operation. The committed test fixture misc/DivaApplication.apk is the DIVA deliberately vulnerable training app; tests needing a larger production APK skip without it, and README reports 92 run and 4 skipped.

No license file: README only notes that the JADX library is Apache-2.0, so the server's own code states no reuse terms. README frames the tool for defensive security analysis and demonstrates it with Claude.

name: payload-dumper-go
description_en: Go command-line tool and library that extracts partition images from Android A/B OTA payloads, reading either a raw payload.bin or the OTA zip that contains it in place. It decompresses operations in parallel, can list partitions or dump only selected ones, and verifies operation data, source images and final images with SHA-256, exiting non-zero on any mismatch. Incremental (delta) payloads are applied onto previously extracted base images, and it regenerates the dm-verity hash tree and FEC parity that delta payloads omit, so the README reports bit-exact output.
description_zh: 用 Go 编写的命令行工具和库，可从 Android A/B OTA 载荷中提取分区镜像，既可读取原始 payload.bin，也可直接就地读取包含它的 OTA zip 包。它并行解压各项操作，可列出分区或只导出选定分区，并用 SHA-256 校验操作数据、源镜像和最终镜像，任何不一致都会以非零退出码结束。增量（差分）载荷会应用在先前提取的基础镜像之上，并重新生成差分载荷省略的 dm-verity 哈希树和 FEC 校验数据，因此 README 称输出可做到逐位一致。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2.1.0, published 2026-09-23 and identical to the reviewed main commit, with prebuilt binaries for Linux (amd64, amd64 AVX2, arm64, armv7), macOS (amd64, amd64 AVX2, arm64) and Windows (amd64, amd64 AVX2, arm64) and a checksum file; the README also lists a Homebrew package. The changelog says macOS builds need macOS 13 or later since 2.0.2 moved to Go 1.27. The README requires xz on the system because decompression uses the C xz library through cgo; the Dockerfile builds with CGO and liblzma-dev.

Input is an OTA zip or payload.bin the analyst supplies; an incremental OTA also needs the base images extracted from the matching earlier full OTA, passed with -old. The README says PUFFDIFF, ZUCCHINI and LZ4DIFF delta operations are not supported yet, so affected partitions, usually system, product or system_ext, fail with an error while the rest can be extracted with -p; images written with -no-fec skip FEC and final verification and must not be flashed.

The repository commits no OTA images: its tests build synthetic payloads, and two opt-in tests read a real payload path from environment variables (E2E_PAYLOAD, DBG_PAYLOAD). The payload format follows AOSP's update_metadata.proto. Apache-2.0.

name: Brida
description_en: Burp Suite extension by Federico Dotta and Piergiovanni Cipolloni that bridges Burp and Frida, so an analyst can run an app's own functions on the HTTP messages it exchanges with its backend instead of reimplementing its encryption, encoding or signing. A graphical plugin engine connects Frida-exported functions to Burp: they can process requests and responses in every Burp tool, or run from custom message-editor tabs, context-menu entries and buttons, and a Generate Stubs tool emits Java or Python code for external Burp extensions. An analysis tab shows the app's Java and Objective-C classes, methods, imports and exports as a tree, from which hooks that log arguments and return values, or replace return values, can be added; an editor holds the analyst's own Frida exports.
description_zh: 由 Federico Dotta 和 Piergiovanni Cipolloni 开发的 Burp Suite 扩展，在 Burp 与 Frida 之间架起桥梁，让分析者直接调用应用自身的函数处理它与后端交换的 HTTP 消息，而不必重新实现其中的加密、编码或签名逻辑。图形化插件引擎把 Frida 导出函数接入 Burp：既可在所有 Burp 工具中处理请求和响应，也可通过自定义消息编辑标签页、右键菜单项和按钮调用；Generate Stubs 工具还能为外部 Burp 扩展生成 Java 或 Python 代码。分析标签页以树形展示应用的 Java 和 Objective-C 类、方法以及导入导出，可从中添加挂钩，记录参数和返回值，或替换返回值；内置编辑器用于编写分析者自己的 Frida 导出函数。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.6, published 2025-10-23 as a single Brida_0.6.jar; the reviewed master commit is two commits ahead, adding and then removing a BApp Store description. Version 0.6 was refactored for Frida 17's JavaScript API and needs Frida 17 or later; v0.6pre, used with frida-compile 10.2.5, remains the release for older Frida versions. The README also points to Burp's BApp Store and notes that the copy there can lag behind GitHub.

Needs Burp Suite Community or Pro, Node.js and npm on the system path (the README warns that this can be hard on macOS), and the frida, frida-tools and pyro4 Python packages; a bundled Pyro4 service script connects the extension to Frida. The README says Brida supports every platform Frida does (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and QNX). Mobile targets need a jailbroken iOS or rooted Android device running frida-server, or an app patched with the Frida gadget.

Builds use Gradle's jar task, or Maven once the bundled modified RSyntaxTextArea jar (libs/rsyntaxtextarea-2.6.1.edited.jar) is installed locally; the extension uses the legacy Burp Extender API. Demo/ holds the authors' own conference demo apps and backend (HIP2021_demo.apk, DemoHIP.ipa, DemoHITB.ipa and BridaTestAppBackend-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar), demo TLS certificates and keys, and exported demo plugins. The iOS demo README asks that its backend, which logs in to MySQL as root with an empty password, run only on a firewalled system or VM.

MIT license. Brida for apps and backends the analyst owns or is authorized to test. The default Android and iOS hook collections under res/, which the README credits to various Frida CodeShare and GitHub authors.

name: debundle
description_en: Node.js command-line tool that unpacks JavaScript bundles produced by Browserify or Webpack back into a tree of module files, so a bundle can be read file by file instead of as one script. A JSON configuration gives the bundle type, the entry-point module and optional knownPaths that map numeric module IDs to output files or node_modules packages, and it can rewrite a minifier's renamed require identifier inline or through a variable so the output can be rebundled or run in Node. The README says it was built to learn how bundles are structured for a reverse-engineering project and that debundling is lossy: package.json settings and Webpack module names are not recovered, and minified code stays minified.
description_zh: Node.js 命令行工具，可把 Browserify 或 Webpack 生成的 JavaScript 打包文件还原为按模块拆分的文件树，便于逐个文件阅读，而不必面对一整个脚本。JSON 配置文件指定打包类型、入口模块，以及可选的 knownPaths（把数字模块 ID 映射为输出文件或 node_modules 中的包路径）；它还能以内联或变量方式改写被压缩工具重命名的 require 标识符，使输出可重新打包或在 Node 中运行。README 称该工具是作者为一个逆向工程项目了解打包结构而编写的，并指出拆包是有损的：无法恢复 package.json 设置和 Webpack 模块名称，压缩过的代码拆出后仍是压缩状态。
requirements: The README calls this a research project that is no longer maintained and says it works in a laboratory environment most of the time but often fails on real-world bundles. The reviewed master commit dates from 2018-06-16; npm's latest debundle release is 0.5.4 of 2017-09-12, newer than the repository's v0.5.3 tag and package.json, and unfinished v2 branches were last updated in 2020.

Installs with npm i -g debundle and runs as debundle -i <bundle> -o <directory> -c <config>. package.json requires Node 6 or newer, .nvmrc and the Travis CI configuration use Node 6, and the dependencies date from that period, such as acorn 4 and recast 0.5.

Only Browserify bundles and Webpack bundles whose modules are passed as an array are decoded: the Webpack decoder aborts when the module list is not an array, and other bundlers are not officially supported, although the moduleAst option can point to a module list with the same layout. Webpack output files are named after module IDs unless knownPaths names them.

test_bundles/ holds four small sample bundles with their configurations and original sources, which CI debundles with test_bundles/run_test.sh; the comparison with the original sources is commented out, so CI only checks that debundling finishes. Users supply the bundles to unpack, and the README's legal note warns that some terms of service forbid reverse engineering.
package.json and the npm package declare ISC, but the repository has no license file and GitHub detects none; src/extern/replace-method is a vendored MIT-licensed module by Hugh Kennedy.

name: Qu1cksc0pe
description_en: All-in-one malware triage tool that statically analyses Windows PE, Linux ELF (including Go binaries), macOS Mach-O and Android APK, JAR and DEX files as well as Office and PDF documents, scripts, shortcuts, archives, e-mails and PCAPs, reporting imports and API categories, sections, strings and IOCs, packers, embedded executables, Android permission risk, YARA matches and, for Windows and Linux, MITRE ATT&CK mappings. VBA/VBScript, JavaScript and PowerShell are run through bounded in-memory emulators instead of being executed, and --watch modes monitor live Windows, Linux and Android processes. A CLI, a Flask web UI and an MCP server expose the analyses, with optional LLM summaries of the JSON reports.
description_zh: 一体化恶意软件初筛工具，可对 Windows PE、Linux ELF（含 Go 二进制）、macOS Mach-O 和 Android APK、JAR、DEX 文件，以及 Office 与 PDF 文档、脚本、快捷方式、压缩包、电子邮件和 PCAP 做静态分析，报告导入表与 API 分类、节区、字符串与 IOC、加壳器、内嵌可执行文件、Android 权限风险和 YARA 匹配，并为 Windows 与 Linux 程序给出 MITRE ATT&CK 映射。VBA/VBScript、JavaScript 和 PowerShell 交由有界的内存内模拟器处理，而不会真正执行；--watch 模式可监视 Windows、Linux 和 Android 上运行中的进程。分析功能可通过命令行、Flask 网页界面和 MCP 服务器调用，还可选择用大语言模型总结 JSON 报告。
requirements: Actively developed from the master branch with no tags or GitHub releases; the reviewed commit of 2026-09-18 adds live-memory YARA/IOC scanning, Windows injection and hollowing checks and expanded Android dynamic analysis. README recommends Parrot OS, Kali Linux or Windows 10/11; Mach-O and Go binaries are analysed statically only.

README has users clone the repository into a Python virtual environment and run setup.sh (apt-get or pacman hosts) or setup.ps1 on Windows. Setup installs requirements.txt, which pins androguard 3.4.0a1, yara-python 4.5.0 and unicorn 2.1.4 and adds lief, pefile, oletools, frida-tools, docker, flask and mcp>=2.0.0, plus adb, binutils strings, unzip, 7-Zip, JADX 1.5.3 in a sc0pe_Base folder in the home directory and Ollama with its configured model. A Dockerfile based on Ubuntu 22.04 runs the CLI against a mounted file. Hash scans download the HashDB SQLite database from the separate CYB3RMX/MalwareHashDB repository, and VirusTotal lookups need the user's own API key.

Inputs are the analyst's own suspicious files. The repository ships detection data, about 300 YARA rule files, Android Frida scripts and API and ATT&CK mapping tables, plus a bundled dnlib 3.6.0 .NET library (Systems/Windows/dnlib.dll, from the open-source de4dot project) that the reviewed scripts do not reference by name; it contains no malware samples. Static analysis and the script emulators do not run samples, but Linux binary emulation runs them under qemu-user in a network-disabled Docker container, falling back to host qemu when Docker is unavailable, and the --watch modes attach to live processes on the host or a connected Android device. Handle samples only on an isolated analysis machine.

--ai sends a report to Ollama by default; the shipped multiple.conf names the cloud-tagged kimi-k2.5:cloud model, for which setup.ps1 suggests ollama signin, and Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM backends are opt-in through --ai_provider, in which case report data leaves the machine. The MCP server (--mcp) exposes 14 tools over streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8765 by default, or over stdio, and a bundled .mcp.json registers it for Claude Code. Family candidates, emulation traces and AI summaries are heuristic findings for analyst review.

name: gr-lora
description_en: GNU Radio out-of-tree module by Pieter Robyns and co-authors for receiving and decoding LoRa physical-layer frames with a software-defined radio, implementing the modulation features described in patents and blog posts. Its receiver channelizes the input, detects and synchronizes to LoRa chirps with clock-drift correction, and decodes symbols through Gray mapping, deinterleaving, dewhitening and Hamming decoding into header and payload bytes, which a message socket sink can forward over UDP port 40868. The bundled flowgraphs decode recorded traces or live captures, and the README lists HackRF One, USRP B201, RTL-SDR and LimeSDR as tested receivers.
description_zh: 由 Pieter Robyns 等人开发的 GNU Radio 树外模块，借助软件定义无线电接收并解码 LoRa 物理层帧，实现了专利和博客文章中描述的调制特性。其接收器先对输入进行信道化，检测 LoRa 线性调频信号并与之同步、校正时钟漂移，再经格雷映射、解交织、去白化和汉明译码把符号还原为报头和载荷字节；消息套接字汇点可把结果通过 UDP 端口 40868 转发。附带的流图可解码录制的信号或实时采集的信号，README 列出 HackRF One、USRP B201、RTL-SDR 和 LimeSDR 为经过测试的接收设备。
requirements: The newest commit on master, from 2021-12-10, merged a port to GNU Radio 3.9: CMake requests GNU Radio 3.9, the Python bindings use pybind11, and the library links liquid-dsp and log4cpp. The README was not updated for the port and still lists Python 2, SWIG and wx dependencies, and its Docker image installs python2 packages on an unpinned Arch Linux base; the Travis CI configuration builds GNU Radio maint-3.8. A gr3.7 branch keeps the older code.

Input is IQ samples from an SDR or a recorded file. The receiver block takes sample rate, center frequency, channel list, bandwidth, spreading factor, coding rate, implicit-header, CRC and reduced-rate settings that must match the transmission. apps/lora_receive_file_nogui.py offers to download an example 868.1 MHz SF7 trace from the authors' university server, and further traces are in the separate gr-lora-samples repository. The README lists LoPy, Dragino HAT, Adafruit Feather 32u4, Microchip RN2483 and SX1276 boards as tested transmitters.

The README states that payload and header CRCs are not checked and that several channels cannot be decoded at once; its changelog marks version 0.7's downlink, reduced-rate implicit-header and arbitrary-bandwidth support as experimental. The newest version tag is v0.6.2, so 0.7 exists only on master. docs/test-results holds the authors' decoding rates from suites rerun on 2021-12-01 during the port, such as 100% on the short USRP traces, and the author considers LoRa fully reverse engineered as of version 0.6, citing close to 100% accuracy on clear signals; these are author-reported results.
GPL-3.0 (LICENSE). The README asks research users to cite the Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.853201. It covers the LoRa physical layer only.

name: CNNPRE (IEEE Access 2023)
description_en: Research code and data for CNNPRE, a message-type identification method for protocol reverse engineering by Javad Garshasbi and Mehdi Teimouri, published in IEEE Access in 2023. A single Colab notebook turns each message's padded bit string into a resized grayscale image, extracts features with an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 as transfer learning, adds message direction and length-group encodings, reduces the features with UMAP and clusters messages with agglomerative clustering and HDBSCAN, scoring each clustering against labelled message types. Preprocessed message datasets for twelve protocols, from ARP and DNS to SMTP and GSM, accompany the notebook.
description_zh: CNNPRE 的研究代码与数据。CNNPRE 是 Javad Garshasbi 与 Mehdi Teimouri 于 2023 年发表在 IEEE Access 上、用于协议逆向工程的报文类型识别方法。仓库中唯一的 Colab 笔记本把每条报文补齐后的比特串转为缩放的灰度图像，借助在 ImageNet 上预训练的 ResNet50 进行迁移学习以提取特征，加入报文方向和长度分组编码，用 UMAP 降维后再以凝聚聚类和 HDBSCAN 对报文聚类，并将各聚类结果与已标注的报文类型比较评分。笔记本附有从 ARP、DNS 到 SMTP、GSM 等十二种协议的预处理报文数据集。
requirements: Paper: Javad Garshasbi and Mehdi Teimouri, “CNNPRE: A CNN-Based Protocol Reverse Engineering Method,” IEEE Access, vol. 11, pp. 116255–116268, 2023, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2023.3325391; Crossref lists it under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The repository was reviewed at its 2026-01-13 head, a README update; the notebook last changed on 2023-07-06, and there are no releases.

The only code is cnnpre.ipynb, written for Google Colab.
